Asaram reaches Ayodhya for darshan of Ram Lalla: Says, 'visiting pilgrimage sites lessens suffering in hell'; out on bail for treatment Rape convict Asaram reached Ayodhya and walked along the Saryu riverbank on Tuesday evening. He said he came to have darshan of Ram Lalla. Followers greeted him during the visit. Asaram, out on interim bail on medical grounds, is staying at Laxman Fort and will visit the temple. 7. Indian among 4 hurt after drones fall near Dubai Airport Iran says it has carried out its biggest attack on Israel so far. In district president appointments, BJP has given 54% posts to upper castes, SP has 70% to Muslim-Yadav leaders, while BSP relies heavily on Dalits with 92%. Congress follows the BPDA formula. Experts say parties prioritise core vote bank leaders to strengthen organisational control. 9. 'Ultimatum given to Yogi, not CM': Dy CM should refute Ashutosh's statements if they both are not complicit, says Shankaracharya Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand arrived in Lucknow and addressed controversies surrounding Ashutosh Maharaj, denying all allegations of misconduct and foreign travel. stories.title: Woman declared dead starts breathing after ambulance hits pothole:Doctor asked family to take her home after proclaiming ‘brain dead’
stories.summary: A woman from Pilibhit who had been declared brain dead by doctors in Bareilly has made a remarkable recovery after an unexpected jolt in an ambulance triggered signs of life. Her family had already begun preparations for her last rites, believing she had no chance of survival. The incident occurred while her husband was bringing her back home in an ambulance after doctors advised the family to take her away due to her critical condition. While travelling on the Bareilly–Haridwar National Highway-74, the ambulance hit a pothole, causing a sudden jolt. Immediately afterwards, the woman’s body moved, and she began breathing again. Shocked by the sudden change, her family rushed her to another hospital, where she received treatment for 13 days. She has now returned home in good health. The case falls under the City Kotwali police station area. Kuldeep Shukla (55) lives there with his family. On the evening of 22 February, his wife Vineeta Shukla (50) suddenly fainted and collapsed while doing household chores. Vineeta works as a senior assistant in the Pilibhit court. After she lost consciousness, family members rushed her to a private hospital in Bareilly. Declared brain dead after 2 days on ventilator Doctors placed Vineeta on a ventilator for two days. However, there was no movement in her body and her pupils were dilated. When her condition did not improve, doctors reportedly declared her brain dead and advised the family to take her home. Her husband, Kuldeep Shukla, said he reluctantly arranged an ambulance and began the journey back to Pilibhit on 24 February. Ambulance jolt brings signs of life Kuldeep recalled the dramatic moment during the journey. 'While we were returning home, the ambulance suddenly hit a pothole on the Bareilly–Haridwar National Highway, causing a strong jolt,' he said. ‘Immediately after the jolt, Vineeta’s body began to move and she started breathing again.’ The unexpected development left the family stunned, prompting them to rush her to Neurocity Hospital in Pilibhit for further treatment. Family had begun preparing for last rites Kuldeep said the family had already begun preparations for Vineeta’s last rites before the incident. ‘I had informed family members to prepare for the funeral. She was not breathing, and only her heartbeat remained, which was gradually slowing down,’ he said. For me, her breathing again was nothing short of a miracle. As soon as I realised she was breathing again, I immediately told my family members to stop the preparations.” Doctors suspected possible snake neurotoxin At Neurocity Hospital, neurosurgeon Dr Rakesh Singh first obtained Vineeta’s medical history from the hospital in Bareilly before beginning treatment. According to Dr Singh, Vineeta’s brainstem reflexes were absent and her Glasgow Coma Scale had dropped from the normal score of 15 to just 3, indicating severe neurological impairment. An eye examination showed pupillary dilation (mydriasis), a sign of brain inactivity. During the examination, doctors also noticed teeth marks on her feet, raising suspicion of possible snake poisoning caused by a neurotoxin. Based on this suspicion, doctors administered anti-venom along with supportive treatment. Recovery within 24 hours, discharged after 13 days Remarkably, Vineeta’s body began responding to treatment within 24 hours. After 13 days of treatment without the need for a ventilator, she recovered completely. She has now returned home and can walk on her own. Her husband said she is conscious and speaking normally with family members. After recovering, Vineeta said emotionally that she does not remember what happened to her. Kuldeep described her recovery as a blessing from God and credited the doctors for their dedicated efforts.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav’s royal wedding card revealed:Radha-Krishna theme with intricate golden detailing and a palace-style design
stories.summary: Indian cricket team spinner Kuldeep Yadav is going to marry his childhood friend Vanshika Singh. On March 14, both will take 7 vows at 'Welcome Hotel The Savoy' in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand. Three days later, on March 17, there will be a grand reception party at Hotel Centrum in Lucknow. Kuldeep and Vanshika's beautiful and royal wedding card has been revealed. The design, craftsmanship and illustrations engraved on this invitation card, obtained by Dainik Bhaskar, give a feel of a royal palace. The card costs ?2200. Kuldeep is from Kanpur. While Vanshika lives in Lucknow. The couple got engaged in Lucknow on June 4, 2025. Wedding Card PHOTOS... Special features of the wedding card... Royal style and intricate detailing The base of the card is in a light pink (peach) shade with delicate floral patterns printed across it. The design features gold foil work, giving it an elegant look. Golden detailing along the edges highlights palace domes and shapes, creating a 3D and vintage appearance. The top portion of the card has a golden lock (buckle) decorated with a pink floral design. Attractive Couple Portrait Engraved in Center At the centre of the card, an attractive illustration has been engraved. It shows a couple standing in front of a royal palace window. Dressed in traditional red and green royal attire, the couple resembles a Rajputana pair. In the background, lattice-style palace windows and domes are visible. The lower part of the card beautifully depicts nature, showing a fountain, lotus flowers blooming in a pond and a peacock sitting near the fountain. Letters and invitation message The font used on the card also matches the royal theme. At the top, the names “Kuldeep and Vanshika” are written inside a beautiful golden vintage-style nameplate design. The card also includes an invitation tag, where the English letters ‘K’ and ‘V’ (for Kuldeep and Vanshika) are combined to create a logo that ends in a heart shape. It is written in English- A Heartfelt Invitation From: Mr. Ram Singh Yadav, Mr. Kuldeep Singh Yadav Just below it is their Kanpur residence address - '381-D, Defence Colony, Jajmau, Kanpur' and phone number. Wedding and reception program Haldi and Mehendi ceremonies will take place on March 13. The wedding ceremony of Kuldeep and Vanshika will be held on March 14 in the presence of family members and close relatives. Kuldeep’s father has also met Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and invited him to the wedding. Wedding Postponed After Engagement Kuldeep and Vanshika had earlier planned to get married in November, but the ceremony was postponed due to cricket tournaments and the busy schedule of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup. Kuldeep reportedly wanted to win the World Cup first before getting married. Several prominent personalities from cricket, politics and the film industry are expected to attend the wedding. The guest list may include Indian cricket team star batsman Virat Kohli along with several other Team India players. A hotel staff member, speaking on condition of anonymity, said that Jay Shah, chairman of the ICC, may also attend the ceremony. Besides him, several political leaders, including Uttarakhand Chief Minister Pushkar Singh Dhami, are also expected to be present.

stories.title: Navy personnel arrested for ISI spying days after Dubai honeymoon:Married recently, accused of sharing sensitive naval details
stories.summary: UP ATS has arrested a Pakistani spy from Agra. The accused is a Lance Naik in the Indian Navy and was allegedly spying for Pakistan’s intelligence agency, ISI. He had sent photographs and details of Indian warships to an ISI agent. ATS arrested the accused, Adarsh Kumar alias Lucky, on Tuesday from his village Chitpur under Kagaarol police station area in Agra. He got married just 22 days ago and had gone to Dubai for his honeymoon. He returned from there three days ago. The Lance Naik had also transferred money to an ISI agent from his bank account. This was confirmed through documents recovered from him. Lance Naik Lucky was posted in Kerala Lance Naik Adarsh Kumar was posted at the Southern Naval Command in Kochi, Kerala. ATS had been receiving information for some time that he was sending sensitive information related to India to Pakistan’s ISI. ATS picked up Lucky from his village and questioned him. During interrogation, it was confirmed that he had shared highly sensitive information. His electronic gadgets were also examined, which confirmed his involvement in espionage. ATS arrested the accused and produced him in an Agra court, from where he was sent to judicial custody. Agencies are now investigating whether more people are involved in this espionage network. The photo is said to be of Lucky’s house. When a Dainik Bhaskar team reached there, nobody was found and the area appeared deserted. Marriage took place on February 19 A Dainik Bhaskar team visited Chitpur village of the accused. The area was quiet, and neighbours expressed surprise after learning that Adarsh was allegedly working as a Pakistani agent. They said he had joined the Navy seven years ago. He got married on 19 February to a woman from Vishawar in Mathura. The wedding ceremony took place at Suraj Garden in Kagaarol village. After the marriage, Adarsh went to Dubai with his wife for a honeymoon. As soon as he returned, ATS arrested him. Villagers said they never suspected that Adarsh could be a Pakistani agent. According to them, he appeared to be very simple and quiet. When the Bhaskar reporter reached Adarsh’s house, it was locked and nobody was present. Locals said his father Balveer is one of three brothers and the family lives jointly. Balveer works at a liquor shop. So was Lucky a victim of honeytrap like Ravindra? Pakistan’s intelligence agency often traps people through honey traps to make them spy. A year ago, ATS had arrested Ravindra Kumar from Agra on similar charges. He had come in contact with a woman named Neha Sharma through Facebook. Ravindra Kumar was sending confidential documents of the Ordnance Factory to a woman working for ISI. These included information related to drones, the Gaganyaan project and a confidential letter of a screening committee. Agencies suspect that Lance Naik Lucky might also have fallen victim to a honey trap. The matter is currently under investigation. When were spies caught from Agra? March 14, 2025: Ravindra Kumar (Ordnance Factory Employee) Caught by: UP ATS Charges: Fell into a honey trap by a Pakistani female handler and shared defence-related confidential information. March 14, 2025: An associate of Ravindra Kumar also in custody Charge: Helping ISI handler share sensitive information. September 27, 2023: Shailesh Kumar Arrested by: UP ATS Charge: Contacting ISI handler through Facebook and sharing army-related activities information. Common Pattern in All Cases ▪ In most cases, contact was established through social media such as Facebook or WhatsApp. ▪ Many cases involved honey traps or financial temptation. ▪ Targets were often employees linked to defence establishments or those having access to sensitive information.

stories.title: Gas shortage in UP sparks clashes for cylinders in Gorakhpur:Fists fly before police; woman faints in Shravasti, Ram Rasoi shut in Ayodhya
stories.summary: There is a shortage of cooking gas (LPG) in Uttar Pradesh. Even after booking, cylinders are not being delivered for 4 to 5 days. Due to the shortage, Ram Rasoi in Ayodhya has been shut. This is the first time in eight years that Ram Rasoi has been closed. Ram Rasoi closed for first time in eight years In Shravasti, a large crowd gathered outside a gas agency. During the rush, a woman fell to the ground and lost consciousness. She suffered a head injury and started bleeding. She was later sent to the hospital for treatment. Woman faints after rush at gas agency Meanwhile, for the second day on Wednesday, long queues were seen outside gas agencies. Cylinders are being distributed in the presence of police in Gorakhpur and Siddharthnagar. In many places, people reached gas agencies as early as 3 am with their cylinders. Long queues seen outside agencies since early morning Even after standing in queues for hours, many people are still not getting cylinders. The reason is that the number of cylinders is low while the number of people waiting is much higher. Short supply of cylinders increases problems for people In Gorakhpur, a young man tried to enter the queue with a cylinder. Another man objected, which led to a fight between the two. They punched and kicked each other in front of police personnel. Later, the police took both of them into custody. Meanwhile, Chief Minister Yogi has issued strict orders. He said black marketing of gas and oil will not be tolerated under any circumstances. Action will also be taken against those spreading rumours about the gas shortage. He has directed all District Magistrates and Superintendents of Police to keep strict watch on the situation. No mercy for rumor mongers Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath has clearly stated that those spreading false information regarding gas and petroleum product supply in the state will not be spared. He has directed the police headquarters and police in all districts to maintain strict surveillance on social media. All District Magistrates and police officials have been asked to continuously monitor the situation around petrol pumps and gas agencies. The government has also made it clear that strict action will be taken against those who illegally store gas and engage in black marketing. Gas agencies inspection begins on DM's orders After complaints of reluctance in delivering cylinders at gas agencies, District Magistrate Vishakh G gave strict instructions to officials. The DM, ADM Civil Supply Jyoti Gautam, and District Supply Officer reviewed the situation in a meeting with oil company officials. Following this, district supply department officials were directed to check the stock of gas agencies in their respective areas along with the concerned SDM and Additional City Magistrate. The administration has made it clear that complaints of black marketing should not come up under any circumstances. Administration takes action on several agencies, including Lalbagh After receiving information about a commotion at a gas agency in Lalbagh, a team led by the Additional City Magistrate reached the spot and inspected the stock. The ACM Third team also inspected Telibagh Indane Gas Agency and Alambagh's Suraj Indane Gas Agency. The administration says that strict action will be taken if any irregularities are found at any agency. Crisis looms over wedding events and catering business The LPG crisis has started affecting weddings in the city. Vijay Kumar, President of Uttar Pradesh Tent Caterers and Decorators Welfare Association, said that around three thousand weddings are proposed in Lucknow in the next four days, but due to a shortage of commercial cylinders, catering businesses are facing a major crisis. Dhabas and street carts' stoves start going cold The city has about 1500 small and large hotels, more than five thousand restaurants and sweet shops, and approximately 50 thousand street carts and shops operating. Most of these depend on commercial gas cylinders. Due to a gas shortage, many small dhabas and tea shops' stoves have started going cold. Tea prices have also started increasing in areas like Ayodhya Road and Kanpur Road. Where tea was previously available for ₹10 rupees, now ₹12 tea and ₹15 tea are being sold for up to ₹20.

stories.title: Former BSP District President arrested for taking bribe:Accused asks for ₹45,000 to get loan of ₹5 lakhs approved from bank
stories.summary: The Anti-Corruption Team has arrested former BSP district president Suresh Chaudhary while accepting a bribe of ₹45 thousand rupees in Hardoi. He was demanding a bribe from a woman to get a loan of ₹5 lakhs approved from the bank. Based on the woman's complaint, the Anti-Corruption Team planned to trap the BSP leader. On Tuesday, the woman was sent to the office with money. As soon as the BSP leader took the money, the team arrived and arrested him. After this, the team interrogated him for about 7 hours and left for Lucknow. During this time, the BSP leader was seen hiding his face. The BSP leader said that he has been framed to defame him under a political conspiracy. He served as BSP district president of Hardoi from July 2020 until the 2022 assembly elections. Later, he was removed from the district president position due to poor performance in the election. Read how the BSP leader was trapped According to Seema Devi, a resident of Achramau village in Baghauli police station area, she applied for a loan of ₹5 lakh under the Chief Minister Youth Entrepreneur Employment Scheme at Bank of Baroda. She was asked to contact BSP's former district president, Suresh Chaudhary, who is a resident of Sugsugi village. Suresh Chaudhary operates a bank BC (Business Correspondent) centre. He is also a recovery agent. The woman alleges that the BSP leader demanded a bribe of ₹50 thousand from her. She had gathered evidence of the conversation and bribe demand and filed a complaint with Anti-Corruption. The bribe amount was settled at ₹45 thousand. After this, the team planned a trap. The team sent the woman with ₹45 thousand to the BSP leader. During this time, the former BSP district president was sitting with workers in his office. As soon as he took the bribe amount from the woman, the CBI team arrested him. BSP leader questioned for 7 hours, bank manager absconding The Anti-Corruption team took the BSP leader to the guard room of Kachhona railway station. He was interrogated here for about 7 hours. Some important documents and transaction-related papers were seized from the leader's office. Upon receiving information about the BSP leader's arrest, the manager of Bank of Baroda's Kachhona branch fled. The team is engaged in searching for him.

stories.title: Asaram reaches Ayodhya for darshan of Ram Lalla:Says, 'visiting pilgrimage sites lessens suffering in hell'; out on bail for treatment
stories.summary: Rape convict Asaram arrived in Ayodhya on Tuesday evening and walked along the banks of the Saryu River. During the visit, several people were seen greeting him with folded hands. Asaram said he had come to Ayodhya to have darshan of Lord Ram Lalla. Speaking to followers, he said India has many pilgrimage sites where visiting or dying is believed to bring spiritual welfare. According to scriptures, there are seven liberation-giving places: Ayodhya, Mathura, Maya (Haridwar), Kashi, Kanchi, Avantika, and Puri. He added that the human body is affected by three imbalances: vata, kapha, and pitta, and visiting pilgrimage sites is believed to help reduce their effects. He also said that Ayodhya holds the foremost place among such sacred locations in the scriptures. Asaram is scheduled to have darshan of Ram Lalla today. During his visit, he is also expected to meet Ram Temple Trust General Secretary Champat Rai. He is currently staying at Laxman Fort, an Acharya Peeth located on the banks of the Saryu River. Asaram had been granted 6 months’ bail by the Rajasthan High Court on October 29. Based on this, Asaram also received 6 months interim bail from the Gujarat High Court on November 6. During the hearing of Asaram's bail petition in the Gujarat High Court, it was argued that the Jodhpur court had granted bail to Asaram for 6 months. He is suffering from a heart-related illness. Walked 300 meters along the Saryu bank Asaram walked from Jhunki Ghat to Sadguru Kuti at 3 PM on Tuesday. Then went to Lakshman Fort by car. Rested there. Left Lakshman Fort around 6 PM. From here reached the Saryu bank. Walked about 300 meters. During this time, his followers touched his feet. It is being reported that Asaram wanted to visit Hanuman Garhi as well. But will not go there due to too many stairs. Now read why Asaram got life imprisonment Girl raped in ashram under pretext of ghost possession A family living in Shahjahanpur, UP, was a follower of Asaram. The family's minor daughter was studying in the 12th standard at Asaram's ashram in Chhindwara (Madhya Pradesh). This incident is from 2013. One day, the girl fainted in class. The guru's disciple claimed she was possessed by ghosts and said that only Asaram Bapu could treat this. After this, on August 14, 2013, the girl was taken to Manai Ashram in Jodhpur, about 1000 kilometers away from Chhindwara. On the night of August 15, 2013, a cook brought a glass of milk to the cottage. After this, Asaram raped the girl. Five days after this incident, on August 20, 2013, the victim girl filed an FIR with the Delhi Police. In this, the victim girl stated that Asaram asked her to perform oral sex and also touched her inappropriately. Due to Delhi's Nirbhaya rape case, new laws regarding rape and molestation had been implemented by that time. Therefore, strict sections under the new law were applied against Asaram. On March 31, 2013, Asaram was arrested in this case. On April 25, 2018, the Jodhpur court sentenced Asaram to life imprisonment in this case. Since then, Asaram has been imprisoned in Central Jail, Jodhpur. This is the first time in so many years that Asaram has come out on parole. On January 7, 2025, the Supreme Court granted him bail until March 31, 2025, on medical grounds. Relief was granted from Rajasthan and Gujarat High Courts again The Rajasthan High Court in Jodhpur granted Asaram interim bail for 6 months on October 29 for treatment, citing his advancing age and continuously deteriorating health. Based on this order, on November 6, the Gujarat High Court also granted him bail in another rape case. However, it included conditions of keeping three policemen with Asaram and not meeting devotees in groups. A petition was filed again in the Gujarat High Court on behalf of Asaram to remove these two conditions.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav to tie knot at Mussoorie’s Savoy Hotel:Once Nehru's favourite, the British ordered him to vacate the property
stories.summary: Indian cricket team’s star spinner Kuldeep Yadav is set to marry his childhood friend Vanshika on March 14 at the iconic Welcomhotel The Savoy. The wedding ceremonies will begin on March 12 and continue for three days, with several prominent guests expected to attend. Located in the heart of Mussoorie, the ITC heritage property is not only a luxury hotel but also an important historical landmark of the hill town. More than a century old, the hotel once served as a favourite retreat of India’s first Prime Minister, Jawaharlal Nehru. Interestingly, there was also a time during British rule when Nehru was asked to vacate the hotel. Perched at an altitude of around 6,500 feet, the hotel is renowned for its grand British-era architecture and sweeping views of the Himalayan mountains. A one-night stay here costs upwards of ₹26,000, while a single meal at the property can cost around ₹20,000. The historic hotel has once again come into the spotlight as Kuldeep prepares to tie the knot there. Rooms for several guests have also been booked at the JW Marriott Mussoorie Walnut Grove Resort Spa. Wedding rituals to begin on March 12 The wedding festivities of Kuldeep Yadav and Vanshika will begin on March 12 in Mussoorie. The Haldi and Mehendi ceremonies will take place on March 13, followed by the main wedding ceremony on March 14, when the couple will exchange vows. After the wedding, a grand reception has been planned on March 17 at Hotel Centrum. Kuldeep’s father, Ram Singh Yadav, recently met Yogi Adityanath and personally invited him to the wedding and reception. The Chief Minister is expected to attend the celebrations. Several personalities from the cricketing world, along with officials from the Board of Control for Cricket in India and the Uttar Pradesh Cricket Association, are also likely to be present. Royal heritage property spread across 23 acres The Savoy Hotel, located in the “Queen of Hills”, is spread across nearly 23.5 acres. Its grand colonial-style architecture, expansive lawns and magnificent Himalayan views make it one of the most distinctive properties in the region. The hotel’s lush greenery and tranquil environment give it a unique charm, which is why it frequently hosts large events, royal ceremonies and destination weddings. Even today, the corridors and rooms of the hotel retain their Edwardian-era character. Antique furniture, pianos, cut-glass décor and numerous artefacts imported from Europe continue to adorn the property. From School to Luxury Hotel: The Savoy’s Origins The history of the Savoy began not as a hotel but as a school. In 1849, the premises housed Maddock School, which later came to be known as Stokes School. In 1890, Irish barrister Cecil D’Lincoln purchased the property and converted it into a luxury hotel, naming it Savoy Hotel. The aim was to establish one of Mussoorie’s most magnificent establishments. To furnish the hotel, furniture, pianos and silver cutlery were imported from England and other parts of Europe. During that era, these items were transported by ship to Kolkata and then carried via Allahabad, Saharanpur and Dehradun to Mussoorie using bullock carts and manual labour. 3 signature restaurants at the Savoy The Savoy Hotel houses several well-known restaurants, each offering a distinctive culinary experience. Grand Dining Hall: The hotel’s main restaurant reflects classic British-era heritage dining. With large chandeliers, wooden interiors and a regal ambience, it serves Indian as well as international multi-cuisine dishes. The Writers Bar: Designed like a library lounge, this space features comfortable sofas, wooden décor and a relaxed atmosphere. Guests can enjoy premium drinks, cocktails and light snacks here. The Royal Afghan: This speciality restaurant is known for its North-West Frontier cuisine, offering dishes such as seekh kebabs, malai tikka, dal Bukhara-style lentils and various tandoori delicacies. When was Nehru asked to leave the Savoy? According to historians, Jawaharlal Nehru first visited Mussoorie in 1906 with his father. Later, in May 1920, he returned with his wife Kamala Nehru and daughter Indira and stayed at the Savoy Hotel. At the same time, discussions involving representatives related to a political treaty between Afghanistan and the British administration were being held at the hotel. British officials feared that Nehru might attempt to influence the talks. They asked him to sign a written declaration stating that he would not interfere in the discussions. Nehru refused to sign the document. As a result, the British authorities ordered him to vacate the hotel within 24 hours, after which he returned to Allahabad. Despite this episode, Nehru visited Mussoorie several times later. In 1928, he again stayed at the Savoy with his wife Kamala, and in October 1930, he returned with his father and wife, staying at the hotel for three days before travelling back to Allahabad.

stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj's ticket was confirmed at last moment:Seats allotted to Vijayawada passengers; co-travellers say none saw the attack
stories.summary: A deadly attack took place on Ashutosh Maharaj, who filed an FIR against Shankaracharya for sexual harassment of young disciples, on March 8 (Sunday) in a moving train. Ashutosh Maharaj had a waiting ticket in the Rewa Express. However, 2 passengers did not arrive on time. After this, Ashutosh Maharaj and his companion were allotted seats. After the attack, Ashutosh Maharaj had said that he was traveling from Rewa Express on seats 15-16 of coach H1. In our investigation, it has come to light that he had taken two tickets in the names of Ashutosh and Sudhansu. However, the tickets were on the waiting list. Seats numbers 15-16 were booked by 2 passengers from Vijayawada. In conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, that passenger said, ‘It was our ticket’. We had booked from Delhi to Rewa. But we missed the train as we reached the station late. Due to this, we could not travel. Those same seats were allotted to Ashutosh Maharaj and his disciple Sudhansu at the last moment. We also spoke to another passenger from Rajruppur (Prayagraj) who was traveling in the seat next to Ashutosh Maharaj. He was traveling from Delhi to Prayagraj. On condition of anonymity, he says, ‘I was sleeping when this happened’. I didn't see the attack. But he (Ashutosh Maharaj) came screaming from the bathroom and opened the coach door; that's when I woke up. I saw blood on his face and body; he was screaming. Read in detail what the passenger said.. Bhaskar: You were coming by Rewa Express on Sunday. What happened? Passenger: When I was coming by Rewa Express, at that time I saw that Babaji was covered in blood. Bhaskar: Did you see the attack happening? Passenger: No, the First AC gate was closed. The incident happened near the toilet. I wasn't near the toilet. Bhaskar: Did you not see what happened near the toilet? Passenger: No, I was sleeping. When he (Ashutosh Maharaj) entered by opening the door while screaming, that's when I woke up. Then I saw that there was blood on his face and blood on his body too. I saw him from the front. Bhaskar: There were 4 passengers, who were all sleeping. Was his companion also sleeping? Passenger: Yes, everyone was sleeping. At 4-5 in the morning, everyone was sleeping. Everyone woke up hearing the noise. Reporter: They came screaming. What happened after that? Passenger: When they came screaming, everyone saw that there was blood on their face and clothes. They sat down and kept making phone calls here and there. When we reached Prayagraj, the GRP officials did the paperwork. Reporter: Wasn't there a coach attendant? Passenger: The coach attendant came later. When Baba came inside, there was a bell inside. We rang it for quite a while. We closed the gate and rang the bell, but still he didn't come. The boy who was with Baba went and woke up the coach attendant. Only then did he come. After that, they called the TTE. Then a policeman came. It's a morning incident, so everyone was sleeping soundly. Bhaskar: Was the train gate open? Passenger: We didn't see it, but Baba says the gates were open on both sides. After the first AC, the general coach on the other side was locked. But the boarding and deboarding gates were open. The coach attendant and TTE also came and told that the gates were open. We didn't see it; we remained seated in our seats. While sitting, we came from Sirathu to Prayagraj. Baba kept talking on the phone everywhere. Then the GRP officers questioned us at the station. After that, I don't know what happened. Over 200 CCTVs examined Ashutosh Maharaj, who filed a case against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, was attacked around 5 AM on March 8. At that time, Ashutosh Maharaj was traveling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express. In the complaint, he stated that when he went towards the train's toilet between Fatehpur and Sirathu stations in Kaushambi district, someone attacked him. Meanwhile, the investigating GRP team has so far scanned more than 200 CCTVs. However, no footage shows any attackers during the attack or while boarding and deboarding. On the other hand, Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj has refused to give his statement in the investigation. He has written a letter to the Union Home Secretary to change the investigation. He has demanded an investigation by an independent agency.

stories.title: Sudden fog leads to multiple accidents in UP:3 dead in Shahjahanpur car‑bus collision, 4 vehicles crash in Unnao
stories.summary: A sudden morning fog has led to multiple accident in Uttar Pradesh. Due to intense fog, a bus and a car collided in Shahjahanpur early morning killing 3 people in the incident. Meanwhile, in Unnao four vehicles collide due to poor visibility injuring over 18 people while 4 are reported to be in a critical condition. Despite this sudden change in weather, heat has started showing its intensity in many cities across the state. The maximum temperature has crossed 38 degree Celsius. On Wednesday morning, fog persisted in 15 cities of the state including Lucknow and Kanpur and was observed for the second consecutive day. In Bareilly, visibility remained up to 100 meters. This intense fog resulted in 3 accidents in the state in which over 7 vehicles collided. IMD issues rain alert for major cities in Purvanchal Meanwhile, the Meteorological Department has issued a rain alert in many cities of Purvanchal today. During this time, winds are likely to blow at a speed of 10-15 km per hour. Talking about the last 24 hours, Banda was the hottest city in the state, where the maximum temperature was recorded at 38.4 degree Celcius. According to Lucknow's meteorologist Atul Singh, “Due to rising temperature and moisture in the air, fog in the morning and haze-like conditions during the day are forming. Temperature may increase further in the coming days. Mercury is expected to reach 40C in many areas. Weather may deteriorate after March 15, during which rainfall is possible”. Know where the accidents occurred Images of dense fog conditions Know the situation of first 4 major cities- Now know the condition of other cities Light rain beneficial for farmers Doctors have advised people to avoid going out in strong sunlight during afternoon hours and drink adequate water. The weather can have mixed effects for farmers. While light rain can prove beneficial for crops, there are concerns about damage to standing crops from intense heat and winds. How will the weather be for 4 days Another sudden reason for fog? Why is the heat increasing in March itself? Skymet Weather's Vice President Mahesh Palawat said, “In recent years, the effect of climate change is clearly visible on the weather. Due to this, the weather pattern is changing rapidly. Summer is starting earlier compared to before”. He added, “The effect is that now the temperature has started rising more rapidly. The number of hot days is also increasing. Sometimes the heat wave period also lasts longer than before. In the past few years, old heat records have also been broken in many cities of the country. In some places, temperatures have been recorded above 48 degrees”. Heatwave could last for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures could remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the Meteorological Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature recorded is 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected and the risk of heat stroke increases. Crops will be damaged due to heat Professor PK Singh of the Agriculture Department at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) said “March could prove to be a challenging month for farmers. The rise in temperature will affect the rabi crop, especially wheat. Due to heat, the grains will not develop fully. This will result in lower yield”. He further added, “Hot winds can also damage crops like mustard, chickpeas and peas. Due to rising temperatures, the soil in the fields dries up quickly. This increases irrigation costs. Crops face stress”.

stories.title: MLA who confronted Swatantra Dev conducts ground reality check:Brijbhushan Rajput alleges water scheme failure; demands SIT probe from Yogi
stories.summary: BJP MLA Brijbhushan Rajput, who stopped Minister Swatantra Dev's convoy, went to conduct a reality check of the Jal Jeevan Mission in Mahoba. He visited several villages. During this, he found that in villages declared 'fully saturated', pipes are lying outside houses. Taps are not even installed on the water connections. The BJP MLA said that water connections have not yet reached the villages. Women are still forced to carry water in pots on their heads from miles away. He also drank water from a woman's pot. After this, he demanded an SIT investigation of the entire matter from CM Yogi. Actually, on January 30, Brijbhushan Rajput had stopped the convoy of Jal Shakti Minister Swatantra Dev regarding the water problem. During this, about 100 village heads were also with him. After which, the minister had asked for 20 days' time. He had promised that water problems would be resolved. Woman asks MLA, ‘Will you drink water’ BJP MLA Brajbhushan Rajput inspected several villages of the Charkhari assembly on Tuesday at 3 PM. He first reached Naredi village. Here, he spent about 1 hour doing a reality check and gathering information from people. After that, at 4 PM, the MLA reached Salat village. Here, a woman was carrying a water-filled pot on her head and hand. MLA stopped the woman and asked her name. The woman said her name was Gomti. Then, MLA asked where she was coming from with the water. The woman explained that there is no water supply at home. There is a tap about 500 meters away, I'm bringing water from there. The woman asks, ‘Would you like to drink water?’ MLA says, 'Yes, I will definitely drink, it's water earned through hard work'. After that, he drank water from the woman's pot. During this time, departmental officials and concerned contractors were also present. Taps not even connected to pipeline During the MLA's inspection, pipes were found outside many houses, but taps were not installed in the connections. Villagers said that four years have passed since the scheme started, but water has not reached homes till date. Due to a lack of water supply in villages, women still carry water in pots on their heads from miles away. Roads were dug up in many places to lay pipelines, but they were not repaired. This has created a situation of mud and waterlogging on the roads. Seeing the conditions, MLA's temper rose. He scolded the officials and quoted a Bundeli saying "When you hit one, two die, and the third dies of fear." BJP MLA says, ‘Officials are misleading’ MLA Brijbhushan Rajput alleged that departmental officials are giving wrong information to the minister. They are presenting false figures. If people are not getting water even after four years, it is a major failure of the department. According to the MLA, Minister Swatantra Dev had given a 20-day deadline. He had said that the water problems would be resolved. But even after this, conditions did not improve. When water still hadn't reached the villages even after 38 days, I went out to inspect the situation in the villages. Read what happened between Swatantra Dev and the MLA Actually, a month ago, Water Power Minister Swatantra Dev Singh had come on a district tour. During this, MLA Brijbhushan Rajput, along with about 100 village heads, stopped his convoy. They parked 30 cars and 20 bikes in front of the minister's convoy. There was also a clash between MLA supporters and police officers at the spot. The SDM and CO kept trying to explain to the people, but the people were not letting the minister's convoy move forward. Heated argument between the Minister and MLA During this, the MLA told the minister that water has not reached 100 villages in his constituency till date. The roads dug for pipelines have also not been repaired. He said that people from 90 percent of the district's villages demand answers from him. What answer should he give to this? After growing controversy, Minister Swatantra Dev Singh reached the DM office with MLA and village heads, where a meeting was held with DM Gajal Bhardwaj. In the meeting, officials assured to resolve all problems and repair the dug-up roads within 20 days.

stories.title: Shia community takes out 21st Ramzan procession in Lucknow:Protestors step over posters of Trump and Mohammed-Bin-Salman pasted along the route
stories.summary: The 21st Ramzan procession is being taken out in Lucknow today. Members of the Shia community, with tearful eyes, are paying their respects to the coffin of Hazrat Ali. Amid protests over the Iran–Israel conflict, posters of Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman and US President Donald Trump have been placed along the procession route. Devotees participating in the procession are seen chanting “Ya Ali Maula” and “Haider Maula”, while stepping over these posters. Women, men, the elderly, and children, dressed in black and walking barefoot, are gathering in large numbers, trying to touch and kiss the coffin as part of the ritual. The procession begins at the Najaf Imambara and will conclude at the Karbala Talkatora. As per tradition, the coffin will be halted briefly near the well in Haiderganj, where a black sheet will be placed over it. Procession taken out in memory of Hazrat Ali's martyrdom It is believed by the Shia community that on the 19th of Ramadan, when Hazrat Ali reached the mosque for prayers, he was attacked with a sword. After this, on the 21st of Ramadan, Hazrat Ali was martyred. A procession is taken out to remember that incident.

stories.title: 54% of BJP district presidents in UP are upper caste:BJP dominated by upper castes, SP by Muslim-Yadavs, BSP by dalits, and Congress by BPDA
stories.summary: Caste is the biggest equation in Uttar Pradesh politics. Although parties claim to represent all sections of society, when giving organizational responsibilities, their trust still rests on their core vote bank. Looking at the appointments of district presidents, the BJP has given 54% responsibility to upper castes, the SP has 70% Muslim-Yadav, and the BSP has 92% Dalits. Meanwhile, in Congress, 84% of faces from Brahmin-Backward-Dalit-Minority (BPDA) classes are handling the organization's command. What is the caste strategy of parties in UP politics? Read in this report... Experts say Parties need trustworthy people BHU Prof. T.P. Singh says, ‘All parties need trustworthy people in the organization’. People who can strongly convey the party's agenda to the general public. This is why most parties give priority to people connected with their core vote bank when appointing district presidents. Senior journalist Ratanmani Lal also agrees with this. He says that UP is a boiling cauldron of caste equations. Politics here is impossible without caste. Although parties may talk about serving all sections of society, every party has its own core vote bank. BJP announces 95 district presidents, 54% are Brahmin-Thakur BJP has divided the state organization into 98 districts. The process of appointing district presidents has been ongoing for about a year. On March 16, 2025, BJP announced the names of 70 district presidents. After this, 14 district presidents were announced in November 2025 and 11 in February 2026. Thus, the party has so far appointed a total of 95 district presidents. BJP's aversion to Muslims-Christians In appointing district presidents, the BJP has given special attention to upper castes along with non-Yadav OBCs and non-Jatav Dalits. Among the upper castes, Brahmins and Thakurs have received the most representation. Meanwhile, in OBCs, Kurmi, Maurya, Lodh, Nishad, and other extremely backward castes have been given positions in the organization. This is the same social equation that has given the BJP a continuous electoral advantage in Uttar Pradesh since 2014. Among the BJP's 95 district presidents, 51 (54%) are upper caste, 35 (36%) are OBC, and 9 (10%) are Dalit. In the general category, there are a maximum of 25 Brahmins, 14 Thakurs, 6 Vaishyas, 5 Kayasthas, and one Bhumihar. Meanwhile, in the OBC category, the Kurmi, Lodh, Maurya, Kushwaha, and Shakya communities have the highest representation. Among these, 6 Kurmi, 4 Lodh, and 6 Maurya-Kushwaha-Shakya community members have been made district presidents. Additionally, there are 4 district presidents from the Nishad community and 2 from the Yadav community. 12 district presidents have also been appointed from extremely backward castes, including Saini, Mali, Pal, Gadaria, and other communities. Similarly, in the Dalit category, the BJP has given district president responsibilities to 4 Pasi, 2 Kori, 1 Dhobi, 1 Katheria, and 2 leaders from other communities. 70% Muslim-Yadav among SP District Presidents Although SP may be raising the slogan of PDA (Backward, Dalit, Minority) dreaming of returning to power in the state, but in the appointment of district presidents, their trust still appears to be on the Muslim-Yadav (MY) equation. The Yadav population in the state is considered to be around 8-9%, but SP has given adequate representation to this core vote bank in the organization. Out of the current 95 district presidents, 42 are Yadavs, which is approximately 44%, and in second place are 24 Muslim district presidents. Meanwhile, although the Dalit population in the state is considered to be around 20-21%, SP has appointed only 3 Dalit leaders as district presidents. Congress relies on BPDA, highest stake on extremely backward classes UP Congress released a list of 134 district presidents on March 20, 2025. Through this, an attempt was made to rebuild the organization across the state. In the appointment of district presidents, Congress has given priority to the BPDA (Brahmin, Backward, Dalit, and Minority) formula. In Uttar Pradesh, Congress once remained in power for a long time with strong support from Brahmin, Muslim, and Dalit vote banks. However, in the 1990s, with the rise of Mandal-Kamandal politics, this core vote bank gradually moved away from it. In this situation, Congress has tried to cultivate its traditional social base again through the appointment of district presidents. Among Congress district presidents, there are 33 OBCs, 32 Muslims, 27 Brahmins, 19 Dalits, and 1 Tribal. According to senior journalist Suresh Bahadur Singh, the Congress has tried to maintain caste balance in its list of district presidents. The party has appointed 48 OBC leaders, including 15 Pasmanda Muslims, who are considered a large and socially backward section within the Muslim community. In contrast, the BSP’s list of district presidents still shows strong reliance on Dalit leaders, especially from the Jatav community, which forms a major part of the state’s Dalit population. Out of 75 BSP district presidents, only six belong to OBC communities such as Nishad, Kushwaha, Gadariya, Lodhi, Gurjar, and Kashyap. Women’s representation remains very low across parties. The BJP has appointed 8 women among its 95 district presidents, Congress has four among 134, while the SP and BSP have not appointed any women district presidents. Overall, only 12 women are among the 399 district presidents across the four major parties.

stories.title: 'Ultimatum given to Yogi, not CM':Dy CM should refute Ashutosh's statements if they both are not complicit, says Shankaracharya
stories.summary: “He may remain the Chief Minister, but we question actions against dharma,” says Shankaracharya Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand made these remarks after arriving in Lucknow while speaking to Dainik Bhaskar. Referring to the 40-day ultimatum given to Yogi Adityanath, he said the time was given to Yogi as an individual, not to the Chief Minister’s post. He added that if someone who has strayed returns to the right path, it is welcome. On allegations by Ashutosh Maharaj of a possible understanding with the Deputy Chief Minister, the Shankaracharya said the Deputy CM did not deny the claims made by a history-sheeter, which raises questions about possible collusion. Speaking about the Go-Pratishtha Dharmayudh Shankhnad Yatra, he said the aim is to make their position clear before political leaders. According to him, those who support cow protection and those accused of harming cows will be treated differently. He added that people expect leaders to be the same in their actions as they appear in public. Read Shankaracharya's verbatim interview... Question. Ashutosh Maharaj is saying this whole drama is created to capture CM Yogi's chair? Shankaracharya. He (Ashutosh) has been left free to spread confusion among the public. Neither is anyone denying it, nor accepting it. How appropriate is this? A criminal can spread confusion. The government should come forward and end this matter. Question. You are asked to come to Lucknow and protest. Will you drink water only when I come? Shankaracharya. A history-sheeter is continuously giving one statement after another. In this, he is clearly taking the name of the Deputy Chief Minister as well. The Deputy Chief Minister is not taking any action. Either he should say that yes, we had such a conversation. Then we will deny that no such conversation took place. Now, if the Deputy Chief Minister is not denying his statement, it means that he is deliberately making him speak. Otherwise, how could he lie by taking someone's name? This means that both are in collusion. Question. Ashutosh Maharaj said that you are preparing to flee abroad under the pretext of Go-Pratishtha Yatra? Shankaracharya. How is he even among Hindus? He doesn't know anything about the Shankaracharya tradition. Those who are Shankaracharya never travel abroad. When we haven't even made a passport, how will we get a visa and go abroad? He doesn't know, that's why he's saying anything. Question. Ashutosh Maharaj has accused you of having a secret wife. What do you say? Shankaracharya. When a person stoops to lowliness, there is no limit. Then they say anything. Question. If wrongdoing happened with Batuk in 2024, why is the issue being raised after 2 years? Shankaracharya. This 2-year story is also imaginary. The truth is that he never went there. On the dates he has made allegations, we were not there. When they had to make up a story, they made up anything. All the evidence for this has been presented in court. Question. Why did Ashutosh make such serious allegations against you? Does he have any enmity with you? Shankaracharya. To have enmity or friendship with someone, you need to be acquainted with them. There needs to be some self-interest between them and you. This person is neither known to us, nor have we ever worked with him. We have no dealings whatsoever. When such a person continuously makes allegations, there can be only two assumptions. First- Someone else is behind him; he is just a pawn. Second- he is using us as a stepping stone for publicity, thinking he will become famous by climbing our ladder. Question. Did you give Yogi 40 days to prove himself as a Hindu? Shankaracharya. We haven't given any ultimatum to CM. We have given it to Yogi Adityanath. Since Adityanath wears saffron clothes, he comes under our religious jurisdiction. As Shankaracharya, all saints and mahants come under us. It is our right to question them. That's why we asked how you can conduct a meat business while wearing saffron clothes? You left home and parents, so how can you work for a salary? These are the questions we have asked. Question. Has the Magh Mela fight become personal? Is the entire Sanatan Dharma being criticised because of it? Shankaracharya. First thing, the fight didn't start with Magh Mela. A fight...is fought from both sides. This was a one-sided attack. This wasn't an attack on any individual but on the self-respect of the Sanatani people. Therefore, all symbols of the Sanatani people, whether they are sanyasis, brahmacharis, Shankaracharya's umbrella, or a Batuk's tuft. This means it was an attempt to destroy Sanatan's self-respect. The attempts continue till today. Till today, no one has admitted any mistake. Till today, arrogance is being displayed by supporting the same. Question. In recent years, one after another Shankaracharya has been upset with Modi and Yogi government? Shankaracharya. This would be called ironic. If it were Mughal, British or any non-religious rule, it would be understandable. When it's a government formed by our own votes, especially a government that calls itself Hindu. If in such a government, beef exports keep increasing, the cow population keeps decreasing. Then what should we say? Question. Is this a fight to become the supreme and most revered of Sanatan? Shankaracharya. The Chief Minister's position is political; Shankaracharya's position is religious. When national festivals like August 15 or January 26 are celebrated, the country's people participate in them. The President, Prime Minister, and Chief Minister attend there. Do they come like common people, you tell me. They have a special way of coming. Do all people appear equal there? When there is no uniform protocol in your national festivals, then why shouldn't there be a protocol for Shankaracharya in the Magh Mela, which is a religious event? If that's not the case, then the Prime Minister and Chief Minister should also start mingling with the public. They won't do it, but they'll make such arguments for us. Question. Who all are coming to the Lucknow event? Shankaracharya. This is not an event where someone is a guest. This is the battle cry for the protection of the mother cow that is beginning. Whoever has devotion for the mother cow will come and stand there and blow the conch. What's happening is that for 78 years, every party, every leader says they are cow devotees and will absolutely protect cows. Yet nothing happens after that. On one side, they show pictures of worshipping cows; on the other side, data comes out about how much beef is exported. This way, everyone remains in illusion.

stories.title: Navy personnel turns out to be Pakistan spy:UP ATS catches Agra man; was sending pictures of Indian warships to ISI
stories.summary: UP ATS has caught a Pakistani spy from Agra. The accused is a Navy personnel in the Indian Navy. He was spying for Pakistan's intelligence agency ISI (Inter-Services Intelligence). The accused sent pictures and details of the country's warships to the ISI agent. This was confirmed by documents found in his possession. The Navy personnel had also transferred money to the ISI agent from his bank account. ATS has arrested the accused from Kagarol in Agra. Navy personnel Lucky was posted in Kerala Accused Navy personnel Adarsh Kumar alias Lucky is a resident of Chitpur village in the Kagaraul police station area of Agra. He was currently posted at Southern Naval Command, Kochi (Kerala). ATS had been receiving information for quite some time that Lucky was sending important information about India to the Pakistani agency ISI. Lucky was arrested on Tuesday. He was interrogated. Electronic gadgets were examined, which confirmed him being a spy. The investigation also revealed that Lucky had sent money to ISI agents from his bank account. Along with this, highly sensitive information was shared. ATS arrested the accused and presented him in court, from where he was sent to judicial custody. Agencies are now also investigating whether there are any other people involved in this espionage network. So did Lucky fall victim to honeytrap like Ravindra? Pakistani intelligence agency often engages in espionage by trapping people in a honeytrap. A year ago, ATS had caught Ravindra Kumar from Agra on charges of espionage. He had come in contact with a woman named Neha Sharma through Facebook. Ravindra Kumar was sending confidential documents of the Ordnance Factory to a woman working for ISI. It contained confidential letters from the screening committee regarding drones, the Gaganyaan project, and other classified information. The agency suspects that Navy personnel, Lucky, was also a victim of a honeytrap. Investigation is ongoing. When were spies caught from Agra? March 14, 2025: Ravindra Kumar (Ordnance Factory Employee) Caught by: UP ATS Charges: Sending defense-related confidential information after falling into the honeytrap of a Pakistani woman handler. March 14, 2025: An associate of Ravindra Kumar is also in custody Charge: Helping share sensitive information with the ISI handler. September 27, 2023: Shailesh Kumar Arrested by: UP ATS Charge: Contacting the ISI handler through Facebook and sharing information about army activities. Common pattern in all cases - Most cases involve contact through social media (Facebook/WhatsApp) - Many cases involve honeytraps or financial incentives - Targets are often defense establishment employees or people with access to sensitive information

stories.summary: UP ATS Arrested Indian Navy Lance Naik: उत्तर प्रदेश की एंटी टेररिस्ट स्क्वॉड (ATS) ने एक ऐसे मामले का खुलासा किया है जिसने सुरक्षा एजेंसियों की चिंता बढ़ा दी है। आरोप है कि भारतीय नौसेना में तैनात एक जवान पाकिस्तान की खुफिया एजेंसी आईएसआई के लिए जासूसी कर रहा था। एटीएस ने आगरा से उसे गिरफ्तार कर लिया है और फिलहाल उसे जेल भेज दिया गया है। गिरफ्तार किए गए आरोपी की पहचान आदर्श कुमार उर्फ लकी के रूप में हुई है। वह भारतीय नौसेना में लांस नायक के पद पर तैनात था और केरल के कोच्चि स्थित दक्षिणी नेवल कमांड में उसकी पोस्टिंग बताई जा रही है। जांच एजेंसियों के मुताबिक आदर्श पर आरोप है कि वह रणनीतिक रूप से बेहद संवेदनशील युद्धपोतों और नौसेना से जुड़ी जानकारी की तस्वीरें आईएसआई तक पहुंचा रहा था। शुरुआती जांच में यह भी सामने आया है कि इसके बदले उसके बैंक खाते में पैसे ट्रांसफर किए गए थे।

stories.title: UP Evening Wrap:Oppn moves no-confidence motion against LS Speaker; UP clears cashless health insurance for teachers more
stories.summary: Bhaskar English brings you the biggest news from Uttar Pradesh and around the world. Here are the top news headlines of the day: 1. Opposition moves no-confidence motion against LS Speaker Birla The Lok Sabha on Tuesday admitted a no-confidence motion seeking the removal of Speaker Om Birla after more than 50 MPs supported the proposal. The motion was allowed by the Chair and will be debated for 10 hours. 2. UP Cabinet clears 30 proposals: Land registration to need verification; bus service planned for 12,200 villages In Lucknow, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath chaired a Uttar Pradesh Cabinet meeting on Tuesday, where 31 proposals were presented and 30 approved. The most significant decision was aimed at preventing fake land registries. 3. Unofficial halt on commercial LPG cylinder supply in UP: Domestic demand surges A major crisis regarding cooking gas (LPG) has emerged in Uttar Pradesh. Oil companies have imposed an unofficial halt on the delivery of commercial gas cylinders due to declining stock levels. 4. SC says time to implement UCC, asks Parliament to decide The Supreme Court said on Tuesday that the time has come to implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) in the country. The court was hearing a petition seeking to strike down certain sections of the Shariat Act 1937, alleging discrimination against Muslim women. 5. Kanpur celebrates 85-year-old Ganga fair with grand holi procession, Muslims welcome Hindus with flowers Today, on Tuesday, there is a Ganga fair in Kanpur where Holi is being celebrated. SP MLA Amitabh Bajpai, drenched in colors, danced enthusiastically with people. 6. Shankaracharya says, 'Yogi's mother is our mother': Maulana's statements are highly objectionable Amid the ongoing conflict with CM Yogi, Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand expressed strong displeasure over objectionable remarks made against the Chief Minister’s mother. 7. Supply of Commercial LPG cylinders halted in 8 states The central government has implemented the Essential Commodities Act 1955 across the country. This step was taken after gas supplies through the Strait of Hormuz were disrupted. 8. Emergency landing of Maurya's helicopter raises questions: In service for 18 years Deputy CM Keshav Maurya’s helicopter, which made an emergency landing at Lucknow airport on March 7, has been in service for 18 years. Moreover, it hasn't been repaired for 3 years. Civil Aviation Department officials provided this information to Dainik Bhaskar. 9. IAS interview panel asks, 'Will bulldozer justice aid economic growth?': What would you write in the President’s speech? More than 50 candidates from UP succeeded in the UPSC-2025 final results. Surbhi Yadav from Amroha secured 14th rank, Monica Srivastava from Ballia got 16th rank, Vijay Mudgal from Aligarh ranked 54th and Harsh Nehra from Meerut secured 74th rank. 10. BCCI announces ₹131 cr cash reward for Team India The Board of Control for Cricket in India has announced a massive cash reward of ₹131 crore for India national cricket team after their outstanding performance in the ICC Men's T20 World Cup 2026.

stories.title: Rinku Singh's emotional note for late father after WC win:Indian cricketer says, 'field par bas aapka sapna poora karne ki koshish kar raha tha'
stories.summary: Indian cricketer Rinku Singh made an emotional post for his late father, Khanchand Singh, after winning the T20 World Cup 2026. India won the title by defeating New Zealand by 96 runs in the final on Sunday. This match was played in Ahmedabad. Rinku Singh's father passed away on 27 February during the T20 World Cup. He had been battling stage-4 liver cancer for a long time. After attending his father's funeral, Rinku rejoined the team for the tournament. Rinku Singh pens emotional note for father Taking to Instagram, the Indian cricketer shared a note for his father. Sharing a photo of him alongside his father, Rinku wrote, “Aapse baat kiye bina itne din kabhi nahi nikale. Mujhe nahi pata aage ki zindagi aapke bina kaise chalegi… par mujhe har kadam par aapki zaroorat padegi.” (Never spent so many days without talking to you. I don't know how life will go on without you, but I will need you at every step). Rinku further recalled his father's advice and said that he was living out his dream on the field after rejoining Team India in T20 World Cup. "Aapne sikhaya tha ki farz sabse aage hai.. toh field par bas aapka sapna poora karne ki koshish kar raha tha. Ab aapka sapna pura ho gaya hai…. toh bas yahi lagta hai ki kash aap mere paas hote. Har chhoti badi khushi mein aapki kami khalegi. Bohot miss karunga aapko Papa... bohot zyada. (You taught me that duty comes first, so I was trying to fulfill only your dream on the field. Your dream has been fulfilled and I wish you were here. I am going to miss you a lot, Papa.) Rinku had met ailing father during T20 World Cup Rinku's father, Khanchand Singh had been battling liver cancer for a long time. It was stage four cancer. Last month, his condition became very critical. Rinku had gone home to meet his father during the tournament. But on 27 February, his father passed away at a hospital in Greater Noida. Rinku attended the last rites and then returned to the team. Rinku Singh's fiance lauds his courage for playing T20 WC after father's demise Rinku's fiance and Samajwadi Party MP Priya Saroj lauded him for his mental strength after he opted to play the remainder of T20 World Cup following his father's demise. “Amidst this historic victory, I also saw the strength of a son standing tall for his father, his team and his nation. To play through one of the hardest moments of your life and still come out a champion takes a different kind of courage,” a part of her note on Instagram, read. Rinku Singh played five matches in T20 WC Rinku Singh played five matches in the T20 World Cup, scoring 24 runs while having a strike-rate of 82.75. Even when he was not part of the playing XI, Rinku made an impact on the field by coming on as a substitute fielder on a number of occasions. He took five matches in the five matches in the tournament.

stories.title: Ashutosh Brahmachari injured in train attack sparks controversy:Police begin probe after he alleges Avimukteshwaranand conspiracy; fake Facebook ID claims responsibility
stories.summary: Ashutosh Brahmachari, who had filed a sexual harassment case against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand involving two young students, was attacked on a train on Monday. He suffered injuries to his nose and left hand. Ashutosh said the attack was part of a conspiracy linked to Avimukteshwaranand. Police have registered a case against an unknown person. A few hours later, Dr Swati Aghori claimed responsibility for the attack on Facebook, where her profile described her as the 'National President of Kaal Bhairav Yuva Vahini'. Meanwhile, Avimukteshwaranand, who is on a pilgrimage, said in Raebareli- This is all a show. Ashutosh is saying this to create an atmosphere and get security. He is trying to divert attention from my journey. GRP CO Arun Kumar Pathak says - After the attack on Ashutosh Maharaj, CCTV footage has been reviewed in Sirathu and Prayagraj. Four passengers sitting near Ashutosh Maharaj have also been questioned. For security reasons, the statements cannot be made public. No one saw Ashutosh Maharaj's attacker. Now questions are being raised as to why Avimukteshwaranand is calling this attack false? Who is this Dr. Swati Aghori? What happened to the accused in the previous attacks on Ashutosh? Dainik Bhaskar found the answers to these questions. Let's know everything one by one. First, let's understand the attack and the questions raised Why is Ashutosh Brahmachari in discussion? Ashutosh Brahmachari's real name is Ashutosh Pandey. Ashutosh hails from Kandhla town, about 20 km from Shamli district headquarters. Ashutosh identifies himself as the president of the Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Mukti Nirman Trust. These days, Ashutosh is in discussion because he presented two young boys in court, and based on their statements, a case was filed under the POCSO Act against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand and his disciple Mukundanand. Attack outside First AC, Allegation - Done at Avimukteshwaranand's behest On March 7, at 10:30 PM, Ashutosh Pandey boarded the AC-First Class coach of the Rewa Express train from Ghaziabad railway station. The train was scheduled to reach Prayagraj in the morning. Ashutosh says - In the morning, the train reached Sirathu station in Kaushambi district. I was going to the toilet, a man was standing outside the gate, as I moved forward, he attacked me from behind. He tried to cut my nose with a sharp weapon. Besides my face, he also attacked my hand. Ashutosh further said - The person who attacked me came at the behest of Avimukteshwaranand. He was saying that I have sworn to cut off your nose and offer it at Guruji's feet. He was supposed to get 21 lakh rupees for cutting off my nose. The attacker was calling Avimukteshwaranand his guru. These people do not want me to be able to go to court with evidence against them. I have filed a lawsuit in the Prayagraj Special POCSO Court, demanding to stop the Shankaracharya's cow journey. 3 questions that are complicating Ashutosh Maharaj's case Bhaskar understood the cases of those against whom Ashutosh Maharaj filed FIRs Case 1. Accused Ashutosh Parashar Threatened to withdraw the case filed against Avimukteshwaranand Ashutosh Maharaj has been attacked many times before. He has filed complaints with the police at different times. After a POCSO case was registered against Avimukteshwaranand, he was going home. According to Ashutosh, on the way, Suraj Parashar met him with 5-6 companions and pressured him to withdraw the case. They tried to abduct the minor children who were with me and tried to kill me. Ashutosh has filed a case against Suraj and his companions at Kandhla police station. Suraj says - no evidence, only allegations On this, Suraj Parashar said over the phone - the police are investigating against us, but they have not found any evidence yet. The allegations made against us are false, we don't have much more to say. Case 2. Accused Tanveer Ahmed First filed a case, then said Tanveer, you are a friend On August 8, 2025, Ashutosh filed a case against Tanveer Ahmed, Mohit Sharma, and Afzal Ahmed, all from Kandhla. He alleged that these people set his car on fire by throwing a petrol bomb. There were 7 lakh rupees in the car. These people can get me killed. I am receiving threats from Pakistani terrorists to blow me up with a bomb. I should be provided security. He said - I had written to the SP but I was not provided security. Tanveer says - The allegations Ashutosh Maharaj made against me were rejected by the SSP sir, because there was no evidence. Then he apologized to me. He said that I would not file a case against Muslims, you are my brother. But a few days later, he filed another case against me through his sister-in-law Pratibha. In that, he was accused of threatening. Whereas I don't even know his sister-in-law, so I didn't even get bail. I will go to the High Court and get this case quashed. Case 3. Accused Mohit Case against 11 people including me, 10 were cleared in investigation Ashutosh Maharaj had filed a case against Mohit for threatening to kill him. Additionally, an FIR was filed against Mohit under the SC-ST Act. Actually, Pratibha alias Simran, wife of Ashutosh's brother Vineet Sharma, belongs to the Dalit community. She has so far filed cases under the SC-ST Act and for attempted rape against more than 20 people. Mohit said - I got a stay from the court Mohit says - A case was filed against me and 11 other people under the SC-ST Act. Saharanpur CO investigated. 10 people were excluded from the case. They dropped the charges against me and my brother. When the incident was reported, my brother was in Delhi. I went to court and got a stay. There was no incident at the place shown as the scene of the incident. I took affidavits from 30 people there, all of whom gave statements in our favor. We asked why Ashutosh Maharaj filed a case against you then? Mohit says - I am a journalist by profession. Mathura police came to this very police station; they had to paste a notice in front of Ashutosh's house. They needed someone who could take its picture and run the news. I went myself. I had neither friendship nor enmity with Ashutosh. I published the news. From that day, he started harassing me. They had filed one case alleging a connection with Pakistan and burning a car, but no evidence was found in it. The police had filed an FR (case closed). Case 4. Accused Tarun Agrawal Threat on phone, apprehension of murder On October 27, 2021, a case was registered against Mukesh Verma and Utsav Verma under SC-ST Act by Ashutosh's sister-in-law. On September 2, 2021, a case was registered against Ramkumar and Shyam Kumar. On August 5, 2021, a case was registered against Mukesh Sharma for rape threat and under the SC-ST Act. On September 10, 2019, Ashutosh filed a case against Rajan expressing apprehension of his murder. On October 23, 2018, a case of murder threat was filed against another person. Tarun Agarwal of Kandhla says- Ashutosh has filed similar cases against more than 100 people. The police do not find evidence in most cases. Later, they close the case. Ashutosh Maharaj himself has 27 cases registered against him. He has created fake trusts and tried to grab land. A case of crime like cow smuggling is registered. The attack he is currently reporting also seems fabricated. Question: Is all this happening for government security? Talking to different people in Kandhla made it clear that Ashutosh Maharaj has tried many times for government security. A case was filed against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand, then the court stayed his arrest. Ashutosh came out of court crying in front of the media. He says - my life is in danger, I can be murdered. I had asked the police administration for security, but I am not getting it. Ashutosh had also announced that he was now dropping the case related to the Batuks. We don't have big lawyers, nor enough money to fight them. Regarding security, Mohit Sharma, a journalist from Kandhla, says- Ashutosh Maharaj had written letters to the SP several times for security. The LIU contacted journalists here. We told them that he had filed false cases against many people. The police had also closed most of the cases. LIU personnel asked us, and we provided several such instances, after which he did not get security. The old story of security seems to be behind the current attack as well. After the attack on Ashutosh Maharaj in a moving train, Swami Avimukteshwaranand said- He was attacked on the train. The central government should investigate. The UP government should provide him security, so that he can submit the evidence he was going to submit in court. We absolutely do not want any evidence against us to be withheld.

stories.title: UP Cabinet clears 30 proposals:Land registration to need verification; bus service planned for 12,200 villages, Ola–Uber regulation approved
stories.summary: In Lucknow, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath chaired a Uttar Pradesh Cabinet meeting on Tuesday, where 31 proposals were presented and 30 approved. The most significant decision was aimed at preventing fake land registries. Stamp and Registration Minister Ravindra Jaiswal said that land registration in Uttar Pradesh will now be allowed only after verification of land records and documents. He said the move will help curb fraudulent registrations, protect the savings of common citizens and deal a major blow to land mafia syndicates operating in the state. Village transport scheme approved Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh said the Cabinet has approved the Chief Minister Village Transport Scheme, which aims to provide direct bus connectivity to 12,200 villages across the state. The scheme is expected to benefit students, farmers and patients who travel to cities for education, markets and healthcare. He also said that ride-hailing platforms like Ola and Uber will now come under state government regulation. These companies will have to register with the transport department. Their vehicles will not be allowed to operate without medical checks, police verification and fitness certification, and full details of the vehicles will be integrated into the official app. How the scheme will work The minister said private operators running buses in villages will not need permits, and they will also be exempt from paying transport tax. Operators will have the option to run services independently or provide buses to state roadways on contract. Under the plan, a bus will depart from a village at 6 am, travel through 15–20 villages and nearby block headquarters, and reach the district headquarters by 10 am. The bus will then leave the district headquarters at 4 pm and return via the same route, reaching the originating village by 8 pm. The facility will make it easier for villagers to transport crops to block and district headquarters, while also helping students, farmers and women commute more easily. The fare will be decided by a committee headed by the District Magistrate. Major decision for government employees The Cabinet also approved a proposal from the Personnel Department concerning government employees. Finance Minister Suresh Khanna said that if a government employee invests an amount equal to six months’ basic salary in the stock market, they will now have to inform the authorised officer. Similarly, if an employee purchases movable property worth more than two months’ salary—such as a car or gold—they will be required to report it. The move aims to increase transparency and curb corruption. Cashless health insurance for teachers The Cabinet has also approved cashless health insurance up to ₹5 lakh for teachers working in aided degree colleges under the Higher Education Department. Higher Education Minister Yogendra Upadhyay said the scheme will benefit regular as well as self-financed course teachers in aided colleges. Teachers of private colleges and state universities will also be covered. According to the government, 1,28,725 teachers are expected to benefit from the scheme. Major proposals passed
