stories.title: Commercial gas cylinder supply halted in Uttarakhand:Only hospitals and educational institutions to receive, panic booking started
stories.summary: The supply of commercial gas cylinders has currently been suspended in Uttarakhand. PS Pangti, Additional Commissioner of the Supply Department, stated that due to insufficient supply, the distribution of commercial cylinders has been temporarily halted. He explained that the ongoing war situation has affected the supply of commercial gas cylinders from the main source itself. Considering the shortage of stock, its supply has been stopped for now. However, essential services will not be affected. According to the Supply Department, commercial gas cylinders are being provided only to hospitals and educational institutions from the available stock. Panic bookings rise among residents Following news of the halt, residents in many parts of the state have begun making panic bookings. The temporary shortage has created concern among households and businesses alike. Business difficulties escalate The closure of commercial gas supply is expected to increase challenges for hotel, dhaba, and restaurant owners. Raman Chaddha, a member of the Restaurant Association in Dehradun, stated that while there is a current shortage, hotels and restaurants are still managing with the existing stock. He added that operations will continue until the stock runs out, but if the government completely stops supplying gas, closure of some establishments may become inevitable. Induction and alternative cooking methods are being employed to manage operations temporarily. If the situation persists, the state’s tourism and hospitality sector could suffer significantly, making cooking in dhabas, restaurants, and hotels difficult, affecting both residents and tourists. Understanding the Essential Commodities Act The Essential Commodities Act of 1955 empowers the government to control the supply and pricing of essential goods such as grains, pulses, edible oils, medicines, and fuel. Commonly referred to as the anti-hoarding law, it allows the government to set stock limits for traders to prevent hoarding and price manipulation during shortages. 4 gas categories after act implementation Government measures to tackle the crisis Gas price hike amid shortage fears Domestic LPG cylinders were increased by ₹60 three days ago. In Delhi, a 14.2 kg cylinder now costs ₹913, up from ₹853. Commercial 19 kg cylinders increased by ₹115, reaching ₹1,883. Previous hikes occurred on April 8, 2025, and March 1, 2026. The price increases coincide with fears of a gas shortage due to the ongoing US-Israel–Iran conflict. When will the situation improve? K.M. Thakur, Chief General Manager (LPG) at Indian Oil, urged customers not to panic or make panic bookings. The government is exploring alternative imports from countries like the United States. At an international level, G7 countries are discussing releasing emergency oil reserves to mitigate the energy crisis. Additional crude oil is also expected from Russia and Algeria, which could stabilise the situation in the coming weeks.

stories.title: Air Force personnel acquitted after 7 years in molestation case:Sister-in-law tells judge alleged assault happened in dream; family filed complaint due to confusion
stories.summary: The Air Force personnel facing molestation charges with his minor sister-in-law has been acquitted by the special judge after 7 years. This was based on the same sister-in-law's statement, who had accused her brother-in-law of grabbing her while sleeping and molesting her. The sister-in-law later testified in court that her brother-in-law didn't actually molest her, but it happened in a dream. She had been confused, and her father had filed a report at Naubasta police station. However, due to the earlier statement, the Air Force personnel had to spend 19 days in jail. The Air Force personnel from Bithoor married a woman from Bidhnu on February 10, 2019. On February 13, when the Air Force personnel went to his in-laws' house for the fourth day ceremony to bring his wife, his 15-year-old sister-in-law also came with them. According to the report, on March 8 at 9 PM, the teenager started screaming loudly. When her elder sister reached the room, the teenager accused her brother-in-law of molesting her and grabbing her. On this, the elder sister called the police on Dial-100. The allegation is that the Air Force personnel fled with his father after locking him up. This incident was reported at Naubasta police station about five months later, based on the father's complaint. In the case, senior advocate Karim Ahmad Siddiqui said that the victim testified in court that the harassment occurred in a dream, not in reality. The victim's father and elder sister also admitted in court that they filed the case due to confusion. After this, the court acquitted the Air Force personnel. He is currently posted as a Corporal in Pune. Victim said - felt in dream that brother-in-law grabbed her Advocate Karim Ahmad Siddiqui said that the victim recorded her statement in court in December 2021. In her statements to the court, she said that 'it was nine o'clock at night. I was sleeping after taking the antibiotic medicine. The medicine is intoxicating, so I was half asleep. In the dream, it felt like my brother-in-law grabbed me... Then I made noise. My sister came, and I went to the hospital. This was a dream, it wasn't real.' Charges determined on four points Based on the victim's father's complaint, Naubasta police registered a case against the Air Force personnel on August 3, 2019. Police arrested and sent him to jail on September 29. After spending 19 days in jail, he got bail on October 17. On October 6, Inspector Jitendra Pratap Singh, posted at Naubasta police station, filed a chargesheet based on the victim's statements. Advocate Kareem Ahmad said that charges were framed against the Air Force personnel in the Special Judge POCSO court on November 13, 2019. These charges were determined on four points. First was assaulting the victim, second was defaming her, third was molesting her, and fourth was sexually assaulting the victim.

stories.summary: Several flights at Lucknow's Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport saw sudden schedule changes on Tuesday. Some flights had to be completely cancelled, while many flights arrived or departed later than their scheduled time. Due to this, passengers faced considerable inconvenience at the airport. Many people were seen waiting for their flights since morning. Multiple flights from Gulf countries cancelled Speaking of incoming flights at the airport, several flights from Gulf countries were cancelled. IndiGo flight 6E-1416 from Abu Dhabi to Lucknow was scheduled to arrive at 6:05 AM, but it was cancelled. Similarly, IndiGo flight 6E-1424 from Sharjah could not arrive at its scheduled time of 7:05 AM and was also cancelled. Air India Express flight IX-194 from Dubai, which was scheduled to arrive in Lucknow at 11:30 AM, was also cancelled. Additionally, IndiGo flight 6E-098 from Dammam was scheduled to arrive at 8 PM, but this flight was also cancelled. Some flights arrived late While many flights were cancelled, some flights arrived late in Lucknow. FlyDubai flight FZ-443 from Dubai was scheduled to arrive at 10:50 AM, but it reached the airport around 11:28 AM. Akasa Air flight QP-1524 from Mumbai also arrived later than scheduled. This flight arrived in Lucknow at 11:28 AM instead of 10:55 AM. Additionally, Air India flight AI-2491 from Mumbai also arrived in Lucknow with approximately half an hour's delay. Departing flights also affected The schedule of flights departing from Lucknow was also affected. Air India Express flight IX-193 to Dubai, which was scheduled to take off at 1:05 AM, was cancelled. Similarly, IndiGo flight 6E-1415 to Abu Dhabi, 6E-097 to Dammam, and 6E-1423 to Sharjah also had to be cancelled. However, IndiGo flight 6E-6968 to Ahmedabad was not completely cancelled, but it departed about 25 minutes late.

stories.title: Kanpur celebrates 85-year-old Ganga fair with grand holi procession:Muslims welcome Hindus with flowers; revelers ride camels and tractors
stories.summary: Today, on Tuesday, there is a Ganga fair in Kanpur where Holi is being celebrated. SP MLA Amitabh Bajpai, drenched in colors, danced enthusiastically with people. On Meston Road, Muslims welcomed Hindus by showering flowers. They also garlanded them. Revelers have come out riding on tractor trolleys and camels. Colors and gulal are being showered abundantly. The revelers will cover a distance of 7 km in six hours while dancing, singing, and playing with colors. This time, colors were not distributed from the buffalo cart. Committee president Gyanendra Bishnoi said, ‘This time we tried hard to find a buffalo cart’. We were ready to pay the asking price, but couldn't find a buffalo cart. Therefore, this time, drums of colors will be carried on tractor trolleys. Along with this, there will be 6 camels, 5 horses, 8 tractors, and several loader vehicles. Colors are also being sprayed through water guns. This tradition has been continuing for the past 85 years. This is the only Holi that began after the national anthem. The District Magistrate and police officers started Holi by hoisting the tricolor at Rajjan Babu Park. Flowers were also offered at the inscription of revolutionaries. The history of this special Holi in Kanpur is linked to British rule in 1942, when 47 revolutionaries from Kanpur were imprisoned. After playing with colors during the day, a children's fair will be organized by the fair committee in the evening. It will have swings for children, food stalls, and fireworks. The color cart is moving through these routes: The color cart will start from Rajjan Babu Park and pass through major markets and routes of the city. This cart will pass through Soot Bazaar, Generalganj, Bajaj Bazaar, Maniram Bagia, Gaya Prasad Lane, Meston Road, Chowk, Topi Bazaar, Sarafa Bazaar, Kotwali Crossing, Sangam Lal Temple, Kamla Tower, Philkhana, Birhana Road, Nayaganj Crossing, Puran Pan Wala, Kahukothi, Satrangi Mohalla, Sirki Mohalla, and Lathi Mohalla before returning to Rajjan Babu Park in Hatia via Generalganj, where the program will conclude.

stories.title: Unofficial halt on commercial LPG cylinder supply in UP:Domestic demand surges, delivery delays reported in many cities
stories.summary: A major crisis regarding cooking gas (LPG) has emerged in Uttar Pradesh. Oil companies have imposed an unofficial halt on the delivery of commercial gas cylinders due to declining stock levels. Agencies have currently been instructed to focus only on the supply of domestic gas cylinders. This move has had a direct impact on hotel, restaurant and dhaba operators, who are struggling to obtain commercial cylinders. Meanwhile, the situation has created a sense of concern among the general public as well. In several cities, the demand for domestic cylinders has suddenly increased. In places including Lucknow, Kanpur, Prayagraj, Varanasi and Gorakhpur, cylinders are not being delivered even 4 to 5 days after booking. Long queues have started forming outside gas agencies, with people expressing frustration over not receiving cylinders on time. See Pictures- Residents compare situation to decades-old shortages People standing in queues outside a gas agency in Gorakhpur said that obtaining a gas cylinder has suddenly become difficult. Some residents said they have been waiting in line for the past two to three days. They added that the situation now resembles conditions from 15–20 years ago, when people had to wait for months to receive a gas cylinder. However, officials have said there is no need for panic. Lucknow District Supply Officer Vijay Pratap Singh said that there is currently no situation of shortage. According to him, the department has a quota available for the next 25 days. Ways to book gas cylinders For customers of Indian Oil, gas cylinder bookings can be made through three methods. Consumers can place bookings using their registered mobile numbers via WhatsApp, missed call or IVRS. The WhatsApp number is 7588888824, the missed call number is 8454955555, and the IVRS number is 7718955555. This facility is currently available only for Indian Oil customers.

stories.title: Emergency landing of Maurya's helicopter raises questions:In service for 18 years; not undergone repairs in last 3 years, say officials
stories.summary: Deputy CM Keshav Maurya’s helicopter, which made an emergency landing at Lucknow airport on March 7, has been in service for 18 years. Moreover, it hasn't been repaired for 3 years. Civil Aviation Department officials provided this information to Dainik Bhaskar. In fact, this is the fourth emergency landing of Keshav Maurya's helicopter in 8 years. This raised questions about when the helicopter's last technical inspection was conducted. Why wasn't the technical issue detected before takeoff? Meanwhile, Akhilesh Yadav also took a dig and gave the matter a political turn. To find answers to these questions, Dainik Bhaskar spoke with officials. Let's see what they revealed... Purchased in 2008, rotor blade parts replaced in 2023 Officials said, 'Keshav Maurya's helicopter, Bell 412 EP, is one of the oldest helicopters in the Civil Aviation Department's fleet'. It was purchased from Bell Helicopter Textron of Singapore in 2008. Its repairs and overhauling work were done in 2023. At that time, 2 main rotor blade parts were replaced. This cost ₹99 lakh 99 thousand 528. After this, there is no information about any repairs to this helicopter. UP Government recently purchased helicopter worth ₹130 crore Akhilesh Yadav held a press conference at the SP office on March 7. During this, he was also questioned about an emergency landing. He replied that it seems Keshav Maurya did not get the new helicopter. After this, Bhaskar tried to find out for whom the new helicopter was purchased for in UP? It came to light that the UP state government has recently purchased a modern helicopter, Agusta AW 139. Its price is being reported between 120 and 130 crores. This helicopter was purchased from Italy's Messrs Leonardo. Currently, CM Yogi Adityanath and other VVIP guests are flying in it. Captain Akshay Jaswal, Amit Bhutani and Rajesh Kumar Sharma have been given critical emergency training for this helicopter. More than ₹50 lakh has been spent on this training. This is considered one of the safest helicopters in the world. During whose rule were more aircraft-helicopters purchased After talking to former IAS officers of UP, it came to light that the maximum number of helicopters and aircraft were purchased during BSP's rule between 2007 and 2012. Crores spent on pilot training Civil Aviation Department officials say, ‘The government does not compromise on the safety of helicopters and aircraft’. From time to time, pilots undergo critical emergency training and instrument flight training along with repair and overhauling. Training of each pilot costs lakhs of rupees. The UP government has about 10 pilots, all working on contract. The government has not recruited permanent pilots for a long time. The pilots who are flying helicopters and aircraft include Captain Sunil Kora, Captain Sunil Srivastava, Captain GS Padda, Captain Amit Kumar Bhutani, Captain SK Giri, Captain Anoop Srivastava, Captain Deepak Srivastava, Captain Akshay Jasywal and Captain Rajesh Kumar Sharma. Bureaucracy created such a system that permanent pilots were not recruited During the BSP government, CM Mayawati appointed her state pilot Shashank Shekhar as Cabinet Secretary in the government. Insiders say that Shashank Shekhar proved himself to be not only an excellent pilot but also a skilled administrator. All Principal Secretaries, Secretaries, and DMs of that time reported to him, and he was feared due to his strict working style. However, internally, IAS and PCS officers resented that a pilot was ruling over them. This is why the bureaucracy subsequently created such a system that new pilots were not permanently recruited. Helicopter was at height of 2000 feet On March 7, Keshav's helicopter took off from La Martiniere School Ground in Lucknow. This ground is near his residence. There were 6 people, including Keshav, in the helicopter - two pilots, an advisor, a class four staff and security. At an altitude of 2000 feet, the pilot detected a problem in the helicopter. Smoke started filling the helicopter. After taking permission from Air Traffic Control (ATC), the aircraft was immediately turned towards Lucknow. The pilot somehow managed to land the helicopter at Lucknow airport amid robust safety arrangements. Initial investigation revealed that there was a problem in the helicopter's electronic system. After 1 hour, Keshav Prasad Maurya took off for Kaushambi in another helicopter. Upon reaching there, he said- There was a technical fault in the helicopter, so I had to be turned back and landed. Later, I came here (Kaushambi) taking another helicopter. By Lord Shiva's grace, everything is fine. When-when did Keshav's helicopter make emergency landings? Akhilesh took a jibe during the press conference After Keshav's helicopter emergency landing, Akhilesh said at the SP office, ‘We wish that they (Keshav) stay healthy’. A helicopter is a machine. We all fly in this machine. Such incidents should not happen to anyone. The machine should be in good condition. After this, taking a jibe, he said, ‘He must not have got the new helicopter’. The new helicopter that has come to the state should be given to him.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav to marry childhood friend Vanshika in Mussoorie:Cricketer's father invites UP CM Yogi to son's reception in Lucknow
stories.summary: Indian spinner Kuldeep Yadav is going to marry his childhood friend Vanshika. The couple will take 7 vows in Mussoorie, Uttarakhand, on 14 March. On Monday, Kuldeep's father, Ram Singh Yadav, invited CM Yogi to the wedding. The grand reception party will be conducted after three days of marriage, i.e. 17 March in Lucknow's Centrum Hotel. Kuldeep and Vanshika got engaged in Lucknow on June 4, 2025, which was attended by many close friends, including cricketer Rinku Singh and Priya Saroj. See 3 pictures of Kuldeep-Vanshika's ring ceremony... Celebrations to start on 13 March, Bollywood celebrities politicians to attend Kuldeep's coach and family friend Kapil Dev Mishra says, "The wedding rituals will begin on 13 March. The haldi and mehendi functions will be held on the same day. After the wedding, a reception will be hosted at Hotel Centrum in Lucknow. Several well-known cricketers, famous Bollywood celebrities, and prominent politicians from Uttar Pradesh are expected to attend the event.” : How can India surpass Australia's tally of 10 ICC trophies?:3 ICC titles up for grabs in next 2 years, including ODI and T20 World Cups Distance between Kuldeep-Vanshika's homes in Kanpur is 3 km Kuldeep's bride-to-be, Vanshika, is from Shyam Nagar in Kanpur. She currently works at LIC. Meanwhile, Kuldeep Yadav lives in Lal Bungalow, 3 kilometers away from Vanshika's house. Kuldeep and Vanshika are childhood friends and have known each other for a long time. Earlier, there was a discussion that the wedding would be in November 2025, but it was postponed due to the Indian team's busy schedule and the T20 World Cup. Now, after winning the T20 World Cup, Kuldeep is starting a new innings. Wedding in Mussoorie and reception in Lucknow Kuldeep's coach and family friend Kapil Dev Pandey said that the wedding celebrations will begin on 13 March. On this day, there will be Haldi and Mehendi ceremonies. The wedding will take place on 14 March at a grand resort in Mussoorie. After the wedding, a grand reception party will be held on 17 March at Hotel Centrum in Lucknow. Indian cricket team players, along with cricketers from several countries, Bollywood celebrities, and prominent politicians from Uttar Pradesh, are expected to attend. Kuldeep had said - wife should be someone who can take care of the family Vansika is Kuldeep's childhood friend. Gradually, their friendship turned into love. Vansika has also completed her studies in Kanpur. In an interview in 2024, Kuldeep had said that he would not marry a Bollywood actress. His wife would be someone who could take care of the family. Speaking about Vansika, Kuldeep said that she holds a special place in his life. Their relationship goes back a long way. Kuldeep Yadav became a cricketer because of his father Kuldeep was born in a village in UP's Unnao district. His father ran a brick kiln. He had a great passion for cricket. Whenever there was a match broadcast, he never forgot to watch it on TV. When Kuldeep Yadav was born on 14 December, 1994, his father decided to make him a cricketer. Kuldeep says, “I didn't like this game at all. I just played cricket with tennis ball with friends. I was very good at studies. I never liked the game of cricket. However, today Kuldeep is a charismatic off-spinner of Indian cricket through his own and his father's hard work. Today he lives a very royal life. He lives in a posh area like Lal Bungalow in Kanpur. He owns several expensive luxury cars.”

stories.title: Fog and rain alert issued across 10 UP cities:Temperature Crosses 37°C for the first time; weather may worsen after March 15
stories.summary: The heat in UP has started showing its intensity. For the first time this season, the temperature has crossed 37C. Meanwhile, on Tuesday morning, fog persisted in 10 cities including Lucknow, Kanpur, Varanasi, and Prayagraj. Visibility was reduced to 400-500 meters in many places. People were seen driving with headlights on in several areas. People avoided venturing out of their homes in rural areas. According to experts, due to rising heat and moisture in the atmosphere, light fog in the morning and hazy conditions during the day are developing. Some areas are likely to remain cloudy. Meanwhile, the weather department has issued a rain alert for eastern UP and surrounding areas for two days. While this may provide a slight relief but it is expected that conditions may worsen from March 15. People facing scorching heat due to intense sunlight and hot winds Looking at the past 24 hours, Agra was the hottest in the state. The temperature here was recorded at 37.6C. People had to face scorching heat due to intense sunlight and hot winds. Besides this, cities like Jhansi, Banda, Hamirpur, and Basti also saw a surge in temperature. Winds also blew at speeds of 25 to 30 kilometers per hour in the evening. Doctors and administration have advised the public to avoid going out in strong sunlight during afternoon, drink plenty of water and take necessary precautions to avoid heatstroke. Experts suggested that the weather will remain mixed for farmers. Light rain could be beneficial for crops. However, there are concerns about damage to standing crops from heat and strong winds. Weather expert Atul Kumar Singh said, “Temperature may rise further in the coming days. Soon the mercury could reach 40 degrees Celsius in many areas of the state. Between March 10-14, both day and night temperatures are likely to gradually continue increasing. A new spell of rain may begin from March 15”. Condition in Major Cities Why is the heat increasing in March itself? Skymet Weather Vice President Mahesh Palawat said “The effect of climate change has been clearly visible on weather in recent years. This is why the weather pattern is changing rapidly. Summer is starting earlier compared to before”. He added, “The effect is that now the temperature is rising more rapidly. The number of hot days is also increasing. Many times, the heat wave period also lasts longer than before. In the past few years, old heat records have also been broken in many cities of the country. In some places, temperatures have been recorded above 48 degrees Celsius”. Western Disturbance active, what effect will be seen in UP? According to Mahesh Palawat, “A Western Disturbance is likely to become active, due to which light rain and snowfall may be seen in the Western Himalayan region (Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand) till March 11. Its effect will also be seen in UP”. He said, “Actually, a cyclonic circulation (wind rotating in a circular motion while rising upward in one area) formed in North Odisha and Bengal region has extended a trough line up to the northern parts of Uttar Pradesh. Due to this system, slight changes in the state's weather may be observed”. He further added, “The weather in Uttar Pradesh is likely to remain mostly dry for now, but some areas may see cloud cover and slight fluctuations in temperature”. Heatwave may continue for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that many cities may experience very high temperatures for several consecutive days and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the Meteorological Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in the plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature is recorded 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected and the risk of heatstroke increases. Crops will be damaged by heat Professor PK Singh from the Agriculture Department at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) said, “March could prove challenging for farmers. The rise in temperature will affect the Rabi crop, especially wheat. The grains will not develop fully due to the heat. This will result in lower yield”. According to him, “Hot winds can damage crops like mustard, chickpeas and peas. Rising temperatures cause soil in fields to dry quickly. This increases irrigation costs. Crops face stress”.

stories.title: Engineer who stabbed sister 84 times becomes restless in jail:Sleepless, missing his mother, speaking irrationally
stories.summary: The engineer Hardik, who killed his sister with 84 stab wounds in Moradabad, is restless in jail. He is unable to sleep. He is talking incoherently. He is missing his mother. On one hand, he is worried about who will take care of his mother, who will look after her. He keeps asking jail officials when he can go home. On the other hand, he tells fellow inmates that he had always feared his mother being left alone. For this reason, he wanted to kill his mother. Given Hardik's mental state, he has been kept in a quarantine barrack. Doctors are also closely monitoring his behavior. On March 6, Hardik (25) murdered his twin sister Himshikha (25) at home. He mutilated her entire body, including her kidneys, liver, and heart, with a knife. After this, he brought his mother, Neelima, home from work. He then attacked her too with the knife 6 times. After the incident, the accused had fled. Police arrested him from Moradabad within 24 hours. His mother remained hospitalized for 4 days. She was discharged on Monday. Now she has gone to her brother's house in Badaun. CO Civil Lines Kuldeep Gupta says- Hardik's mother is the only eyewitness in the case. Police have recovered the knife used in Himshikha's murder. After collecting forensic evidence, we will soon file a chargesheet in court. We are also searching for the girl with whom Hardik was in a relationship. Both were twin siblings, active on social media Originally from Jogipur in Badaun district, Neelima works as an Assistant Manager at an insurance company located on Delhi Road in Moradabad. 30 years ago, she settled in Moradabad with her husband. She separated from her husband 10 years ago. After this, she started living in a rented house in the Buddhi Vihar area of Moradabad. She educated both her children (Hardik-Himshikha) and made them capable. Himshikha and Hardik were twins. After completing engineering, both worked at an IT company in Gurugram. Himshikha was also pursuing an MBA along with her job. Both siblings were active on social media. Hardik fell in love with a girl from Gurgaon on Instagram. After this, he quit his job about one and a half years ago and started uploading content on YouTube. During questioning, Hardik told police that he wanted to marry his online girlfriend. However, his sister advised him not to be crazy in love and focus on building his career. After this, he carried out the crime. After murdering sister, told mother, 'Let's go home, want to give a surprise' After killing his sister on Friday, Hardik went to his mother's office to call her. He said, 'Mom, let's go home. I want to give you a surprise'. Then he took his mother home by car. As soon as Neelima opened the gate, she saw blood spread throughout the house. Their daughter Himshikha's blood-soaked body was lying on the bed in the room. Seeing this, she screamed. Before Neelima could understand anything, Hardik attacked her with a knife multiple times. Hardik was devoted to his sister; their chemistry seemed perfect When police investigated Hardik and Himshikha's social media accounts, they found that the siblings were devoted to each other. Taking his sister on outings, getting her leaves from work for weekend-long trips...even making new reels with her every day was a habit of the accused brother, Hardik. The chemistry between them appeared perfect. Hardik advocated for giving freedom to girls on social media and giving them more rights than boys. Hardik's pain regarding marriage in other religions is also visible in Instagram reels. However, the siblings were not in agreement on this topic. The difference in Hardik and Himshikha's views was reflected in their social media activities. Seeing their bonding on social media, the police are not able to digest the accused's theory. Police are trying to find the answer to the question of how Hardik came to hate his sister so much. Watch Hardik and Himshikha's reels...

stories.title: IAS interview panel asks, 'Will bulldozer justice aid economic growth?':What would you write in President’s speech? Read UP candidates’ answers
stories.summary: More than 50 candidates from UP succeeded in the UPSC-2025 final results. Surbhi Yadav from Amroha secured 14th rank, Monica Srivastava from Ballia got 16th rank, Vijay Mudgal from Aligarh ranked 54th and Harsh Nehra from Meerut secured 74th rank. The interview session was most interesting, where most selected candidates from UP were asked questions related to Uttar Pradesh. The interview panel member asked Shubham Singh Chandel from Jaunpur, ‘Will bulldozer justice help achieve economic targets?’. The answer was equally interesting: Investors need security. Law and order in UP have improved after the bulldozer action. Not just heavy topics, candidates were also asked questions about their personality. Harsh Nehra from Meerut was asked how he stays so fit at such a young age. Harsh explained that he does physical strength training to keep himself fit. When asked, Aditya from Azamgarh, which country would you like to work in besides India as a job option? Aditya said China... Meanwhile, Surbhi from Amroha said about the interview selection that I achieved success by adopting a 'no' strategy. What I didn't know, I clearly said that I don't have knowledge about it. Read Dainik Bhaskar report… Shubham Singh Chandel secured 378th rank in the UPSC civil services examination. After his selection, Dhananjay Singh congratulated him through a tweet. He is his nephew through a distant relation. Shubham is from UP. During the interview, when the panel member learned this, they asked, ‘How will bulldozer justice improve law and order in UP benefit the one trillion dollar economy target?’ He said, 'States that have law and order issues don't receive investments, where law and order is good, investors' perception changes, they feel secure and bring investments'. When asked about UP's budget, how many lakh crores was it earlier? How big is the budget this time? Shubham replied, 'I haven't seen how much this year's budget is, I don't know'. Last year's budget was ₹8.08 lakh crore rupees. They asked me questions about revenue, which I declined to answer. Tanya Singh from Deoria says, ‘I succeeded in my second attempt’. Secured 200th rank in the Civil Services Examination. She says, ‘During the interview, I was asked a slightly off-beat question’ , 'If you had to write the President's speech for Republic Day', which 3 issues would you like to mention? I told them that the first issue should be unemployment. The youth of the country need jobs. For the second issue, I would try to highlight what work is being done to eliminate poverty. The third issue I would like to talk about is the work done to increase the country's GDP despite ongoing difficulties with other countries. After that, in the interview, I gave the example of India making free trade deals with European countries after America imposed tariffs. This is how I explained these three issues in the interview. Surbhi Yadav says, ‘I am from a small village called Nagla Sanga’. There were many questions in the interview about which I had no knowledge. Instead of giving half-incomplete or wrong answers, I thought it was better to say NO. The panel member asks, 'Did you read today's newspaper?' Questions were asked about India-Bangladesh relations. Questions were also asked about airline privatisation. I didn't have much information about these questions, so I said I didn't know. Then I was asked detailed questions about the Nuclear Peace Bill and Nuclear Energy. Sir said that you are a history student, but I want to ask you about the science behind nuclear energy. How does it function? Surbhi further says, ‘I explained the mechanism of how the whole thing functions’. They asked which fuel is used in it, then I said, ‘Uranium-235’. Surbhi shared - During the Mains exam, I got typhoid, and my eyes were quite swollen. Despite poor health, I didn't give up and took the exams with full strength. In January 2026, I got a job as Assistant Director at My Bharat in the Ministry of Youth and Sports. Now that I have been selected in UPSC, I will leave that job. Aditya says, ‘I am from the Bilariaganj area’. When the interview panel learned this, they asked 4 questions related to UP. 1. Name 5 people from UP who have received the Bharat Ratna. 2. Which districts fall between Lucknow and Delhi? 3. How will UP achieve its one trillion dollar economy goal? 4. What steps has the government taken to deal with Japanese Encephalitis (brain fever) in Purvanchal? Additionally, I was asked if I would like to work in job options given outside India? I answered China. They asked, why so? Then I said, 'China's population is almost equal to India's, so in that respect China makes good use of its resources, that's why if given the option I would work in China'. Harsh Nehra from Meerut secured the All India 74th rank in UPSC. He says - As soon as I went inside for the interview, the sir immediately asked me - You were born in 2002, your age is less, accordingly, you look healthy and strong, so what are the advantages and disadvantages of this? What is your daily routine? Harsh said, 'I do physical strength training to keep myself fit. After this, sir also told about his life, which I also like to do all this. During this time, the atmosphere remained quite pleasant. He also asked several questions related to Meerut, asking, What developments are happening in Meerut? I replied, ‘Connectivity is getting better, Rapid Rail has arrived, this has improved connectivity with Delhi, can go from Meerut to Delhi for studies’. If Rapid Rail had started earlier, I wouldn't have had to stay away from home in Delhi during preparation. Do you get angry? I said, ‘I am a person of a calm nature’. Any problem can be solved peacefully by making a strategy. Not with anger.

stories.title: Shankaracharya says, 'Yogi's mother is our mother':Maulana's statements are highly objectionable; his community should caution him
stories.summary: Amid the ongoing conflict with CM Yogi, Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand expressed strong displeasure over objectionable remarks made against the Chief Minister’s mother. Speaking in Unnao, he said ideological differences may exist, but insulting someone’s mother is unacceptable. He added that Yogi Adityanath’s mother should be respected like everyone’s mother, and such comments should not have been made. He also urged people from the Maulana’s community to explain the seriousness of the matter to him. Shankaracharya began his Gopratishtha Dharmayudh Yatra from Kashi on March 7 and is scheduled to hold a Dharma Sabha in Lucknow on March 11. On Monday, he reached the ancient pilgrimage site Naimisharanya in Sitapur, where he offered prayers at the Lalita Devi Temple and will stay there for the night. Meanwhile, Maulana Abdullah Salim had allegedly used abusive words for Yogi Adityanath’s mother in Bihar. A case was registered against him in Balrampur on Sunday, and protests against the Maulana were reported from several districts of Uttar Pradesh. Now read Shankaracharya's full statement... Strongly rebuked the Maulana Shankaracharya said, look, whether it's a Maulana or a Pandit, no one should have the audacity to speak about someone's mother. Yogi Adityanath's mother is our mother. If you stoop to the level of speaking about mothers, then all of us sitting here, our mothers are everyone's mothers, and everyone's mothers are our mothers. This is the conduct of us Hindus. Therefore, whoever has spoken about Adityanath ji's mother has spoken very wrongly. We strongly condemn this. We want to say to their religious followers in front of everyone that make their Maulana understand. This makes your religion feel small, too. There's no need to go after mothers. In Islam, too, a mother's status is considered the highest. In our tradition, also "Pituh Shatguni Mata Gauravena Atirichyate", the scripture says that the father is the greatest because he is our birth giver. But a mother's status is a hundred times more than that. So you should not make such wrong statements about mothers, speak ill words, beware, you should not speak like this. May the days never come when we speak at someone else's behest Ashutosh Brahmachari had alleged that Shankaracharya is the guru of Akhilesh Yadav and the Samajwadi Party, and only speaks what he is told to say. To this, Shankaracharya said, it's different if someone becomes his disciple. But for Shankaracharya to become someone's disciple and start speaking at their behest, such low days have not yet come for Shankaracharya. Compared BJP rule to demon Hiranyakashipu's reign Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand Saraswati compared the present government to the rule of the demon Hiranyakashipu. He said that during Hiranyakashipu’s time, saints and ascetics were persecuted, and a similar situation is returning today. He referred to the Mauni Amavasya incident during the Magh Mela, saying that the police of the Chief Minister, who calls himself an ascetic, used batons on saints. He questioned what it means when ascetics and celibates are beaten with batons, adding that such things used to happen during Hiranyakashipu’s reign. Quoting the Puranas, Shankaracharya said cows and Brahmins are considered forms of Lord Vishnu. Dandi Sanyasis come from Brahmin traditions. He alleged that today in Uttar Pradesh, cows and Brahmins are being attacked. When asked about the difference between the BJP and Sanatan Dharma, he used an example of an elephant. He said an elephant has two tusks: one for show and one for eating. According to him, the BJP’s Sanatan is only for show, while their Sanatan is for real practice. He said their Sanatan Dharma is linked with virtue, sin, heaven, and hell, whereas the BJP’s version is connected to power and pleasure. Dharma Yuddh to be declared on March 11 Shankaracharya said that on March 11 in Lucknow, the conclusions of a 40-day discussion will be presented, and a Dharma Yuddh (religious battle) will be declared by blowing a conch shell. He clarified that this will be an ideological battle. No missiles will be fired, and no one will be physically harmed. Instead, it will be a battle of ideas, arguments, and speeches. Both sides will present their views and evidence about who represents the true form of Hinduism. He said that when this debate happens, people will decide who is right and who is wrong. Controversial remark about Yogi Adityanath’s mother Meanwhile, a video of Maulana Abdullah Salim has surfaced on social media. It is reported that during a religious gathering in Bihar in the month of Ramadan, he used objectionable language while referring to Yogi Adityanath’s mother. In the video, the Maulana made remarks while talking about food habits and a law in Uttar Pradesh, which sparked controversy. (We cannot write Maulana's complete statement here verbatim. Therefore, objectionable words have been marked with dots)

stories.title: Aparna Yadav writes to CM Yogi against rapper Badshah:Seeks ban on show; says women insulted in 'Tateeree' song
stories.summary: Rapper Badshah has started facing opposition in UP after Haryana. Aparna Yadav, Vice President of the Women's Commission, wrote a letter to CM Yogi Adityanath on Thursday. She has demanded a ban on Badshah's stage shows in UP. Aparna wrote in the letter: Badshah's new song 'Tateeree' uses abusive language towards women. Objectionable scenes have been shown. Sacred places like schools have also been addressed with derogatory words. This has severely insulted the dignity of women. Aparna Yadav said - In the song, female students in school uniforms have been shown inappropriately. This hurts the dignity of women and social values. Demand for issuing a lookout circular Information has also been received about an FIR being registered and a lookout circular being issued in this matter. The Chief Minister is requested to instruct all district magistrates of the state to cancel permission for any proposed program of singer Badshah. First, know why there is a controversy over the song Show to be held in Pilibhit on March 20 In Pilibhit, a 2-hour non-stop live magic show/concert named "Badshah Magic World" is scheduled for March 20. The show promises family entertainment with digital magic like mind reading, telepathy, and live dinosaurs. After Aparna Yadav wrote a letter to the Chief Minister, there is now confusion regarding the organization of this event. Haryana Women's Commission also summoned Amidst the controversy, the Haryana Women's Commission had issued a notice to Badshah last Friday. He has been asked to appear in Panipat on March 13. Additionally, 3 separate cases have been registered against the singer in Panchkula and Jind. Khap panchayats and social organisations had also demanded a ban on this song, calling it against Haryanvi culture.

Due to the disrupted supply of both domestic and commercial cylinders, people associated with the hotel. 9. Akhilesh Yadav meets Shankaracharya in Lucknow SP chief Akhilesh Yadav met Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand in Lucknow on Thursday. Akhilesh greeted the saints present there with folded hands at the entrance. Former MP Anu Tandon was also present with him. 10. stories.title: 2 HPCL officers shot dead in UP:Gunman enters plant with automatic weapon, kills DGM and manager
stories.summary: Two senior officials of Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited (HPCL) were shot dead inside a company plant in Uttar Pradesh’s Budaun on Thursday afternoon, allegedly by a dismissed former employee who had been holding a grudge against the management. The victims were identified as Sudhir Gupta (55), Deputy General Manager (DGM), and Harshit Mishra (40), Assistant Manager (Sales). Police said the accused, Ajay Pratap Singh alias Ramu Singh, a former vendor and employee associated with the plant, opened fire at the officials during a meeting inside the premises around 1 pm. Accused entered plant in Bolero, opened rapid fire According to initial information, Ajay Pratap Singh arrived at the plant in a Bolero vehicle along with five others, including four plant employees and a driver. The group reportedly entered the premises before the employees’ shift, which was scheduled to begin at 2 pm. Officials said the vehicle was not checked at the plant gate, allowing the accused to enter with an automatic firearm. Shortly after entering, Ajay allegedly began arguing with the officers and suddenly opened rapid fire at Sudhir Gupta and Harshit Mishra. Both officials sustained critical gunshot injuries and collapsed on the spot. They were rushed to the Dataganj Community Health Centre (CHC), where doctors declared them dead. See 3 visuals related to the incident... Police seal plant, investigation underway Following the incident, police sealed the plant premises and stopped the entry of visitors. Senior police and administrative officers rushed to the spot after receiving information about the double murder. DIG Ajay Sahni reached the plant and supervised the investigation. Police teams have begun questioning staff members present during the incident. Security has also been tightened at the HPCL plant, Dataganj CHC, and the district hospital as a precautionary measure. Eyewitnesses: accused forced entry, fired after argument Eyewitnesses said that Ajay Pratap Singh, a resident of Sainjani village, forcibly entered the plant with several people around 1 pm. He allegedly began abusing associates of the two officers. When Sudhir Gupta and Harshit Mishra objected, the situation escalated. In the middle of the argument, Ajay reportedly pulled out a firearm and began shooting. The accused fled the scene immediately after firing the shots. Earlier dispute and threats Investigators say the attack may be linked to an earlier dispute at the plant on February 5. Police said Ajay Pratap Singh had created a disturbance at the facility that day by breaking through the security perimeter and entering the premises forcibly. Following the incident, the company terminated his contract and barred him from the plant. Officials said he was also blacklisted three months ago, which allegedly fuelled his resentment. According to police, Ajay had openly threatened to kill DGM Sudhir Gupta during the earlier confrontation. Witnesses claimed he had also boasted of links with notorious gangster groups in Noida and Shahjahanpur, showing knife scars on his body and warning that he would “teach everyone a lesson”. After the February dispute, the accused allegedly followed the officers’ vehicles for nearly five kilometres, repeatedly overtaking them and issuing threats. Assistant Manager Harshit Mishra had filed an FIR against him in connection with that incident. Victim’s background Sudhir Gupta was originally from Silver Estate Apartment, Sector 50, Noida. His father’s name is Dayakishan. At the time of the incident, Gupta was residing near Sanjay Community in Bareilly due to his posting. Accused arrested Senior Superintendent of Police Dr Brajesh Singh said the shooting took place while officials were attending a meeting inside the HPCL plant. “During the meeting, a former vendor of the plant entered the premises and opened fire. The injured officials were immediately taken to hospital, where they were declared dead. The accused has been arrested,” the SSP said. Police said further investigation is underway to determine whether others present in the vehicle were aware of the attack plan or involved in the crime.

stories.title: Need a gas cylinder? Don’t panic:Officials claim a 25-day reserve stock across the state, even if the war escalates
stories.summary: Images of panic buying of gas cylinders are emerging from different cities of Uttar Pradesh. Gas supply is being carried out in the presence of police. Even people who do not immediately need cylinders are booking them. The government has already stopped the supply of commercial gas cylinders. Because of this, many people fear that the supply of domestic cylinders may also be affected. How valid is this concern? What preparations have petroleum companies made for the next six months? Can cylinder prices increase? Dainik Bhaskar explains answers to nine key questions. Question 1: Can there be a shortage of domestic cylinders? Answer: Due to the Iran war, uncertainty has arisen regarding gas and crude oil. Gas supply has been disrupted by up to 30%. Because of this, the Petroleum Ministry has fixed supply priorities. The government has reduced commercial gas supply by 20–30%. Agencies are now focusing on supplying domestic LPG cylinders. Through this system, the government aims to ensure 100% availability of domestic gas and CNG for the next six months. Question 2: How many days of reserve stock does the government have? Answer: There is no shortage of LPG cylinders. Refineries have increased LPG production by around 10%. Officials say there is no need to panic. Gas companies are sending messages to customers saying claims of gas shortage are misleading. Food and Civil Supplies Principal Secretary Ranveer Prasad said, “There is a reserve stock of domestic LPG cylinders for 20 to 25 days in Uttar Pradesh.” Question 3: Will cylinders not be available even after 26 days in the coming period? Answer: Food and Civil Supplies Principal Secretary Ranveer Prasad said, “Because of panic booking, demand suddenly increased. Therefore, on March 6, oil companies introduced a 21-day lock-in period for domestic LPG booking.” He added, “Lock-in period means that after delivery of one cylinder, a new cylinder can be booked only after 21 days. On March 9, the lock-in period was increased to 25 days.” “The automatic booking system has been updated accordingly. That is why gas agencies are unable to accept bookings earlier. There is little possibility of any change in the lock-in period in the coming days,” he said. Question 4: Should people panic? Answer: Before the Iran–Israel war, there was no lock-in period. People could book a new cylinder on the same day the previous one was delivered. Now that this is not possible, an atmosphere of panic has developed among people. However, officials say there is no need to panic. Question 5: Why has the government implemented the Essential Commodities Act? Answer: The Essential Commodities Act gives the government the power to control supply and prices of essential items such as grains, pulses, edible oils, medicines and fuel. In simple terms, it is a law to prevent hoarding. Under this law, traders are given a stock limit and cannot store goods beyond that limit in warehouses. This will also prevent black marketing of gas cylinders. In Gorakhpur’s Pipiganj area, two youths standing in a queue for cylinders at an Indane gas agency got into a fight. Police had to intervene to separate them. Question 6: What is the government doing to tackle gas shortage complaints? Answer: Complaints of LPG and petrol-diesel shortages have been reported from several districts of Uttar Pradesh. Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath reviewed the situation on March 10. He instructed all District Magistrates and Superintendents of Police to monitor the situation in their respective districts. In major districts such as Noida, Lucknow, Kanpur and Prayagraj, the administration is inspecting gas depots and agencies to check whether any artificial shortage of gas or fuel is being created. Question 7: After booking, how many days does it take to receive a cylinder? Answer: Food and Civil Supplies Principal Secretary Ranveer Prasad said, “There is no district where gas supply has stopped.” “After booking, the standard supply time is seven days. However, in Uttar Pradesh, cylinders are being delivered to homes within two to three days. Around 8 to 10 lakh cylinders are delivered every day,” he said. Question 8: If the Iran–Israel war intensifies, will gas supply be affected? Answer: The government has already prepared for such a situation. Refineries have been asked to increase production. The Reliance refinery in Jamnagar and the HMEL refinery in Bathinda have been directed to stop petrol production and shift to gas production. After operating at full capacity, it is estimated that about 70% of the country’s requirement can be met. Question 9: Where can people complain if agencies are not delivering cylinders? Answer: A toll-free number has been issued for complaints. Consumers can call 1800-2333-555, which is common for Indane, Bharat Gas and HP Gas customers. Complaints can also be registered online at mylpg.in. (All answers were provided by Food and Civil Supplies Principal Secretary Ranveer Prasad.)

stories.summary: UP Panchayat Chunav 2026: यूपी पंचायत चुनाव कब होंगे? यूपी ग्राम प्रधान का चुनाव कब होंगे?… ये सवाल इस वक्त यूपी के हर एक गांव में सुनाई दे रहा है। आम जनता यूपी में होने वाले पंचायत चुनाव को लेकर सवाल कर रही है कि आखिर सरकार कब कराएगी चुनाव। पंचायत चुनाव में भाग लेने वाले प्रत्याशी परेशान हैं कि आखिर सरकार यूपी पंचायत चुनाव क्यों नहीं करा रही है। वहीं सरकार ने इसको लेकर OBC आयोग का गठन तक नहीं किया। उम्मीद थी कि 10 मार्च को होने वाले कैबिनेट बैठक में यूपी पंचायत चुनाव पर मोहर लग जाएगी, लेकिन इसको लेकर कोई चर्चा ही नहीं हुई। बता दें कि कोर्ट ने योगी सरकार को 2 फरवरी को OBC आयोग का गठन करने के लिए 15 दिन का समय दिया था, लेकिम लगभग 2 महीने से उपर का समय बीत चुका है और सरकार अभी तक आयोग का गठन नहीं कर पाई है। वहीं पंचायती राज मंत्री ओपी राजभर बार-बार पंचायत चुनाव समय पर कराने का दावा करते हैं, लेकिन अब ऐसा नहीं लगता कि यूपी पंचायत चुनाव समय पर हो पाएंगे। वहीं यूपी के डिप्टी सीएम ने एक ऐसा बयान दे दिया है, जिसके बाद यह साफ हो गया है कि यूपी पंचायत चुनाव समय पर बिल्कुल भी नहीं कराए जाएंगे।

stories.title: Massive fire at Noida factory:Firefighters climb roof, break windows to rescue 35 workers; many carried out on shoulders
stories.summary: A massive fire broke out at an electricity meter manufacturing factory in Noida on Thursday, triggering panic among workers and prompting a large rescue operation by the fire department. The fire started suddenly at the Capital Power System Limited factory located in the Phase-1 police station area. Within minutes, the flames spread rapidly across all five floors of the building. More than 200 employees managed to run out of the factory to save their lives. However, around 35 workers were trapped inside, many of whom reportedly lost consciousness due to smoke. Local residents alerted the police and the fire department soon after the fire broke out. More than 30 fire tenders rushed to the spot and began rescue and firefighting operations. Firefighters used ladders to reach the first-floor balcony and broke the glass windows to enter the building. Rescue teams then brought the trapped workers down on their shoulders and shifted them to safety. The injured were taken to the district hospital by the police and emergency teams. Officials said most of the workers suffered minor injuries, mainly due to smoke inhalation and panic. However, two workers suffered serious burn injuries. One of them has been referred to a hospital in Delhi for advanced treatment. Firefighters battled the blaze for several hours before bringing it under control. Officials said it took around four to five hours to fully control the fire. 5 Pictures of the Accident... Short circuit suspected behind Noida factory fire; smoke visible 2 km away A short circuit is suspected to have caused the massive fire that broke out at an electricity meter manufacturing factory in Noida early Thursday morning, officials said. According to initial reports, the fire started on the ground floor around 5.30 am. Due to the large quantity of plastic components and electrical wiring materials stored inside the factory, the flames spread rapidly through the building. The blaze was so intense that thick clouds of smoke were visible from nearly two kilometres away, creating panic in the surrounding areas. During the chaos, one employee suffered a fractured leg while trying to escape from the burning building. He was rushed to hospital and is currently undergoing treatment. Police and emergency teams shifted all the injured workers to the district hospital in ambulances. Most of the employees sustained minor injuries, while some were treated for smoke inhalation. Firefighters used powerful water jets and continued operations for several hours before bringing the blaze under control. After the flames were contained, rescue teams carried out a thorough search of the factory building to ensure that no one was left trapped inside. Officials later confirmed that no additional workers were found inside the factory during the search operation. Joint Commissioner of Police (Law and Order) Rajeev Narayan Mishra said that authorities responded quickly after receiving information about the incident. “This morning, information was received about a fire in a factory located in Sector-4. The local police and fire brigade team immediately reached the spot and the fire has been brought under control,” he said. Authorities are now investigating the incident and assessing the extent of damage caused to the factory.

stories.title: Kuldeep Yadav's wedding to feature ₹20,000 plate meal:Cricketer's wedding card based on Radha-Krishna theme with a splinter of Rajwada
stories.summary: Indian cricket team spinner Kuldeep Yadav is going to marry his childhood friend Vanshika Singh. Meanwhile, his family and relatives have left Kanpur for Mussoorie to attend the wedding. The marriage ceremony will take place on March 14 (Saturday) at Mussoorie's luxurious 'Welcomhotel The Savoy'. Three days later, on March 17, a grand reception party will be organised at Hotel Centrum in Lucknow. Kuldeep and Vanshika got engaged on June 4, 2025, in Lucknow. The budget for this wedding is expected to exceed ₹2 crore. The beautiful and royal wedding card of Kuldeep and Vanshika's wedding has also left people buzzing on social media. The invitation card's theme is based on Radha-Krishna. Its design, carving, and the artworks etched on it give a feel of a royal kingdom. The card is said to cost around ₹2200. Meanwhile, both vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes have been arranged for the guests. The cost of one plate of food is around 20,000 rupees. PHOTOS of the wedding card Features of Kuldeep Yadav's wedding card Royal style and intricate carving The base of the card is light pink (peach) in colour. It features a very intricate floral (flower-and-leaf) pattern. The card has 'gold foil work' (golden carving). Golden colour has been used on the edges to highlight the palace domes and figures, giving it a 3D and vintage look. On the upper part of the card, there is a magnificent golden lock (buckle) with a pink floral design on top. Attractive couple's portrait engraved in the centre of the card A very attractive picture is engraved in the centre of the card. It depicts a couple standing in front of a jharokha (balcony window) of a royal palace. Dressed in traditional royal attire of red and green, this couple resembles Radha-Krishna. In the background are the palace's latticed windows and domes. Meanwhile, the lower part of the card features a beautiful depiction of nature - lotus flowers blooming in a pond and a peacock sitting near a fountain are shown. Text and invitation message The choice of letters written on the card also matches its royal theme. At the top, "Kuldeep and Vanshika" is written in a beautiful, golden, vintage nameplate-shaped design. An invitation tag is also attached to the card, on which a 'logo' has been created by combining the English letters 'k' and 'v' (Kuldeep and Vanshika), which ends in a heart shape. It is written in English on it- A Heartfelt Invitation From: Mr. Ram Singh Yadav, Mr. Kuldeep Singh Yadav Right below this, their Kanpur residence address - '381-D, Defence Colony, Jajmau, Kanpur' and phone number are written. Plates costing up to 20,000, fusion of Kanpuriya and Pahadi dishes Many VIP guests from the cricket and political world may attend the royal wedding. Therefore, the food menu has also been kept very special. According to Kuldeep's close associates, the food will reflect the culture of UP and Uttarakhand. Kuldeep hails from Kanpur, so the menu features a fusion of Kanpuriya-style flavours with Pahari (hill) cuisine. Keeping in mind guests from different states, more than 10 types of main courses and desserts have been prepared. The cost of a single meal (one plate) at the hotel is reportedly around ₹20 thousand. Royal Feast: What'll be on Kuldeep's wedding menu The hotel's special 'Platinum' and 'Gold' menus have been prepared for the guests. It will include both delicious vegetarian and non-vegetarian dishes. Highlights of the Platinum/Gold Non-Veg Menu- Snacks: 4 types of vegetarian and 4 types of non-vegetarian snacks will be served to guests (Gold menu will have 3 options each). Salad and Soup: There will be 8 types of premium salads with different dressings and an option of 1 veg and 1 non-veg soup. Main Course: 2 Non-Vegetarian Dishes, 2 Vegetarian Dishes, 1 Special Paneer Dish, 2 types of Dal and 2 types of Rice items will be served. Along with various Indian breads. Premium Beverage Menu The wedding bar menu includes the most expensive and premium liquor from India and abroad. Wedding budget will exceed ₹2 crore Hotel Package: A 2-day base package for over 100 guests and around 50 rooms starts from 70 lakh rupees (plus tax). Decoration: The cost of hotel decoration alone will be between 25 to 30 lakh rupees. Per Plate Cost: The price of one food plate (thali) has been set at 4,500 to 5,000 rupees (plus tax). The thali price can go up to 20 thousand. Total Estimate: Combining hotel booking, decoration, and other expenses, the total cost of this entire 3-day grand event is estimated to exceed 2 crore rupees. Guest Welcome and wedding theme Guests will be welcomed in a royal and grand manner at the wedding. The wedding decoration will feature a glimpse of the 'Rajputana Theme'. It includes special royal canopies and peacock design elements. Kuldeep is a Yaduvanshi, so there is also talk of adding some spiritual and traditional elements related to Radha-Krishna to the theme. This will give the wedding a special personal touch.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav meets Shankaracharya in Lucknow:Yogi Adityanath and SP chief trade sharp remarks over controversy cow campaign
stories.summary: SP chief Akhilesh Yadav met Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand in Lucknow on Thursday. Akhilesh greeted the saints present there with folded hands at the entrance. Former MP Anu Tandon was also present with him. Shankaracharya had begun his journey from Varanasi on March 7 and reached Lucknow on March 10, travelling through Jaunpur, Sultanpur and Sitapur over four days. On Wednesday, he launched the Cow-Establishment Public Awareness Campaign in the city. He is currently staying in Krishna Nagar. See 2 pictures Shankaracharya launches Cow-Establishment Public Awareness Campaign After announcing the Cow-Establishment Public Awareness Campaign in Lucknow, Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand addressed a gathering. He said, “This is not a liquor shop. This is a pure cow’s milk shop. If there had been a bigger crowd here, it would have meant it was a liquor shop. The smaller gathering here shows it is a pure cow’s milk shop.” He further remarked: “The BJP has now become Bhagpa (runners). If you were not true devotees of cows, you would not be sitting here despite so many obstacles. All of you who have come here should register your names after the programme ends, as you will be the founding members of this campaign. Yogi and Akhilesh exchange sharp remarks over Shankaracharya issue The Shankaracharya controversy has also triggered a political war of words between Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath and SP chief Akhilesh Yadav. Last month in the Assembly, CM Yogi said, “Not everyone can write Shankaracharya before their name. Not everyone can roam around as an Acharya and disturb the atmosphere. If he was Shankaracharya, then why did your (SP’s) government lathi-charge him in Varanasi? Why was an FIR filed?” The Chief Minister added that an issue that did not exist during the Magh Mela was deliberately created. He said, “Can anyone roam around the entire state claiming to be the Chief Minister? Can anyone put up a board and call themselves a minister? Can anyone declare themselves SP president? No… there is a system and an order.” Akhilesh hits back at CM Yogi Responding to the remarks, Akhilesh Yadav criticised the Chief Minister. He said, “What kind of Yogi is he? Who gave him the certificate of being a Yogi? In Hindu tradition, saffron robes are always respected. But the Yogi who is our Chief Minister does not show respect.” Akhilesh further said, “You do not become a Yogi simply by wearing saffron clothes and piercing your ears. Our revered Shankaracharya, whom everyone respects, was not allowed to bathe. Since ancient times, no one has stopped saints from bathing in the Ganga. He is the first to stop them, and he will incur sin for it.”

stories.title: IIT Roorkee to host Cognizance 2026 from Mar 13–15:Asia’s 2nd-largest technical festival expected to draw over 25,000 participants from 3,000 colleges
stories.summary: The Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) will host Cognizance 2026, its flagship annual technical festival, from March 13 to March 15, bringing together thousands of young innovators, technologists and creative thinkers from across the country for three days of innovation, competition and collaboration. The 3-day festival is expected to attract more than 25,000 participants from more than 3,000 colleges, offering them an opportunity to engage with cutting-edge technologies, interdisciplinary challenges, and real-world innovation ecosystems. Widely recognised as Asia’s second-largest technical festival, Cognizance has long served as a dynamic platform for technological exploration, collaborative learning and innovation-driven competition. Theme: ‘Empyrean Technogenesis’ The 2026 edition is themed ‘Empyrean Technogenesis,’ reflecting the transformative role of technology in shaping the future of society. Organised entirely by students of IIT Roorkee, Cognizance has evolved into one of Asia’s largest student-driven technical festivals, promoting a culture of creativity, innovation and technological excellence. More than 50 competitions and a ₹50 lakh prize pool Cognizance 2026 will feature over 50 competitions and technical events, including flagship contests such as Armageddon, Flight Fury, Scythe CTF, and InnovWave. These events are designed to test participants’ creativity, engineering expertise and problem-solving abilities. With an overall prize pool exceeding ₹50 lakh, the festival aims to encourage young innovators to push the boundaries of technological advancement. Industry workshops and expert sessions The festival will also host more than 15 industry-led workshops and expert sessions conducted by leading organisations, including Microsoft, Myntra, Meesho and American Express. These sessions will provide participants with exposure to emerging technologies, industry insights and entrepreneurial opportunities. Cognizance 2026 is supported by partners and initiatives such as Make in India, Skill India, HiLabs, JioSaavn, The Coca-Cola Company and BenQ, highlighting strong industry–academia collaboration. Focus on social impact Beyond technological competitions, Cognizance 2026 will also emphasise social responsibility and community engagement. Initiatives during the festival will promote awareness of environmental sustainability, menstrual health and rural education, encouraging participants to apply technology for meaningful societal impact. Leadership speaks Prof. Kamal Kishore Pant, director of IIT Roorkee, said the festival reflects the institute’s spirit of innovation and technological excellence. “Cognizance represents the spirit of innovation, curiosity and technological excellence that defines IIT Roorkee. By bringing together young innovators, industry leaders and academic experts, the festival creates an ecosystem where ideas evolve into impactful solutions. Events such as Cognizance play an important role in nurturing future-ready talent and advancing India’s technological aspirations,” he said. Prof. Barjeev Tyagi, dean of students’ welfare at IIT Roorkee, said the event has grown into one of the country’s most dynamic student-driven technology festivals. “The 2026 edition, themed ‘Empyrean Technogenesis,’ offers a vibrant platform for young innovators to collaborate, exchange ideas and engage with emerging technologies that will shape the future of society,” Tyagi said. Pro-nights to add entertainment Adding to the excitement, the festival will feature its much-anticipated Pro-Nights, offering high-energy performances and entertainment. Previous editions have hosted renowned artists such as Jubin Nautiyal, Amit Trivedi, Mohit Chauhan and Guru Randhawa, making Cognizance a celebration that blends technology, creativity and culture. Invitation to innovators nationwide Cognizance 2026 invites technology enthusiasts, innovators and students from across India to participate in this dynamic celebration of ideas, innovation and technological excellence.

stories.title: Navy personnel sent warship details to Pakistan:Money transferred to Adarsh’s account; villagers say, “He cannot betray the country”
stories.summary: UP ATS has arrested Adarsh Kumar alias Lucky from Agra. Adarsh is a navy personnel in the Indian Navy and is accused of spying for Pakistan’s intelligence agency ISI. He allegedly sent photos and details of Indian warships to ISI handlers. After being produced in court, Adarsh was sent to 14 days’ judicial custody. According to ATS sources, around three years ago Adarsh befriended a girl named “Ashi” on Instagram. Investigators say the account actually belonged to an ISI handler, who created the fake profile to trap him. As their conversations increased, the two exchanged phone numbers and began regular communication. Through WhatsApp, Ashi allegedly obtained photos and sensitive details of Indian warships, while money was transferred to Adarsh’s bank account in return. ATS had been tracking him for 18 months About one-and-a-half years ago, ATS detained some suspects during another investigation. During questioning, Adarsh Kumar’s name surfaced. Since then, ATS had been keeping him under surveillance. When investigators felt that Adarsh had fallen deeply into the honeytrap, they moved in and arrested him. Joined Navy in 2021, recently got married Adarsh joined the Indian Navy in 2021 and was posted at the Southern Naval Command in Kochi, Kerala. He had married just 22 days ago. According to sources, he went to Dubai for his honeymoon and had returned three days ago. However, his father claims that his son had gone to Manali, not Dubai. Questions in the village after arrest After Adarsh’s arrest, many questions have arisen in his native village Chitpur in Kagaraul, located about 38 km from Agra headquarters. What is the atmosphere in the village after the arrest? How was his behaviour with villagers earlier? What do people think about him now? What do family members say, and where is the woman he married recently? To find answers to these questions, a Dainik Bhaskar team visited Chitpur village and spoke to villagers and family members. Read the report... Situation in village There is silence in the village after Adarsh’s arrest. When the Bhaskar team reached the village, a few people were seen standing outside a house, discussing the incident and talking about Adarsh Kumar. Villagers say it is difficult for them to believe the allegations. “How could Adarsh do this?” many asked. According to them, he used to interact with everyone in the village and was known as a simple and straightforward person. Several villagers said they cannot believe that Adarsh Kumar, also known as Lucky, could betray the country. A villager, Prakash, said Adarsh Kumar is the youngest member of his family. He completed his high school and intermediate education from SG Public School in Akola, located about 10 km from his home. Now know the condition of Adarsh Kumar's house... At the other end of the village near the pond is Balveer Chahar's 2-story concrete house. In this house, Balveer lives in a joint family with his three brothers. Adarsh Kumar aka Lucky is Balveer Chahar's son. He has three elder sisters. Balveer Chahar's two other brothers Samudra Singh and Kishore Singh also live in this house. Balveer Singh works at the liquor shop with his brother Samudra Singh. Kishore Singh works in the dairy business. After Adarsh Kumar was caught on charges of treason against the country, all people are confined to their homes. No family member is stepping outside the house. Family members only come out of their rooms after peeking through the window to check if anyone is around. The extent of the family's embarrassment is such that the milk tanks haven't been removed from the bike yet. These tanks haven't been washed for 2 days. No family member is meeting with villagers. Since ATS arrested Adarsh Kumar, his wife has been confined to the house. Now the father's statement, read what he said? Father said - My son is being framed 28 hours after his son's arrest, Adarsh Kumar's father Balvir Singh Chahar appeared before the media. On Wednesday afternoon, he said - We had dedicated our son to protect the country. He is now being implicated as part of some conspiracy. My son is innocent. This should be investigated impartially. We are a farming family. We are living accordingly. They can check our accounts if they want. We have checked our son's accounts too, there are no large amounts deposited in his account either. We can be investigated. If we have invested money anywhere, it will come to light. Our accounts can also be investigated. Now read what villagers are saying Adarsh cannot be a Pakistani agent Village resident Manish Chahar says - I am a conductor in Roadways. Adarsh used to go to Agra for coaching sitting with me in the bus. Adarsh cannot do this. If he had received money in exchange for sending information, why would he live a normal life? Everything at home is also normal. His lifestyle, food habits are completely normal. One day after Adarsh's wedding, I needed some money. I asked Adarsh for 2 thousand rupees. Then Adarsh had said that he didn't even have money to go join a job. If he had black money, he would have given it. Adarsh was so straightforward that he cannot be a Pakistani agent. He is being framed. No change was visible in Adarsh Village resident Pawan Kumar said - Adarsh is just like other boys from the village. He gets along with everyone. Even after getting the job, there was no change in him. Adarsh and his family are the same as they were before. Jaipal Singh said that Adarsh Kumar is a very simple and straightforward boy. No complaints have ever been received about him in the village. He was very sharp in studies. He got a job in the Navy based on his capabilities. ATS arrested him after returning from honeymoon Adarsh Kumar got married on February 19 to a girl from Vishavar, Mathura. The wedding ceremony was held at Suraj Garden in Adarsh's village Kagaraul. After Holi, he went to Kullu-Manali for his honeymoon. He had just returned on Monday. On Tuesday, ATS apprehended him. When were spies caught from Agra? March 14, 2025: Ravindra Kumar (Ordnance Factory Employee) Caught by: UP ATS Charges: Sending defense-related confidential information after falling into the honeytrap of a Pakistani woman handler. March 14, 2025: An associate of Ravindra Kumar is also in custody Charge: Helping share sensitive information with the ISI handler. September 27, 2023: Shailesh Kumar Arrested by: UP ATS Charge: Contacting the ISI handler through Facebook and sharing information about army activities. Common pattern in all cases - Most cases involve contact through social media (Facebook/WhatsApp) - Many cases involve honeytraps or financial incentives - Targets are often defense establishment employees or people with access to sensitive information
