stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj attacked in moving train:Claims attacker tried to cut his nose; blames Shankaracharya’s disciple for assault
stories.summary: Ashutosh Maharaj, who had filed an FIR alleging sexual harassment of batuks against Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, was reportedly attacked in a moving train on Sunday. According to Ashutosh Maharaj, he was travelling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express and was seated in the First AC coach. He said that at around 5 am, when the train was near Sirathu railway station, he got up to go to the toilet. A man was standing near the door outside. Assault with sharp weapon Ashutosh Maharaj said that when he moved ahead, the attacker suddenly assaulted him from behind. The assailant allegedly tried to cut his nose with a sharp weapon and repeatedly struck his face and hands. He sustained serious injuries and lost a considerable amount of blood. According to Ashutosh Brahmachari, he somehow managed to escape and locked himself inside the train’s toilet to save his life. From there, he called the Government Railway Police (GRP) and reported the incident. FIR registered, investigation begins Ashutosh Maharaj has held Swami Avimukteshwaranand, his disciple Mukundanand and others responsible for the attack. Acting on the complaint, the GRP has registered an FIR and begun an investigation into the matter. Shankaracharya rejects allegations Responding to the accusations, Shankaracharya said the incident was merely a drama. According to him, Ashutosh was making such claims to create an atmosphere and obtain security protection. He said the allegations against him were intended only to attract media attention and divert focus from the ongoing journey. Ashutosh Maharaj hits back Shortly afterwards, Ashutosh Maharaj responded sharply to the Shankaracharya’s remarks. He said every drop of blood would be avenged through legal means. He claimed the attacker had said that his nose would be cut and offered at the feet of his 'guru'. Ashutosh said they would fight the matter through the law. Rejecting the counter-claims, he said it was absurd to suggest that someone would stage an attack on themselves and added that the Shankaracharya should try getting his own nose cut to understand..

stories.title: Two brothers killed YouTuber Salim Wastik over his controversial videos:3-min struggle leaves YouTuber with 14 wounds; attackers flee, later killed in police encounters
stories.summary: February 27, 2026, Friday. At 7:30 AM, Zeeshan and Gulfam reached the Loni area of Ghaziabad. They attacked ex-Muslim Salim Wastik (YouTuber). One had a paper cutter, the other had a knife. The entire attempt was to behead. The struggle continued for 3.5 minutes. Salim suffered 14 serious wounds on his neck, stomach, back, and chest. During this time, a woman arrived and raised an alarm. At this, both attackers fled. Pictures appeared in the Telegram group, stating that Salim, an Ex-Muslim, has been taken to the hospital. Both kept a fast the next day. Police identified both based on CCTV, vehicle numbers, and presence at the scene. When the search began, a confrontation occurred. Police killed Zeeshan in an encounter on March 1 and Gulfam on March 3. How was this incident planned? Who was behind the planning? Why did Zeeshan want rights to the Babri Masjid? Read Sunday Big Story... Salim left Islam and became an atheist 7 years ago Ghaziabad's Salim Vastik's original home is in Shamli district. 20 years ago, he left Shamli and settled in the Ashok Vihar area of Loni in Ghaziabad. Besides him, his family includes his wife and his son, Usman Khan. Salim previously worked in construction-related work. He also worked as a Maulvi for some time. Later, he became disillusioned with Islam. He left Islam and added 'Vastik' to his name. Salim bought land about one and a half kilometers away from his house in Ali Garden Colony, then built a house there. He opened his office in it and started working there. Salim had agreements with different TV channels, where he used to go for religious debates. He would debate there as an ex-Muslim. He would discuss matters related to Islam. Later, he created his YouTube channel and would comment about Islam on it. Misconduct in Jammu-Kashmir, Channel Deleted On April 22, 2025, a terrorist attack occurred in the Basran Valley of Pahalgam in Anantnag district of Jammu-Kashmir. 26 tourists were killed after being asked about their religion. This incident was condemned worldwide. Salim reached Jammu-Kashmir with his companions Aamir and Ahsan. They protested against this incident there. They spoke with some media personnel. They talked about boycotting Kashmir. Because of this, they became targets of local people. They were beaten up, and their social media accounts were forced to be deleted. Salim complained about this to the Jammu and Kashmir Police, but the police took no action. After this, Salim returned to Ghaziabad. He complained to the police here, but the police did not take action, saying it was a Kashmir matter. After this, Salim created another channel in his own name. Regarding the Pahalgam attack, Salim had said to a news channel - If we speak from our perspective, this was wrong. It is a terrorist attack, it is against humanity. But, if we look from Islam's perspective, they have done a virtuous deed. This is the work of Shabab. After the Kashmir incident, Salim became a target of extremists. On the other hand, Salim also started making more aggressive videos compared to before. At the beginning of the videos, he would often use offensive words. He would talk about Halala, Hadith, and Triple Talaq. While discussing these topics, he would quote verses from the Quran. Many people from the Muslim community would write abusive comments and give threats on these videos. They offered prayers before going to attack Salim Zeeshan (23) and Gulfam (42), who attacked Salim Wastik (50), were residents of Saidnagli town in Amroha. Their father, Buniyad Ali, works with wood. Both of them also did the same work. In Buniyad's family, besides these two sons, there are 5 daughters. Buniyad Ali has gotten all of them married. Gulfam was the eldest, and Zeeshan was the youngest. In 2013, Gulfam left Amroha and settled in the Khoda area of Ghaziabad. Here he lived in a rented room at the house of a person named Ali Hasan in Mangal Bazaar. After 2021, Zeeshan also went to Ghaziabad to join Gulfam. He worked in a company. Zeeshan studied at a local madrasa in Amroha. Then he passed 12th from a nearby inter-college. He grew a beard. He started actively participating in Islamic programs. He would make videos on social media, talking about Islam. In one video, he had talked about claiming rights to the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. When Gulfam and Zeeshan would watch Salim's videos, they would become red with anger. Both brothers were also connected to some WhatsApp and Telegram groups. They would comment there. The other people there would talk about beheading. According to police sources, these two brothers had planned to kill Salim just 15 days ago. For this, they had chosen the holy month of Ramadan and Friday. On the morning of February 27, both were in their rented room. They had offered Fajr prayer (morning prayer) at 5:30 in the morning. Focus was on killing Salim by slitting his throat After this, Zeeshan and Gulfam took out their cousin's KTM bike. They reached Ali Garden Colony about 20 kilometers away. Both of them knew about both Salim's house and office. They knew when he came and went, at what time. At 7:54 in the morning, both reached Salim's office. At that time, Salim was lying on the sofa watching videos on his mobile. Both brothers went inside. Zeeshan first took out a paper cutter, and then Gulfam also took out a knife. Both brothers were focused entirely on Salim's throat. They both wanted to cut Salim's throat with full force. Salim was continuously screaming. During this, Gulfam says to Zeeshan, 'Kill him, don't be afraid.' After this, Zeeshan picked up a glass table lying there and broke it. Then he launched repeated attacks on Salim with his sharp pieces. The glass from the table got embedded in Salim's back. The CCTV footage that has emerged is 3 minutes and 39 seconds long. Zeeshan and Gulfam were still inside at that time. Sent attack photos to group, then went home After the attack, both took photos and videos of Salim suffering. They sent it to their people. The same picture also appeared on a Telegram channel called Muslim Army. This group has more than 18,300 members. It contained two photos. One was a smiling photo of Salim, with text below saying - Ex-Muslim Salim, treatment video coming soon... After the attack, another picture came where Salim was badly injured. Its caption read - Salim, an ex-Muslim, has been taken to the hospital. Want the full video? Many people in this comment group reacted to this. Zeeshan and Gulfam left Salim's office after carrying out the incident. In this attack, Zeeshan's finger was also slightly cut. This caused blood to get on the clothes. Both went back towards their room. However, on the way, a person recorded a video of these two, considering them suspicious. This video came to light later. After reaching the room, both brothers changed their clothes. Then they reached their home in Saidnagali in Amroha by bike. Here, the elder brother, Gulfam, stayed for some time. Then he went back to Ghaziabad by bike. While, Zeeshan stayed in the village. He fasted the whole day and had iftar with the family in the evening. He took leave every Friday, so the family did not suspect Zeeshan was religiously orthodox. That's why he took leave on Friday instead of Sunday. He came home every week. Therefore, family members did not suspect that he had come after attacking someone. The next day, Zeeshan kept another fast. After the morning prayer, he caught a bus to Ghaziabad. In the afternoon, he talked to his mother on the phone and spoke about offering prayers. On the other hand, after this high-profile incident, 10 police teams were formed. 70 personnel were engaged in searching for Salim's attackers. Crime Branch and STF also became active. A total of 210 CCTVs were examined. The mobile network was investigated at the scene. By February 28, police had discovered that this incident was carried out by Zeeshan and Gulfam. On the night of March 1, both were seen coming in the Loni area itself. When Station In-charge Nitin Chaudhary tried to stop them, firing broke out. About 25 to 30 rounds were fired in 15 minutes. Zeeshan was hit by one bullet in the chest and one in the leg. However, Gulfam escaped. Police took Zeeshan to the hospital, where doctors declared him dead. On March 3, police surrounded Gulfam in the Indirapuram police station area. He also opened fire. However, he was killed in retaliatory police firing. This means both brothers were killed in police encounters within 48 hours. Gulfam was hot-tempered, Zeeshan was calm but cunning Upon talking to people living near their homes in Amroha, it was revealed that Gulfam had an angry temperament. Whereas Zeeshan remained calm. He actively participated in Islamic religious events. He would collect donations in the neighborhood. He made Islamic videos on social media. There are also discussions that both of them used to attend the Jamaat. They would meet Muslims coming from different countries across the world. The way Salim was attacked, 2 similar murders have taken place in the last few years. First- Umesh Kolhe was murdered in Amravati, Maharashtra. On June 21, 2022, 54-year-old Umesh had posted in a WhatsApp group supporting BJP spokesperson Nupur Sharma's comments on Prophet Muhammad. This became the main reason. Yusuf, associated with Tabligi Jamaat, killed Umesh Kolhe by slitting his throat in the middle of the road. Umesh had known Yusuf for 16 years. Umesh had also helped in Yusuf's wedding. Police had arrested 10 more people in this case. Second- Just 7 days after the murder of Umesh Kolhe, Kanhaiya Lal Teli was murdered in the Udaipur district of Rajasthan. Gaus Mohammad and Mohammad Riyaz came on a bike and started making a video. After this, both of them slit Kanhaiya's throat and killed him. Kanhaiya had posted a comment by Nupur Sharma on his Facebook. This became the reason for his murder, too. Both main accused are in jail. NIA is handling this case. Court had objected to 'Sar Tan Se Juda' This slogan of 'Sar Tan Se Juda' has been going on in the country for a long time. However, after the Nupur Sharma case came up in 2022, it started being chanted continuously. There was violence in Bareilly, and slogans were raised. This slogan was also raised there. The situation became such that the Allahabad High Court had to object to this slogan. The single bench of Judge Arun Kumar Singh Deshwal had rejected the bail application of Rehan, who was arrested during the violent protest in Bareilly. The judge said - Such violent slogans raised in the name of Islam are completely contrary to Prophet Muhammad's ideals. If a follower of Islam raises slogans about beheading someone for insulting the Prophet, it is an insult to the Prophet Muhammad's ideals. This slogan is not connected to India's cultural, legal, and religious traditions. It is influenced by blasphemy laws and violent incidents in the neighboring country. The judge had said - Religious slogans like Jai Shri Ram and Nara-e-Takbir are not a crime if they are not being used to intimidate someone or incite violence. However, if they are being used to incite violence, then it is wrong. Maulana said - What happened was wrong, religious comments should not have been made Darul Uloom's Firangi Mahal spokesperson, Maulana Sufyan Nizami, says - Whatever happened was wrong. However, the law does not give anyone the right to speak inappropriately about anyone's religion. What Salim was saying fills people with anger. Educated people respond like educated people, but those who are uneducated, or let's say those who are instigated, become violent. Sufyan says that we need to ensure that the administration takes timely action against those who speak inappropriately about any religion. However, even after the encounter of Zeeshan and Gulfam, the police investigation has not ended yet. Efforts are being made to get to the bottom of this case. Their Pakistan connections are being investigated. Attempts are being made to contact people present in that Telegram group.

stories.title: Brick kiln worker’s son becomes IAS:Vimal Kumar from Raebareli secures 107th rank in UPSC; celebrates with 7-km procession
stories.summary: Ramdev’s son Vimal Kumar, who worked at a brick kiln in Raebareli, has become an IAS officer, securing 107th rank in UPSC. To celebrate his success, Vimal led a 7-kilometre procession with a convoy. His convoy included 12 cars, a DJ system and more than 50 bikes. People welcomed Vimal at several places and garlanded him with flowers. Father Ramdev’s eyes welled up with tears at his son’s achievement. Speaking about his success, Vimal Kumar said, “A DM madam once visited Navodaya Vidyalaya. That’s when I decided to become an IAS officer.” To keep expenses low, he took online classes three times while staying in the village. Read Vimal Kumar’s journey to becoming an IAS officer. First see 3 pictures... Ramdev lives in Chandemau village of Khiro block in Raebareli district. He has 3 sons and 2 daughters. Vimal Kumar (30) is the youngest son. On his son becoming an IAS, Ramdev says - Very happy. I educated my son by working as a laborer at brick kilns and doing sharecropping. Dainik Bhaskar team reached Chandemau village, 32 kilometers away from district headquarters. At that time, Vimal Kumar was seated in a car. Family members and villagers were showering flowers on him. DJ was playing in the background. As Vimal's convoy moved forward, more cars and bikes joined the procession. Gradually, more than 12 cars and over 50 bikes joined the convoy. People kept stopping Vimal to shower flowers and garland him. The 7-kilometer procession lasted for about 2 hours. After this, the village locals brought Vimal Kumar home. The number of well-wishers at home was continuously increasing. We spoke with Vimal's elder brother Ajit Kumar. Ajit says - the family's financial condition is very modest. I myself work as a laborer in Raebareli. Despite financial constraints, we never let any obstacles come in the way of Vimal's education. We continuously encouraged him. Vimal's sister-in-law says - this success has come after many struggles. There were many difficulties and obstacles at home, but Vimal did not give up his goal. He had come during Holi. When the result came yesterday, he said "Bhabhi, my result is out. I have been selected." Buffaloes tied at the door, house was recently plastered Vimal's house is half permanent and half temporary. There are 5 rooms, out of which only 2 are permanent. Vimal's elder brother has gone abroad to earn, which has improved the financial condition of the house. After this, the front part of the house has been plastered. Two buffaloes are tied outside their house. Besides this, there is a fodder cutting machine and hay stored. From village primary school to IIT Family members say, “Vimal Kumar completed his early education from the village primary school Chandemau. After this, he was selected in Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya Maharajganj. He studied there till 10th class. For further studies, he went to Kerala and then reached Delhi for higher education.” In 2020, Vimal Kumar obtained his B.Tech degree from IIT Delhi. After this, he started preparing for UPSC examination. He did not take help from any big coaching institute for this. He mostly prepared through self-study while staying in Raebareli. Vimal explains - Appeared for UPSC exam continuously from 2021 to 2025. Continued preparation without coaching even during the Corona pandemic. In the first 4 attempts, reached the interview stage but couldn't get final selection. Even after this, I didn't give up. Prepared while staying in Lucknow and cleared the interview in the 5th attempt. This time I got 107th rank. Did online preparation, faced failure for 4 years Vimal Kumar says - Online preparation reduced expenses. I faced failure continuously for 4 years. Last year (in 2024) I gave the interview, where I missed selection by 12 marks. Felt very discouraged after failing. Despite this, I didn't give up. Tried once again and passed. Vimal Kumar says - Regular study, discipline and proper use of time is the real key to success. stories.title: UP SI exam question sparks controversy:'Pandit' listed among options for 'One who changes with circumstances'
stories.summary: A question asked in the Uttar Pradesh Police Sub-Inspector (SI) recruitment examination has triggered a controversy. The question asked candidates: “What would you call a person who changes according to circumstances?” The options given were virtuous, pandit, opportunist, and innocent. The question appeared as Question No. 31 in the General Hindi section of the exam. BJP leader complains to CM Yogi BJP state secretary Abhijaat Mishra wrote to Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath, objecting to the question. He said including the word “pandit” among the options hurt the sentiments of a particular community. At the same time, a fake question paper related to the SI recruitment exam went viral on social media. In this connection, seven FIRs were registered at Lucknow’s Hussainganj police station on March 13 and 14. Issue reaches BJP central leadership According to sources, the matter has reached the BJP’s central leadership. At the Uttar Pradesh BJP office, party officials discussed the issue in the presence of state president Pankaj Chaudhary and said the question was inappropriate. Some leaders said repeated mistakes by officials were affecting the party’s image among the public. Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak objects Uttar Pradesh Deputy Chief Minister Brajesh Pathak also objected to the question. He said if any question or option in an examination hurts the dignity of any community or group, it is unacceptable. He added that no examination should include words or references that disrespect any caste, community, or tradition. Strict security at examination centres Candidates were subjected to three-layer security checks before entering examination centres across the state on Saturday. Entry was allowed only with admit cards and identity proof. Mobile phones of police personnel on duty were also deposited, and CCTV cameras monitored the centres. In Varanasi, male candidates were asked to remove their shoes, socks, and belts, while sacred threads tied on wrists were cut. Female candidates were asked to remove jewellery, bangles, toe rings, and earrings before entering the exam halls. In Ambedkar Nagar, two youths died in a road accident while travelling for the exam. One of them was scheduled to appear for the test, while the other was taking his sister to the centre. STF arrests accused in fake paper racket The Uttar Pradesh Special Task Force (STF) arrested an accused named Ayush from Agra for allegedly selling fake question papers. During questioning, he told investigators that the group edited old question papers to make them appear genuine. These were shared on Telegram channels, and candidates were asked to make online payments to obtain them. Recruitment exam across 75 districts The SI recruitment examination is being conducted over two days — March 14 and 15 — in two shifts. The first shift runs from 10 am to 12 noon, and the second shift from 3 pm to 5 pm. The Uttar Pradesh Police Recruitment and Promotion Board has set up 1,090 examination centres across all 75 districts. A total of 4,543 posts will be filled through the recruitment process. Board dismisses viral paper as fake The recruitment board said on social media platform X that the viral question paper was misleading and unrelated to the examination. It added that legal action would be taken against platforms and individuals spreading such misinformation and advised candidates not to fall for such claims.

stories.title: Fraud in name of UP SI exam paper leak:STF arrests youth from Agra; scam run through Telegram channel
stories.summary: The Special Task Force (STF) has arrested a youth from Agra for allegedly cheating candidates in the name of leaking the Uttar Pradesh Police Sub-Inspector Recruitment Examination-2025 paper. The accused was claiming to provide the question paper for the UP Police Sub-Inspector (SI) and Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) recruitment exam through a Telegram channel and allegedly duping candidates. The STF said that social media platforms were being monitored regarding the UP Police Sub-Inspector and equivalent recruitment exam-2025, scheduled to be held on March 14–15, 2026. During this monitoring, information was received that messages were going viral on Telegram through a channel named “1- UP SI UP POLICE-2026 @ Result PANEL PVT TM (3) – UP SI EXAM PAPER UP SI-2026”, claiming to provide the exam question paper. Fake PDF used to cheat candidates Investigation revealed that candidates preparing for competitive examinations were being lured through the channel and asked to pay money. The accused allegedly edited a PDF file to prepare a fake question paper and sent it to candidates claiming it to be the original exam paper. By doing so, the accused first tried to gain the trust of candidates and then collected large sums through online payments. Accused arrested from Agra During surveillance, the STF team arrested Ayush Baghel, a resident of 8/188 Engineers Colony under New Agra police station, on March 13, 2026. A mobile phone was recovered from his possession. Operated several Telegram channels During interrogation, the accused revealed that he, along with some associates, created multiple Telegram channels to lure candidates by promising access to question papers of competitive examinations. He used to add people to the channels and claim that he would provide the exam paper before the test. He then sent an edited PDF file claiming it to be the real question paper. The accused also admitted that he had already taken money from several candidates through online payments and had shared some of the amount with his associates. Case registered in Lucknow A case has been registered at Hasanganj police station in Lucknow. Further legal action is being taken against the arrested accused, and efforts are underway to trace his other associates.

stories.title: Allahabad HC slams Sambhal administration:Says resign if unable to handle law and order; objects to limit on mosque prayers
stories.summary: The Allahabad High Court has strongly reprimanded the Sambhal District Magistrate (DM) and Superintendent of Police (SP) for limiting the number of people allowed to offer prayers at a mosque. The court said the administration cannot restrict the number of worshippers at a mosque. It added that if DM Rajendra Pensia and SP KK Vishnoi feel they cannot manage law and order, they should resign or seek transfer. A division bench of Justice Atul Sridharan and Justice Siddharth Nandan made the observations while hearing a petition filed by a local resident. Court: State must ensure peaceful worship The bench said it is the duty of the state to ensure that people of every community can worship peacefully at designated places of worship. The court also clarified that if a religious place is on private property, no permission from the state is required for offering prayers. State intervention is necessary only when religious activities are organised on public land. Petition claims police limited worshippers Petitioner Munazir Khan told the court that police from Hayatnagar police station visited the mosque in February and ordered that only 20 people could offer prayers there. He alleged that officers also said only five to six people should pray at a time. Khan later filed a petition in the High Court on January 18, 2026. The first hearing was held on February 27, and the court order was uploaded on Saturday. The next hearing is scheduled for March 16. Government cites law and order concerns During the hearing, the petitioner argued that he was being prevented from offering prayers at the mosque during Ramadan, when a large number of people gather for prayers. The government lawyer told the court that the administration had restricted the number of worshippers to prevent possible law and order problems. However, the court rejected this argument. Court seeks photographs and records The bench noted that the petitioner had not yet submitted photographs of the mosque or the prayer area. On the petitioner’s request, the court allowed time to submit photographs and revenue records related to the land. These documents must be filed before the next hearing on March 16. 450 sq ft mosque in Hayatnagar village According to records placed before the court, the Ghosia mosque in Hayatnagar village is built on a 450-square-foot plot. Around 2,700 people live in the village. The administration said the land falls under gata number 291 and is recorded in the names of Mohan Singh and Bhuraj Singh, son of Sukhi Singh. The petitioner argued that a large number of people gather at the mosque during Ramadan, and restricting the number of worshippers is unfair. High Court earlier summoned Bareilly officials In a separate case, the High Court earlier summoned the District Magistrate and Senior Superintendent of Police (SSP) of Bareilly to appear in person on March 23. The court warned that non-bailable warrants would be issued if they failed to appear. It also directed authorities to provide 24-hour armed security to the petitioner. The order was passed by the same bench of Justice Atul Sridharan and Justice Siddharth Nandan. Petition over prayer inside house The case relates to a petition filed by Bareilly resident Tariq Khan, who alleged that local authorities stopped him from offering namaz inside his house on January 16. He argued that the action violated an earlier High Court order which clearly stated that administrative permission is not required for prayers held on private property. During the previous hearing, the court had issued contempt notices to the Bareilly DM and SSP for allegedly violating its earlier directions.

stories.title: ‘Congress ignored Dalits, now wants Bharat Ratna for Kanshi Ram’:Mayawati taunts Rahul Gandhi’s praise for socialist leader
stories.summary: BSP supremo Mayawati has strongly criticised Congress leader Rahul Gandhi. On Saturday, she said the Congress party, whose alleged anti-Dalit mindset led to the formation of the Bahujan Samaj Party, had not even declared national mourning when Kanshi Ram died. Now, the same party is talking about awarding him the Bharat Ratna, she said, adding that people should remain cautious of Congress. The reaction came after Congress organised a programme in Lucknow on Friday to mark Kanshi Ram’s birth anniversary, reportedly for the first time. During the event, a proposal was passed demanding that Kanshi Ram be awarded the Bharat Ratna. The party also decided that Rahul Gandhi would raise this demand in Parliament. At the programme, Rahul Gandhi said Kanshi Ram had always spoken about equality in society. He added that if Jawaharlal Nehru were alive today, Kanshi Ram would have been a Congress Chief Minister. Rahul also alleged that the Bharatiya Janata Party has divided society into the ‘15 and 85’ categories, claiming that only 15% of people are benefiting while the remaining majority has been sidelined. Read Mayawati's important statements... 1- Congress never honored Baba Saheb Mayawati wrote on X, Everyone knows that the Congress party remained in power at the center for a long time, but they never gave respect to the messiah of Dalits and the architect of the Indian Constitution, Baba Saheb Dr. Bhimrao Ambedkar. Nor did they honor him with Bharat Ratna. In such a situation, the question arises, how can the same Congress party now give Bharat Ratna to Kanshi Ram? 2- Congress did not declare national mourning on Kanshi Ram's death The former Chief Minister said that the Congress government did not declare even one day of national mourning on Kanshi Ram's death. At that time SP government was in Uttar Pradesh, and they also did not declare any state mourning. Similarly, many Dalit organizations and parties formed under the influence of other parties have also been trying to take only political advantage of his name. 3- Parties are trying to weaken BSP by adopting tactics Mayawati said, ‘Today different parties are engaged in weakening BSP by adopting various tactics’. Therefore, their followers and supporters need to remain alert. 4- Need to be cautious of Congress party The BSP supremo said, ‘We need to be cautious of the Congress party, because BSP had to be formed due to its anti-Dalit thinking’. I appeal to my workers to make the programs organized on Kanshi Ram Jayanti on March 15, 2026, successful across the country, including UP. Professor raises questions, says, ‘Congress should give cream posts to Dalits where they are in power’ Prof. Vivek Kumar at JNU said that Congress was in power in this country for more than 70 years, but they never remembered Dalits then. Today, when they are out of power, they are putting on an act of remembering Dalit great personalities. Why did Congress never promote any Dalit in the party? Why did Dr. Ambedkar have to leave Congress? Why didn't the condition of Dalits improve during their rule? Why did Kanshi Ram have to form a separate party for Dalits? Where Congress is in power, why aren't they placing Dalits in cream posts? The truth is that for them, Dalits are just a vote bank. Congress can make Dalits a ladder to power, but it will never let them sit on the throne of power. Understanding Dalit Voters' Strength in UP UP has 21%, Dalit voters. Out of the state's 403 assembly seats, 84 are reserved for SC. Additionally, there are 40-50 seats where Dalits make up 20% to 30% of voters. This means Dalits have a decisive influence on 130 seats in the state. In the 2022 assembly elections, the BJP and its allies won 63 out of 84 reserved seats. SP succeeded in 20 seats. 1 seat went to Raja Bhaiya's party, Jansatta Dal Loktantrik.

stories.title: Brahmins become key in SP politics after Muslim-Yadav base:UP leaders say community will regain respect if Akhilesh becomes CM
stories.summary: “Brahmins are afraid of the government’s dictatorial attitude. They should unite and make Akhilesh Yadav the Chief Minister in 2027; this will restore their lost respect.” - Mata Prasad Pandey, Leader of Opposition, March 9, Ayodhya. “There should be a holiday on Parshuram Jayanti on April 19. Akhilesh Yadav had declared it a state holiday, but the current government cancelled it. This has caused resentment among Brahmins.” — Kamal Akhtar, SP MLA, February 20, Assembly. These two statements show that, along with the M-Y (Muslim-Yadav) factor, Brahmin voters have also become central to the Samajwadi Party’s politics. First, the UGC guidelines and then the alleged insult of the Shankaracharya at the Magh Mela have brought Brahmin resentment into focus. Because of this, SP MPs and MLAs have begun speaking about Brahmin rights, from the Assembly to district tours. There appear to be two main reasons for this. First, during the protest after Shankaracharya’s palanquin was stopped at the Magh Mela, a Batuk was allegedly dragged by his hair. This incident was seen by many as an attack on Sanatan traditions. Second, since 2017, the BJP has relied heavily on upper-caste voters in UP politics. If Brahmins move away from the BJP, the SP could become stronger, and Akhilesh Yadav may move closer to the Chief Minister’s post. So the key questions are: Can Brahmin voters really shift away from the BJP? Can they support Akhilesh Yadav? And could the SP, which has largely relied on backwards-class politics, face any risks in this strategy? This report looks for answers to these questions. Read the report... SP benefited from PDA politics Since the 2022 UP assembly elections, SP president Akhilesh Yadav has been engaging in PDA politics, meaning Backwards, Dalit and Minority politics. This benefited him in the 2022 assembly elections. We can understand this in two ways... 1. Benefit in seats This means SP gained a direct benefit of 78 seats and became a strong opposition in the state. 2. Increase in Vote Share SP's vote share reached around 32%, whereas in 2017 SP had received 21.8% votes. This increase was attributed to the shift of OBC and Muslim votes, along with Dalit votes. Now learn how SP's graph increased in the Lok Sabha elections Why SP is changing strategy, read this SP fought the Lok Sabha elections-2024 with the strategy of PDA and preventing constitutional changes, and benefited from it. However, during the Magh Mela in UP on January 18, 2026, the administration stopped Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand from going to Ganga Ghat in a palanquin. After this, there was pushing and shoving and protests, and Shankaracharya himself sat on a dharna. Police forcibly separated the young priests. Images emerged of a young priest being pulled by his hair. This was the sequence of events that forced SP to change its strategy. Because, before this, upper caste voters were angry with the changes in UGC rules. Akhilesh Yadav's measured statements came in the UGC matter, as he did not want to upset OBC voters. However, in Shankaracharya's case, he personally spoke with Avimukteshwaranand. His MPs and MLAs are continuously attacking the Yogi government. Expert View Will the Brahmin equation work? Senior journalist and political affairs expert Rajendra Kumar says, ‘It is absolutely true that Brahmin voters are angry with the BJP on both these issues’ - Shankaracharya and UGC. Upper caste youth are blaming the BJP regarding UGC guidelines, as it is being said that this puts the careers of upper caste children at stake. Meanwhile, the Brahmin community considers the treatment of Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand inappropriate. Somewhere, this message has also reached people that all this is being done under politics. But then why is Sanatan being defamed? This question is also in people's minds. You can also see that first there was a meeting of Thakur MPs and MLAs in the name of the Kutumb family, and later there was also a meeting of Brahmin MLAs. If you look at it, the controversy happened after Brahmin community leaders gathered. Another factor is also at work, which is that Brahmin leaders have been marginalised in the BJP. This is why there is internal discontent among upper-caste voters. Not only SP but also BSP is trying to capitalise on this. Rajendra Kumar says, Now SP's MPs and MLAs are reminding people that SP never insulted Brahmins. Mulayam Singh always respected Janeshwar Mishra. In the current period, Akhilesh is not showing any lack of respect towards Mata Prasad Pandey. Election results show that Brahmins never sided with SP SP's core voters have been Muslim-Yadav (M-Y). Brahmin voters never voted for SP. In UP, the Brahmin voter base with a 10-12% share stood strongly with Congress until 2009 and then with the BJP. After coming to power in 2012, Akhilesh Yadav gave cabinet positions to Rajaram Pandey, Brahma Shankar Tripathi, Manoj Pandey, Vijay Mishra, Abhishek Mishra, and Shivkant Ojha. Currently, Mata Prasad Pandey from the Brahmin community has been made the Speaker of the Legislative Assembly. This position is considered equivalent to a Cabinet Minister, even while being in opposition. The largest park in Lucknow was built in the name of Janeshwar Mishra. Despite this, Brahmin voters never drifted away from the BJP, understand this from these figures... Read in detail what happened with Shankaracharya at Magh Mela... On January 18, at the Prayagraj Magh Mela, police stopped the palanquin of Shankaracharya Swami Avimukteshwaranand, who came for the Mauni Amavasya bath. Police asked him to walk to Sangam. Shankaracharya's disciples did not agree and started moving forward with the palanquin. This led to pushing and shoving between the disciples and the police. Police took several disciples into custody. Police beat up a sadhu at the police post. This angered Shankaracharya, and he insisted on getting the disciples released. The officers tried to reason with him, folded their hands, but he did not agree. The commotion continued for about 2 hours. After this, the police took several more supporters of Shankaracharya into custody. Shankaracharya's palanquin was pulled and taken 1 km away from the Sangam. During this, the canopy of the palanquin also broke. Shankaracharya could not even take a bath. After this, he remained on protest. The administration asked him to take a bath. However, later he returned to his monastery in Kashi without taking a bath. Why was there opposition to UGC's new rules? UGC notified its new rules on January 13. It is called 'Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions Regulations, 2026.' Under this, instructions were given to form special committees, helplines and monitoring teams to prevent caste-based discrimination in colleges and universities. These teams will specifically look into complaints from SC, ST and OBC students. The government said these changes were made to bring fairness and accountability to higher education institutions. However, there was opposition claiming the rules were against the general category. Critics said that upper caste students were made 'natural criminals'. General category students say that the new rules could promote discrimination against them in college or university campuses. This will create chaos in colleges. Considering the protests, the Supreme Court had asked the government to make changes to this notification.

stories.title: Temperature crosses 40°C in UP for first time this season:Rain-hail alert for next 2 days; storms to also occur
stories.summary: UP is experiencing severe heat. For the first time this season, the temperature has crossed 40 °C. Meanwhile, the weather department has issued an alert for bad weather for the next two days. During this time, there could be rain with storms in the eastern and western parts of the state. Some areas may also experience hail. The weather department says, ‘Besides snowfall in the mountains, a new western disturbance is becoming active’. This will change the weather in the state from March 15. Meanwhile, fog was seen for the fifth day in 10 districts, including Gorakhpur, on Saturday. Winds are blowing at speeds of 30-40 km/hour. With increasing daylight, people are seen huddled under scarves and umbrellas on roads due to intense sunlight. In the last 24 hours, Banda was the hottest city where the maximum temperature was recorded at 40.2 °C. The temperature reached 38.3 °C in Jhansi and 37.8 °C in Orai. Weather scientist Atul Kumar Singh said - There is a possibility of rain in the eastern and western regions of the state from March 15. During this time, winds will blow at speeds of 40-50 km/hour. Hail is also expected. The sudden change in weather will cause a drop in temperature. There will be a slight feeling of cold at night. Avoid going out in intense sunlight Doctors have advised people to avoid going out in strong sunlight during the afternoon hours and drink adequate water. The weather may have mixed effects for farmers. While light rain can be beneficial for crops, there are concerns about damage to standing crops from intense heat and winds. How will the weather be for the next 3 days... Another sudden reason for fog? Meteorologist Manoj Srivastava from Banaras Hindu University (BHU) explained - A low-pressure system has formed between Bihar and Marathwada. Due to this, fog-like conditions are forming in some parts of eastern Uttar Pradesh during morning hours. Wind is blowing close to the surface. Therefore, a slight drop in temperature has been observed, but the temperature will increase as the day progresses. They informed that due to the upcoming active western disturbance, temperatures across the state will gradually decrease from March 14. From March 15, light rain will occur for the first time this season in the Terai regions, along with some parts of Purvanchal. This period will continue for a few days. After that, temperatures will start rising. Heatwave could last for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures could remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities, and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the weather department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in the plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature recorded is 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected, and the risk of heat stroke increases.

stories.title: Badaun SSP Brajesh Singh removed after officers' murder:Kasganj SP Ankita Sharma transferred; 7 IPS transferred in UP
stories.summary: The UP government transferred 7 IPS and an equal number of senior IAS officers on Friday. New Superintendents of Police have been appointed in Badaun, Fatehpur, Kasganj, and Bhadohi districts. First about the IPS officers... 2 HPCL officers murdered, SSP sidelined After the broad daylight murder of 2 Hindustan Petroleum officers in Badaun a day ago, SSP Dr. Brijesh Kumar Singh has been removed from there. He has been sidelined and posted to logistics at police headquarters. Brijesh Singh became SSP of Badaun on June 24, 2024. He served there for nearly 2 years. Kasganj SP Ankita Sharma has been promoted. She has been made the new police captain of Badaun. Now know about the murder case... In Badaun on Thursday, Hindustan Petroleum's DGM Sudhir Gupta (55) and Assistant Manager Harshit Mishra (35) were shot dead. The accused Ajay Singh was half-encountered by the police on Friday morning. Major negligence of the Badaun police has come to light in this entire murder case. The accused, Ajay Pratap Singh, was an outsourced employee and had a contract for supplying stubble to the plant. However, he was fired from his job, and his firm was blacklisted. After this, Ajay had been threatening to kill DGM Sudhir Gupta for about 3 months. Sudhir Gupta had also filed an FIR against Ajay at Musajhag police station on February 4. In it, he stated that Ajay was constantly threatening him and following him. Sudhir Gupta was so scared that he had submitted his VRS application 5 years before retirement, which was approved. March 31 was his last day of service. Meanwhile, Harshit Mishra had also applied for his transfer. However, before that, the accused killed both of them. Even after the FIR, the Badaun police did not take action. Fatehpur SP Anoop Kumar Singh attached to DGP office Fatehpur SP Anoop Kumar Singh has also been removed. He has been attached to the DGP office. SP Om Prakash Singh, first from the logistics department, has been given the responsibility of Kasganj. Bhadohi SP Abhimanyu Manglik has been promoted and made the police captain of the larger district of Fatehpur. 2019 batch IPS Abhinav Tyagi will be the new police captain of Bhadohi. Nimish Dasharath Patil has been posted as Additional Superintendent of Police in Gorakhpur from the Ghaziabad Police Commissionerate. Why was Fatehpur SP removed? On March 10, three members of a family died under suspicious circumstances in Chauferwa village of Fatehpur district. The suicide note found at the scene mentioned threats of false cases under the SC, ST Act. The son had alleged pressure of debt and threats from some people. In this case, five people, including two lawyers, were booked for abetment to suicide. During the arrest of lawyers, there was heavy chaos and protest in the court premises, which exposed the police's failure.

stories.title: SC okays son’s euthanasia, ‘baba’ claims he can resurrect him:Bets on herbs’ healing power, father shows him the door
stories.summary: I have come from Rajasthan. My homemade medicine powder can give your son a new life. If you want, you can get it verified from AIIMS doctors. Hearing this claim from a baba, Ashok Rana from Ghaziabad became emotional. He said, ‘words cannot describe how painful it has been to see my son like a living corpse for 13 years’. Now, after the Supreme Court's decision, nothing can be done. Harish Rana from Ghaziabad is on a life support system. The court has granted permission for euthanasia. Dainik Bhaskar's team reached the Raj Empire Society in Ghaziabad, where Ashok Rana lives on the 13th floor. We talked to people in society. Also tried to talk to the father, but he doesn't want to speak much about this issue now. We also learned about who the Baba was. Read the report... Half-hour conversation between Baba and Ashok Rana 62-year-old Akhandanand Baba from Bhilwara, Rajasthan, arrived in Ghaziabad to give Harish Rana a new life. However, he was not allowed to enter the Raj Empire Society. Through a nearby shopkeeper, Dharmendra, Baba said, 'I have brought some traditional medicines from Rajasthan. These are made from herbs. They could give Harish a new life.' About 6 hours after Akhandanand's message, Harish Rana's father, Ashok Rana, came down to the society. Some committee officials were also standing with him there. The conversation between Baba and Ashok Rana lasted for about 30 minutes. Baba said, 'It's possible that the son's organs may start functioning' Baba said that we provide traditional herbs. As I learned from the media about your son, he has been in a coma for 13 years. The Supreme Court has already ruled on euthanasia. We want the medical board to proceed further, but with the herbs we have brought, your son could get a new life. This case has been in a very delicate situation for a very long time, but still, there is hope that, whether you give these medicines through a tube or get them administered by AIIMS doctors. It's possible that your son's nerves and other organs may start functioning. Father said, ‘I cannot express my pain in words’ To this, Ashok Rana said that It's been 13 years for us. We tried everything. Got treatment everywhere. I cannot express in words how I have seen my son like a living corpse for 13 years. I had to sell my three-story house in Delhi, too. I have endured a lot due to financial conditions. I cannot describe my family's situation in words. Now that the honorable Supreme Court's decision has come, we cannot say anything about it. We hope that, as per our request to the Supreme Court, the team of doctors from Delhi AIIMS will start the further process accordingly. After this, Ashok Rana also donated some fruits to the Baba. However, Baba did not interact with the media. Just said that I don't think it's appropriate to give photos, videos, or statements in the media. What society residents said... Dainik Bhaskar also spoke to some people living in the society. Tejas said that Ashok Rana's family has been living here for the past 6 years. Through Harish Rana, it has been learned that a meeting of doctors and administration has been held at AIIMS. The AIIMS team will come, and Ashok Rana's son, Harish Rana, will be taken by ambulance. Tejas says that a father has struggled for a long time for his son's life. They have been living in a rented flat here for many years. They used to sell food and beverages at different stadiums, which helped sustain the family. Ashok's pain is reflected on his face Raj Empire Society Federation Secretary Abhinav Tyagi said that whenever Ashok Rana came and went in the society, we could understand his pain and suffering from his face. He would often talk about his son, saying that he had made many efforts over 13 years to save his life and help him recover. Today, the entire society is with Harish Rana's family. Harish Rana will be taken to Delhi AIIMS via ambulance. Further procedures will begin there under the doctors' supervision. The Supreme Court delivered its verdict on euthanasia on March 11. The court has granted permission for euthanasia (passive euthanasia) to 31-year-old Harish Rana, who has been in a coma for 13 years. Harish, who is from Ghaziabad, is on a life support system. How did Harish reach this state, know the reason... Harish Rana, born in Delhi, was pursuing BTech from Punjab University, Chandigarh. In 2013, during his final semester studies, he fell from the fourth floor of the hostel. After the accident, his entire body became paralyzed, and he went into a coma. Since then, he has been unable to speak or feel anything. Doctors have diagnosed Harish with a serious condition called quadriplegia. In this condition, the patient survives entirely on a feeding tube and ventilator support. According to doctors, there is almost no chance of recovery in this condition. Due to being bedridden continuously for the past 13 years, Harish has developed bedsores, which are deep wounds on his body. His condition has been deteriorating more and more with time. For the family, seeing him in this state has become mentally very difficult.

stories.title: Rahul says, '85% of MGNREGA list comprises Dalits- backward classes':15% control bureaucracy and corporates; focus on Mayawati’s voter base
stories.summary: Rahul Gandhi spoke for 35 minutes in Lucknow to win Dalit votes. The occasion was Kanshi Ram Jayanti, but Rahul's target was the Modi government. In front of Dalits, Rahul took Modi's name more than Kanshi Ram's. He said- Narendra Modi does not believe in the ideology of the country's constitution. Sometime visit Apollo, look at the doctor's nameplate there, you won't find 85% (Dalits, backwards) anywhere. You won't find Dalits and backwards among CEOs of big companies. Rahul further says: In courts, bureaucracy, and corporate settings, you will only see 15% of the elite class. In MGNREGA list, 85% are Dalits and backwards. This is what Kanshi Ram used to say in his pen model. Kanshi Ram used to say, 'One man one vote, representation according to population... but what is the reality?' 15% control the country's resources'. Kanshi Ram was fighting to change this picture; now Congress is fighting this battle. Rahul Gandhi celebrated Social Change Day in Lucknow 2 days before Kanshi Ram Jayanti. He spoke directly with 4,000 people. Bhaskar learned from the leaders themselves how much Rahul's message reached them… MP said, ‘Rahul gave clear vision in 3 points’ Congress MP from Sitapur Rakesh Rathore, says, ‘Rahul Gandhi has given a clear vision today. Congress is focused on 3 points. First- Caste census. Second- Protection of the Constitution. Third- MGNREGA’. These 3 factors are going to prove decisive in UP. Due to MGNREGA, 80% of Dalits and backward classes were able to get respect. Congress spokesperson Sachin Rawat says, Rahul Gandhi is saying, ‘The greater the numbers, the greater the participation. This was the dream of Baba Saheb and Kanshi Ram’. Now Congress will become the voice of Dalits and the backwards in UP. Leaders and workers from Dalit and backward communities will advance in Congress. They will also get places in the government. Now the move for reservation in private sector Congress Vice President Vishvavijay Singh said, " The way Kanshi Ram did politics, Congress also follows that''. We are ready to give participation to Dalits and the backwards in the organisation and government. Also, we will ensure places for Dalits and backwards in large institutions and private sector. Will tell the public how agricultural rights were surrendered Congress National Secretary Dheeraj Gurjar explains this in more detail. He says, Rahul Gandhi mentioned the agriculture sector. Even today, 70% of our country's population does farming. Most of these are Dalits, backward and extremely backward classes. We will go among the people. Will explain how the BJP central government surrendered agricultural rights to America. We will put these questions to the country's public about how we have surrendered on the energy sector. Female leader claims, ‘Public will support Congress in 2027’ Bundelkhand zone's Women Congress State President Karishma Thakur confidently says that Congress will form a government in UP in the 2027 elections. In today's time, only Rahul Gandhi is such a leader who speaks fearlessly. Our PM is making decisions completely under American pressure. Will Trump now tell us which country to buy oil from? Therefore, the public will give surprising results in the upcoming elections. Sohan Lal, who came to hear Rahul Gandhi, has retired from the Agriculture Department. He says, ‘10% people occupy 90% of the posts in the Secretariat’. When halwa (benefits) is distributed, these 10% people alone are eating the share of the 85%. Rahul Gandhi is attacking this very issue. We will go among the public with this ideology. Today, only Congress is fighting for the voice and rights of Dalits and backward classes. Now, understand the political message of Rahul's pen model By mentioning Kanshiram's pen-model, Rahul tried to appeal to Dalits, extremely backward classes and minorities. Said, when Kanshiram used to travel in UP in his struggle to uplift Dalits and ensure their political participation, he kept a pen with him. He used to say that the pen cap represents 15% upper castes who operate the pen. It should have been that 85% should get the benefit. Since the BJP came to power, they have created a new system. They have separated the pen and the cap itself. They are only moving with 15% (upper castes). 85% have been thrown away. Expert View: Suresh Bahadur Singh, Senior Journalist Question: Is Rahul trying to prove Modi as a weak PM? Answer: If you listen to Rahul Gandhi's speech, it's clear that he is trying to prove Narendra Modi as a weak PM. This is why he kept claiming that the PM compromised under American pressure. For this, he also mentioned the trade deal with America. They try to explain that they are not speaking baseless words. In this trade deal, all benefits were given to America, while our farmers will suffer the most in the future. American farmers will sell agricultural products worth ₹9 lakh crores in our country. Raising the question of an oil and gas crisis in the country, Rahul Gandhi said, "People are troubled by low gas supply." Then mentioning the Epstein file, he also attacked the PM's personal image. Rahul Gandhi openly accused PM Modi of compromising the country's energy security. This is why America is now deciding where we will buy oil. He mentioned the Epstein Files and George Soros while referring to Petroleum Minister Hardeep Puri and his daughter's company. The meaning is clear that Rahul is making his way by attacking the same PM on whose face and strength the BJP wins state elections. In his speech, Rahul Gandhi clearly said that "There are only two reasons for PM Modi's surrender. One is Epstein's and the second is Adani's ongoing case in America. Modi himself is involved in the Adani case, which is why he has completely surrendered. Modi ji has lost psychologically, and when a person loses mentally, then he has to lose. Now, 3 major points from Rahul Gandhi's statement: Narendra Modi does not believe in constitutional ideology: The constitution contains the voices of all Dalit great personalities. The voices of Savarkar and Nathuram Godse are not in this constitution. Whatever Narendra Modi may say, he does not believe in the ideology of this constitution. All goods will come from America: The PM has said that we will buy goods worth ₹9 lakh crores from America. I want to ask, what will our businesses do? Cotton, soya, fruits, almonds, and walnuts will now be sold here by American farmers. America has large farms. All their goods will come here, and they will finish everything. Congress needs 100 people willing to die in UP: Now we have a big opportunity. Let's change India's politics. If Congress can find just 100 people in UP who say they will die, won't back down, won't abandon our goals, our work will be done. Congress will raise demand to give Bharat Ratna to Kanshiram Congress has passed a proposal demanding Bharat Ratna for Kanshiram. It has been decided that this demand will be raised in Parliament through Rahul Gandhi. This was the first time that Rahul Gandhi came to Lucknow to do a major event 2 days before Kanshiram Jayanti. About 4 thousand people participated in the program. This is being considered a big step by Congress in the politics of Dalit voters. Congress-SP Alliance in UP In the Lok Sabha elections, when Congress had an alliance with SP, NDA's seat count in UP was reduced to 36. The grand alliance succeeded in winning 43 seats. The grand alliance wants to repeat this success in the 2027 assembly elections. SP has also announced to celebrate Kanshiram Jayanti as PDA Day. Programs will be held at party district headquarters in 75 districts of UP on March 15.

stories.title: Anticipatory bail of 8 accused in multi-crore fraud case rejected:Fraud committed by giving fake s for providing gas and petrol agency
stories.summary: 8 accused who committed fraud of more than ₹21 crores by giving fake and false s in the name of providing kerosene, petrol and gas agencies had their anticipatory bail applications rejected by ADJ Sapna Tripathi's court. A report was filed against the accused at the Kotwali. DM had ordered investigation on July 31, 2007 False s were given for providing petrol pumps, kerosene and gas agencies from Hindustan and Bharat Petroleum. Fraud of more than ₹21 crore rupees was committed across the country in the name of providing agencies. On July 31, 2007, the then District Magistrate had ordered an investigation in this case. Based on the investigation report, the then Sub Divisional Magistrate had recommended filing a case in December 2008. Case was filed against these people A case was registered at Kotwali police station in 2010 based on the complaint of KK Kamani, a resident of Pandu Nagar. ADGC Pradeep Kumar Sahu said that during investigation, names of Girish Chandra from village Rajupur Amrauli Kannauj, Atul Kumar Katiyar from village Kachhiyapur Kusumkhor Bangar Kannauj, Arvind Kumar from village Kusumkhor Kannauj, Mukesh Chandra Katiyar from village Rajpur Kirtpur Kannauj, Sunil Kumar Katiyar from Bank Colony Devin Purwa Sarai Meera, Rakesh Kumar Katiyar originally from village Baranda Bilhaur now residing in Indra Nagar Kalyanpur Kanpur, Arjun Singh from Bima Vihar Lakhanpur and Umesh Chandra from village Khadamau Araul came to light. The court has rejected the anticipatory bail petitions of all the accused.

stories.title: Bihar's Maulana made inflammatory remarks about Yogi's mother:People take to streets in Lucknow, burn effigy and take out funeral procession
stories.summary: Bihar's Maulana Abdullah Salim Chaturvedi made objectionable and inflammatory statements about UP CM Yogi Adityanath's mother. This has angered BJP workers and Yogi fans. On Saturday, people burned an effigy of the Maulana in Lucknow. They trampled it under their feet. Earlier, the youth carried out a mock funeral procession of the Maulana in Hazratganj. After that, they poured petrol and set fire at the intersection. Police tried to stop the students but failed. People created a huge ruckus. Angry people raised loud slogans against the Maulana. They demanded that a case be filed and that he be arrested. The protesting youth said - Yogi is the heart and soul of UP. His mother is the mother of all India. Mothers and sisters will also protest for him. Meanwhile, BJP leader and UP Women's Commission Vice President Aparna Bisht Yadav targeted the Maulana. She said, The status of mother is very high in any religion. In Islam too, mother has been given a very high status, but this Maulana has not read such texts. Stop making such vulgar comments, he should apologize. Protests will continue until Maulana apologizes Abhishek, a protesting student from Lucknow University, said that Maulana has insulted our Chief Minister's mother. If the person who made the statement does not apologize, we will come in larger numbers tomorrow and protest. Such people make these kinds of statements to boost their political career. One can oppose Yogi Adityanath's policies, oppose his ideas, but commenting on his mother is extremely wrong. Tomorrow, mothers and sisters from our homes will come out and join the protest. 'Will make Maulana's condition like an effigy' Protesting Jatin Shukla said, we have burned the effigy of Maulana Salim from Bihar. He has shown his mentality during the sacred months of Holi and Ramzan. Yogi is the Chief Minister of such a large state. He is a saint. Objectionable comments were made about his mother. This will not be tolerated. Today we burned his effigy. Now we will file a case against the Maulana and work to send him to jail. Just as the effigy is burning, people with a mentality like Maulana will also burn. During his speech, Maulana made objectionable comments about CM Adityanath's mother. He made false statements about the cow slaughter law and the police in Uttar Pradesh. There is anger across the entire state because of this. 'Yogi's mother is the mother of entire India' Jatin said, it's a matter of investigation whether such people are getting protection from someone. Just a few days ago, in Lucknow University's Lal Baradari case, Congress and SP people were talking about unity and brotherhood. Today, all those people are silent on this issue. This shows their political dignity. Making such comments about someone's mother is extremely wrong. Yogi is a saint who left his home and family. Yogi's mother is the mother of the entire nation of India. This comment is not on Yogi's mother, but on Mother India. Ayodhya Hanumangarhi Mahant says - Maulana should be hanged Saints and Mahants of Ayodhya are angry over Maulana's comments. Hanumangarhi's Mahant Raju Das said that the Maulana who spoke against Gorakhpeeth's head priest, Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath's mother, should be publicly hanged. Meanwhile, Saket Bhawan's Mahant Sitaram Das said that Maulana should be shot in the chest, not in the leg. Maulana had said - Yogiji's... Maulana Abdullah Salim's video has surfaced on social media. It is being reported that he gave this speech at a religious gathering in Bihar during the month of Ramadan. The Maulana said, 'About Yogiji... would also come and eat. You would eat mutton. You would eat meat. It's a controversial topic, I won't go there. Do you know what kind of law has been made in Uttar Pradesh? Ask Mr. Dil (pointing to a person sitting on the stage). If someone has Yogiji's... my Hindu brothers, please don't mind. I respect your Mataji. We respect your beliefs. But, we also invite you to believe that there is no better belief than Islam. If up to 250 grams of Yogiji's... is found, there is an order to shoot holes below their knees.' (We cannot write the Maulana's complete statement here. Therefore, the objectionable words have been marked with dots.) Why Maulana writes 'Chaturvedi'... Many Muslims use the surname 'Chaturvedi'. This is due to the knowledge and study of all four Vedas (Rigveda, Yajurveda, Samaveda, Atharvaveda). It is a title.

stories.title: 600 skin disease cases reported in Kanpur within 48 hours:Chemical colours linked to infections; women and children worst affected
stories.summary: After the Holi festivities, long queues of women are now seen at hospital OPDs. In the last 48 hours, around 500 to 600 new cases of skin diseases have emerged, which has increased the health department's concerns. The most shocking thing is that more than half of these patients are women and young girls who have been using 'Betnovate' or other steroid-containing creams for a long time without medical advice. This deadly combination of color and steroids has not only caused swelling on faces but has also left deep wounds. Dermatologist Dr. Swetank said that most women coming to the OPD have one thing in common - they were directly purchasing and applying steroid creams from medical stores. Some were using these creams to remove acne, while others were using them to clear dark spots and blemishes on their faces. They said - Continuous use of steroids makes the upper layer of skin extremely thin and delicate. When chemical colors were applied to such sensitive skin and sunlight fell on it, the reaction increased manifold. This is why these women are experiencing much more burning and pain compared to normal patients. Dr. Shwetank said that women whose skin was already damaged due to steroids are showing severe swelling on their faces and lips after Holi. In many cases, watery discharge has also started from wounds on the cheeks and forehead. As soon as these women step into sunlight, their faces turn red, and they experience unbearable itching and burning. Besides women, young children and people with dry skin have also been affected by this problem, because their skin is naturally soft and delicate, on which chemical colors caused immediate allergic reactions.

stories.title: Akhilesh Yadav says, ‘I wanted Mayawati as PM’:Takes jibe at Nitish's Rajya Sabha nomination, says, 'BJP didn't let him retire as CM'
stories.summary: When we had an alliance with BSP, we wanted to make Mayawati the Prime Minister. When the 'India' alliance was formed, we wanted to make Nitish Kumar the Prime Minister, but BJP didn't even give him a chance to retire as CM. Now he will retire from Rajya Sabha. SP chief Akhilesh Yadav said these things during a press conference in Lucknow on Saturday. He took a jibe at CM Yogi's Singapore and Japan visit. These remarks were made by Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav during a press conference in Lucknow on Saturday. He took a dig at Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath over his visit to Singapore and Japan. Akhilesh said that whenever a programme is organized, people usually plan trips after the farewell. “But this is the first Chief Minister who went abroad even before the farewell,” he remarked. On Deputy CM Keshav Prasad Maurya's helicopter emergency landing, he said - They must not have given him a new helicopter. The machine should always be good. We wish for his good health. We all travel by helicopter. It should be in good condition. Our demand is that he should be given a new helicopter. Key points from Akhilesh's press conference- ‘Prices will fall only when BJP leaves power’ Akhilesh Yadav said vehicles carry more than 50% tax, which is why people are forced to buy expensive cars. He added that inflation will come down only when the BJP is voted out of power. ‘One halwai, one sweet’ jibe at BJP Referring to the slogan ‘One Nation, One Election’, Akhilesh mocked the BJP, saying the party distributed gujiyas on Holi under a new formula, ‘one halwai, one sweet’. He warned people to remain cautious. Why weren’t smugglers’ call records checked? Citing the Kanpur drug case, Akhilesh said police call records revealed links with smugglers involved in the trade of cannabis and opium. He questioned why the call details of the smugglers themselves were not examined. SP to file FIR over BJP’s song Akhilesh said the Samajwadi Party would file an FIR against a song allegedly launched by the BJP targeting the party. He added that it would expose the alleged nexus once the complaint is filed. Taunts at CM Yogi over Japan visit Taking a swipe at Yogi Adityanath, Akhilesh said the chief minister did not even visit Kyoto during his Japan tour and mocked his enthusiasm during a high-speed train ride. Claims BJP did not build new thermal plants He said most thermal power plants in Uttar Pradesh were set up during the Samajwadi Party government and challenged the BJP to name even one built in the last decade. Concern over Indians stranded in Gulf countries Akhilesh said the government should bring back Indians stuck in Gulf nations. He also criticised India’s foreign policy, claiming external factors appear to be influencing decisions. Calls Election Commission ‘dishonest’ over voter list issue He accused the Election Commission of irregularities in voter list revisions, alleging fake signatures and attempts to delete votes in places like Sarojini Nagar and Bidhuna. ‘Shankaracharya is an institution of Sanatan’ Akhilesh said allegations made against Shankaracharya were attempts to defame Sanatan traditions, stressing that Shankaracharya represents an important spiritual institution. ‘Government celebrated Holi while a poor man died waiting’ He claimed a person died while waiting during a public grievance hearing and blamed the administration for negligence during the Holi festival. Meetings meant to decide BJP tickets Akhilesh alleged that the BJP’s ongoing meetings near Delhi and in Kanpur are aimed at deciding which sitting MLAs may lose their election tickets.

stories.title: Engineer blames sister for ending his relationship with girlfriend:Victim stabbed 40 times in Moradabad; blood from room to kitchen
stories.summary: Engineer brother Hardik (25), who killed his engineer sister by stabbing her with a knife, is still out of police custody in Moradabad. Hardik stabbed his sister Himshikha 40 times with a knife. Blood was scattered everywhere from the room to the kitchen in the house. He also attacked his mother with a knife, who is currently hospitalized in an injured condition. The exact reason for the murder will only be known after the accused Hardik is caught, but so far, it has been learned that Hardik was having an affair with a girl from Pune. Some time ago, he had broken up with his girlfriend. Hardik's mother, Neelima, who is admitted to the hospital, told police during questioning, "Hardik had become angry since the breakup with his girlfriend. He was adamant about marrying his girlfriend. While she had already left him. Hardik somehow felt that his breakup happened because of his sister Himshikha and me. That's why he had become irritable. He would get angry over small things." Hardik and his sister Himshikha were twins. Actually, Hardik killed his sister in broad daylight on Friday. After the incident, he brought his mother home from the office where she had gone for work. When the mother went inside, she started screaming after seeing her daughter's blood-soaked body. Seeing this, Hardik also attacked his mother with a knife. Two neighboring women arrived after hearing the screams. After this, Hardik fled in a car. When the women went inside the house, the mother and daughter were lying on the ground covered in blood. Police were informed. The incident took place in the Majhola police station area of Moradabad. After separation from husband, Neelima started living in Moradabad Himshikha and Hardik were twin siblings. Like her brother, the sister was also an engineer. Both worked in an IT company in Gurgaon. About a year ago, Hardik lost his job. After this, he started living with his sister in Gurgaon and began uploading content on YouTube. The siblings lived in Gurgaon, and their mother, Neelima, worked in an insurance company in Moradabad. She lives in a rented house in Buddhi Vihar. Police say the family originally hails from Badaun. After separating from her husband about 9 years ago, Neelima started living in Moradabad with both children and started a job here. After completing their education, the children started working in Gurgaon. As a result, Neelima lived alone in Moradabad. The children would come to meet their mother in Moradabad during festivals. On March 2nd itself, the brother and sister arrived together by car from Gurgaon to Moradabad to meet their mother and celebrate Holi. Chased and stabbed sister inside house Hardik had so much hatred for his sister that he killed her with extreme brutality. He chased Himshikha around the house and stabbed her with a knife. She has knife wounds on almost every part of her body, including stomach, chest, and neck. The total number of wounds will only be known after the post-mortem. However, police officers said that every part of the body was stabbed with a knife. Himshikha's dead body has not been autopsied until Saturday afternoon. Because, her brother has been absconding since the murder. While the mother is hospitalized due to injuries. Police will also take family consent before the post-mortem. Therefore, her family has been called from Badaun. Police will conduct Himshikha's post-mortem only after getting consent from the family. Blood everywhere from kitchen to room in the house Blood was found scattered at the crime scene in both rooms, the courtyard, and the kitchen. Police suspect that Himshikha was possibly working in the kitchen when her brother Hardik attacked her with a knife. She ran into both rooms of the house to escape her brother's attack, but could not survive. The blood scattered in both rooms and the courtyard testifies that Himshikha tried her best to save her life. 10 police teams engaged in search for Hardik After killing his sister, Hardik fled from home in a car. SSP Satpal Antil of Moradabad has formed 10 teams to search for him. SP City Ranvijay Singh is leading these teams. Police teams are also checking CCTV footage at toll booths on highways. Additionally, electronic surveillance is being used to arrest Hardik. Real motive will only be known after Hardik's arrest SSP Satpal Antil says that why Hardik attacked his sister and mother with a knife will only be known after Hardik's arrest. Police teams are searching for him, and he will be arrested soon.
