stories.title: Google Maps led attackers to ex-Muslim YouTuber’s office:Police scan CCTVs of 140 km route to trace Zeeshan and Gulfam
stories.summary: A new revelation has emerged in the attack on Ghaziabad-based YouTuber Saleem Wastik, who had left Islam. The investigation found that the attackers, real brothers Zeeshan and Gulfam, reached Saleem’s office using Google Maps and kept watch on his activities after confirming the location. Saleem (50) often shared his office address and mobile number in videos on his YouTube channel. Using this information, the accused traced his location. Zeeshan used Google Maps to find the route, and both reached his office. They conducted reconnaissance for one or two days and monitored Saleem’s movements. Later, finding an opportunity, they carried out the attack and fled. After the incident, police formed five teams to arrest the accused and scanned CCTV footage from roads covering nearly 140 km, which eventually helped identify them. CCTV reveals brutal attack Ex-Muslim YouTuber Saleem Wastik was attacked on February 27 and suffered 14 stab wounds. He is currently admitted to a private hospital in Delhi. Two surgeries have been performed, but his condition remains critical. Police have killed both assailant brothers, Zeeshan and Gulfam, in an encounter, while the search for the mastermind continues. After the encounter, some people questioned the police action. On Wednesday, CCTV footage of the attack surfaced, showing the brutality of the two brothers. In the video, one of them can be heard saying, “Hit him, don’t be afraid.” After the incident, Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath took cognisance of the matter and said the culprits would not be spared. Where the accused went after the deadly attack? CCTV footage scanned across 140 km On February 27 at 7:54 AM, Zeeshan and his elder brother, Gulfam, broke into Saleem Wastik’s house and attacked him. After the incident, police got key clues from CCTV cameras installed at Saleem’s office. Investigation revealed the bike-borne attackers entered Delhi through the Wazirabad border. From there, they were traced to Mangal Bazar in Khoda near the Ghaziabad–Delhi border through street CCTV. They reached their room, changed clothes, stayed for about six minutes, and left again with a bag. The two then crossed the Hapur border via Ghaziabad on the Delhi–Moradabad–Lucknow Highway and reached Brijghat. After Brijghat, CCTV cameras captured them in Gajraula on Sambhal Road in Amroha. They also stopped for 5–10 minutes in Hasanpur before reaching their hometown, Said Nagli via Sambhal Road. A few hours later, Zeeshan fled, while Gulfam left the house on February 28. Police, along with Ghaziabad SWAT and Crime Branch teams, scanned CCTV footage from toll plazas and over 150 locations within a 140-km radius. This helped confirm that the attackers were residents of Amroha district. Stopped for 2 minutes before Saleem’s house Mobiles to be sent for forensic examination Police recovered a Samsung mobile phone from Gulfam, a one-lakh bounty criminal killed in an encounter. They also seized a pistol, cartridges, a KTM bike stolen from Delhi, an Aadhaar card, an Ayushman card, and a driving license. A backpack containing a kurta-pajama, a round cap, and a jacket was also found. Gulfam’s mobile phone will be sent for forensic analysis, and Zeeshan’s phone will also be examined by the Forensic Science Laboratory (FSL). Linked to radical social media pages According to police, several Instagram pages are operating under the name ‘Muslim Army’ and allegedly spreading radical content. Initial investigation suggests Zeeshan was also associated with this group. CCTV footage of the attack CCTV footage shows the shocking sequence Saleem Wastik in critical condition Saleem Wastik is currently admitted to Max Hospital in Saket, Delhi. He is in the ICU. He is currently unable to speak or eat and drink. Doctors have performed surgery on the knife wounds on his throat. However, his condition is still critical due to liver damage from the knife wound in his stomach. Saleem's wife has been shifted to another location for security reasons. It is feared that her life is also in danger. Saleem's only son, Usman, is at the hospital with relatives. However, the son says that he is not being allowed to meet his father. Son Usman says, Our financial situation is bad at the moment. One lakh rupees were given by Meerut leader Amit Jani for treatment. Around 3 to 4 lakh rupees have been spent so far, and a lot of money has also been borrowed. Latest update on Ghaziabad police probe Case being investigated from 3 angles First- Is there another real mastermind behind the attack on Saleem Wastik? Second- Are other YouTubers who speak against Islam, like Saleem Wastik, also targeted by these people? Third- Which organization were Zeeshan and Gulfam working for? In contact with a Maulana from Delhi Zeeshan and Gulfam were in contact with a Maulana from Delhi. Police believe that both were receiving guidance from the Maulana. Zeeshan's Instagram account shows him giving Islamic speeches like a Maulana. It has also come to light that both went to Delhi before the attack on Saleem Wastik. Ghaziabad Crime Branch may soon interrogate the Maulana.

stories.title: Dy CM Keshav Maurya’s helicopter makes emergency landing:Chopper develops technical issues mid-air at 2,000 feet; landed in Lucknow
stories.summary: An emergency landing was carried out for the helicopter of Deputy Chief Minister Keshav Prasad Maurya in Lucknow. According to information, smoke suddenly started coming out of the helicopter while it was in the air. As a precaution, the helicopter was diverted and landed at Amausi Airport. Maurya was leaving for a two-day visit to Kaushambi. He was scheduled to inaugurate the two-day Saras Mahotsav programme at the Babu Singh Degree College ground in Sayara. His helicopter had taken off from La Martiniere Ground on Saturday morning. During the flight, due to a technical fault, the display first stopped working and then smoke began to rise. Within moments, smoke filled the cabin. The pilot immediately contacted Lucknow ATC and sought permission for an emergency landing at Amausi Airport. The helicopter was landed there amid tight security arrangements. As soon as it landed, security and technical teams immediately surrounded it. The Deputy Chief Minister was safely taken out of the helicopter. He will now travel to Kaushambi in another helicopter. The aerial distance between La Martiniere College (La Marts) and Amausi Airport (Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport) is about 11–12 kilometres.

stories.title: Rajya Sabha nominations may favour leaders with Assembly-winning clout:BJP set for 7 seats in UP, SP bets on third
stories.summary: Rajya Sabha elections are currently a topic of discussion across the country. Bihar Chief Minister Nitish Kumar and BJP National President Nitin Naveen have filed their nominations for the Upper House. Meanwhile, in Uttar Pradesh, Rajya Sabha elections are scheduled to be held at the end of the year, but political speculation has already begun. Questions are being raised over whether the BJP will again field its current members and veteran leaders such as Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri, Brijlal, Dr. Dinesh Sharma, Geeta Shakya, and Neeraj Shekhar, or opt for new faces. Attention is also on how many seats will be contested in UP, the electoral math behind them, and which leaders have a strong claim and why. Rajya Sabha elections due in UP Uttar Pradesh has a total quota of 31 Rajya Sabha seats, of which the term of 10 members will end on November 25 this year. The election process is expected to begin in October or November. With the polls scheduled just before the Assembly elections, the BJP is likely to decide its candidates while maintaining social and regional balance. Experts believe some current members may get another term, while new faces could replace others. After the elections, the Samajwadi Party’s strength in the Upper House will increase by one seat, while the BSP will have no representation. Rajya Sabha math in UP BJP’s 7, SP’s 2 seats almost certain The NDA has 290 MLAs in the UP Assembly: BJP 257, Apna Dal (S) 13, Rashtriya Lok Dal 9, Suheldev Bharatiya Samaj Party 6, and Nishad Party 5. The Samajwadi Party has 102 MLAs, Jansatta Dal Loktantrik 2, and BSP 1, while three seats are vacant and will be filled in elections. Around 36–40 MLA votes are required to win one Rajya Sabha seat. In such a scenario, BJP is certain to win seven seats and SP two out of the 10 seats. SP will have to struggle for the third seat, while BJP may try for an eighth. BSP may lose Upper House presence After the Lok Sabha, BSP’s presence in the Rajya Sabha is also set to end. For the first time since its formation, the party may have no members in either House of Parliament. The term of BSP’s lone Rajya Sabha MP Ramji ends on November 25, 2026. In the Assembly, BSP has only one MLA, Umashankar Singh, while at least 10 proposers and seconders are required to file a Rajya Sabha nomination, making BSP ineligible to file a nomination on its own. Support deal with BJP or SP possible Political analysts say BSP candidates could file nominations with the support of either BJP or SP. BJP may also adopt a strategy of arranging support through allied parties and unattached MLAs, avoiding direct backing so BSP is not seen as BJP’s B-team. Whose claim is strong, and why? Brijlal might be repeated The term of BJP's Rajya Sabha MP and former UP DGP Brijlal will end on November 25. Brijlal is BJP's Dalit face. On issues related to Dalits and law and order, Brijlal aggressively puts forward BJP's stand by attacking SP and BSP. Experts believe that the party might give him another chance to go to Rajya Sabha. If he is not given a chance to go to Rajya Sabha, then he might be made to contest the assembly elections from a seat reserved for SC in UP. Dr. Dinesh Sharma seen as strong Brahmin face Former Deputy CM Dr. Dinesh Sharma was sent to the Rajya Sabha after the demise of MP Hardwar Dubey. Amid discussions over Brahmin displeasure in UP, Sharma recently faced criticism from the community over the UGC issue at a meeting. Experts say he remains BJP’s key Brahmin face and is active across the state, including Lucknow, so the party may give him another Rajya Sabha term. Uncertainty over Hardeep Singh Puri Union Minister Hardeep Singh Puri is currently serving his second Rajya Sabha term from UP and handles key ministries such as Urban Development and Petroleum. His name recently surfaced in the Epstein Files and earlier in another controversy. Experts believe that if he is dropped in the proposed Modi cabinet expansion, he may not return to the Rajya Sabha; however, if he remains a minister, he could get a third term from UP in November. Neeraj Shekhar may get another term Neeraj Shekhar, son of former PM Chandrashekhar, joined BJP from SP during the Article 370 abrogation to help the party secure a Rajya Sabha majority. BJP later sent him to the Rajya Sabha again in 2020, and he may receive another opportunity. BL Verma’s nomination almost certain Union Minister of State for Cooperation BL Verma is serving his second Rajya Sabha term. A prominent Lodhi leader from UP and considered close to PM Narendra Modi and Home Minister Amit Shah, he was also a contender for UP BJP state president. As a Union minister, his Rajya Sabha nomination is considered almost certain. Arun Singh’s chances depend on party role BJP National General Secretary Arun Singh’s future depends on his role in the new team to be formed by BJP National President Nitin Nabin. If he does not get a position such as General Secretary or Vice President, he may be sent to the Rajya Sabha again. Geeta Shakya may be replaced Geeta Shakya, currently Mahila Morcha state president, was sent to the Rajya Sabha while heading the women’s wing, fulfilling both the women’s and Shakya community representation. Experts say a new Mahila Morcha president may be appointed before the elections, so another woman leader could be nominated instead of her. Seema Dwivedi may not return Seema Dwivedi from Jaunpur, who was sent to the Rajya Sabha in 2020 and has also served as MLA from Gadwara, may be replaced as BJP could give another woman leader an opportunity under the current political equation. Position of the opposition and BSP Ramgopal Yadav certain to return to Rajya Sabha Ramgopal Yadav, SP’s senior national general secretary and a close confidant of party chief Akhilesh Yadav, is considered certain to enter the Rajya Sabha again. He also acts as a key link between the central government and the Samajwadi Party. Ramji Gautam’s future depends on Mayawati Ramji Gautam is currently BSP’s only Rajya Sabha member, but the party lacks enough MLAs to file a nomination in the upcoming elections. His political future now depends on BSP supremo Mayawati. If Mayawati secures support from BJP and NDA allies, BSP could become eligible to file a nomination. In that case, it will be seen whether Mayawati again backs Ramji Gautam or introduces a new face. Perspective of political experts Contest between BJP and SP Senior journalist Anand Rai believes the Rajya Sabha elections will see a direct contest between the BJP and SP, with both parties selecting candidates while keeping the upcoming Assembly elections and political circumstances in mind. As for the BSP, it does not even have enough numbers to file a nomination. Senior journalist Akhilesh Bajpai says the BSP is going through the worst phase in its political history. For the first time, the party will not have enough strength to even file a nomination in the Rajya Sabha elections. Currently, BSP has no members in the Legislative Council or the Lok Sabha, and after November 25 it will also have no representation in the Rajya Sabha. Meanwhile, the BJP is expected to focus on winning eight seats.

stories.title: Kanpur cop amasses ₹100 crore from hashish, marijuana trade:Tipped off smugglers with emojis before raids, audio clips leaked
stories.summary: An internal investigation has revealed shocking allegations against several policemen in Kanpur. According to findings from the probe ordered by Police Commissioner Raghuvir Lal, some police personnel were allegedly helping hashish and marijuana smugglers instead of acting against them. Suspicion arose when smugglers began vacating their dens just before police raids. The commissioner then ordered a check of the call detail records (CDR) of certain policemen. The CDRs of one sub-inspector and three head constables showed frequent contact with suspected smugglers. When their mobile phones were examined, investigators found audio recordings in which policemen were allegedly giving tips to smugglers about moving drugs such as marijuana and hashish to avoid raids. A departmental inquiry has been initiated and four policemen have been suspended. Property Worth ₹100 Crore Found in Head Constable’s Name During the investigation, the Police Commissioner also ordered scrutiny of the properties owned by the accused policemen. The probe found that Head Constable Jitendra Pratap Singh, posted at Sachendi police station, had allegedly acquired property worth around ₹100 crore. He purchased a 600-yard plot near Ashoka Hotel in Mandhana and also built a 200-yard house there. Investigators also found several benami properties in the names of his wife and relatives, along with gold worth crores. Emoji Messages Used to Alert Smugglers Investigators also discovered that some policemen allegedly used emoji messages on mobile phones to warn smugglers about surveillance or possible raids. These coded messages were reportedly sent to help traffickers move their goods before police action. A departmental inquiry is currently ongoing against the suspended officers. Kamlakant’s Support to Smugglers in Three Areas Head Constable Kamlakant, currently posted in the police line for the past one and a half years, was found to have allegedly run drug operations in Kanjarnapurwa, Naubasta and Kidwai Nagar using his influence. Investigators revealed that Golu Pahadi, who was caught with 53 kg of cannabis in Kidwai Nagar, had been operating his business under Kamlakant’s protection. Inspector’s Support to Babita, Who Sold Marijuana Near Temple Another case involved Babita, who was allegedly selling marijuana while pretending to sell flowers near Panki Temple. She reportedly had the support of Inspector Shravan Kumar Tiwari. Due to complaints against the inspector, DCP West SM Kasim Abidi had earlier submitted a detailed investigation report to the Joint Police Commissioner. Head Constable Supplying Drugs in Sarvodayanagar Meanwhile, Head Constable Ranjit Sharma, who was suspended from Kakadev police station, was allegedly supplying marijuana and hashish in Sarvodayanagar. He was also accused of providing shelter to traffickers operating in Sarvodayanagar and Kakadev Coaching Mandi. Jitendra Pratap Singh’s Posting History Raises Questions Head Constable Jitendra Pratap Singh had been posted at Sachendi police station for about one and a half months, where he drove the station in-charge’s jeep. Complaints surfaced that he was settling disputes over valuable land deals in exchange for money, after which he was removed from the police station. He was later posted to the Crime Branch, but was again removed after allegations of links with bookies and smugglers surfaced. How the Police–Smuggler Nexus Came to Light The investigation began on October 7, 2025, when Police Commissioner Raghuvir Lal took charge in Kanpur. While reviewing old records, he noticed a rise in marijuana and hashish smuggling in certain parts of the city. He assigned IPS officer Sumit Sudharkar Ramteke to lead action against drug trafficking and gave him a free hand to act. Ramteke formed a special team, which started tracking the movements of suspected smugglers. Officers patrolled on scooters to monitor cocaine and marijuana dealers. The team achieved its first breakthrough on October 15, when smugglers Kunal Gupta, Arjun Singh and Manish were arrested. Police recovered 100.38 grams of marijuana and 3.45 grams of cocaine from them. Later, on October 22, Rajkumar alias Baua Lind, brother of history-sheeter Sushil Bachcha, who ran a drug syndicate in Kakadev Coaching Mandi, was arrested with 70 kg of marijuana. On January 10, 2026, police arrested five smugglers including Deepu and Deepa from Saketnagar with marijuana worth ₹2.50 crore. Officers also recovered ₹5.43 lakh in cash. Revealing the case, the Police Commissioner said the accused used to supply marijuana across the city by packing it into small packets. Even after all these revelations, the nexus of drug traffickers in the city has not completely broken. ADCP Sumit Sudhakar Ramteke said that the team was receiving information about large-scale smuggling from many places including Panki, Kakadeo, Naubasta, Machharia, Sarvodayanagar, Kalyanpur, and Nawabganj. Police would set their trap, but smugglers would escape. Officers suspected police collusion with smugglers. ADCP Sumit Sudhakar Ramteke started a secret investigation. Then suspicious numbers appeared in the CDR of some police personnel. These included numbers of one sub-inspector and three head constables. Understand how smugglers were alerted Some sent emojis, some made 3 missed calls ADCP said - Police personnel had their own distinct pattern of alerting smugglers. Some would make WhatsApp calls. Some would alert by sending emoji messages. Some would give information about police raids by making two or three missed calls. After investigation of the entire case, suspicious police personnel have been suspended. After being proven guilty, now ADCP East Anjil Vishwakarma is investigating this case.

stories.title: Scorching days ahead in UP:1st week of March hottest since 2023; temperatures likely to touch 40°C soon
stories.summary: Holi was celebrated three days ago and the effect of heat in UP has started increasing rapidly. After three years, the temperature has crossed 35 degrees Celsius in the first week of March itself. The Meteorological Department has warned that the temperature could reach 40 degrees this month. According to IMD, between March and May 2026, temperatures in most parts of the country may remain above normal. In this situation, let's find out how hot it will be this March compared to the last 5 years? Why is the heat increasing? Which sector will be affected? Read in this report... In 2025, during the first week of March, the daytime temperature in most cities of UP was recorded between 29 to 31 degrees Celsius, while the night temperature remained between approximately 14 to 19 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, on March 1, 2026, the maximum temperature was recorded at 32.5. The beginning of March was warmer this time in UP. According to meteorological department data - on March 1, 2026, the maximum daytime temperature was recorded at 32.5 degrees Celsius, which is the highest temperature for early March in the last three years. Previously in 2023, the maximum temperature recorded on March 1 was 32 degrees Celsius. Meanwhile, in other years, the temperature on the first day of March was lower than this. Lucknow meteorologist Mohammad Danish says that such high temperatures at the beginning of March indicate that the heat could increase rapidly in the coming days. How will the weather be in coming days? According to weather expert Mohammad Danish, temperatures are likely to rise further in the coming days. Maximum temperatures could increase by about 2 to 3 degrees Celsius over the next five days. Due to this, temperatures in many areas of the state may reach around 38 degrees Celsius and the effect of strong sunlight and heat may be felt more during the day. Banda was the hottest district in the state According to Mohammad Danish, people are experiencing April-May like heat at the beginning of March itself. In the last 24 hours, Banda remained the hottest district in the state. The maximum temperature here was recorded at 35.6 degrees Celsius. Due to continuously rising temperatures, the effect of intense sunlight and heat is clearly visible during afternoon hours. Why is the temperature rising? Skymet Weather's Vice President Mahesh Palawat says that in recent years, the effect of climate change is clearly visible on weather. Due to this, the weather pattern is changing rapidly and summer is starting earlier compared to before. The impact is that now the temperature is rising more rapidly and the number of hot days is also increasing. Sometimes, the period of heat waves also lasts longer than before. In the past few years, many cities in the country have broken old heat records. In some places, temperatures have been recorded above 48 degrees Celsius. If this situation continues, the heat may feel even more intense in the coming years. Western Disturbance active, what effect will be seen in UP? According to Mahesh Palawat, a western disturbance is likely to become active, which may lead to light rain and snowfall in the Western Himalayan region (Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh and Uttarakhand) between March 7 and 11. Its effect will also be seen in UP. Actually, a trough line extends up to the northern parts of Uttar Pradesh from the cyclonic circulation (air rising while rotating in a circular motion in one area) formed in the northern Odisha and Bengal region. Due to this system, there may be slight changes in the state's weather. Although the weather in Uttar Pradesh is likely to remain mostly dry for now, clouds may cover some areas and there may be slight fluctuations in temperature. Heatwave may continue for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures may remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities and people may have to face intense heat. When is it considered a heatwave? According to the Weather Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature recorded is 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected and the risk of heat stroke increases. Crops will be damaged due to heat Professor PK Singh from the Agriculture Department at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) says - March could prove challenging for farmers. The rise in temperature will affect the Rabi crops, especially wheat. Due to the heat, the grains will not develop fully. This will result in lower yield. According to PK Singh, hot winds can damage crops like mustard, chickpeas and peas. Rising temperatures cause soil in fields to dry quickly. This increases irrigation costs. Crops face stress.

stories.title: UP plans buses for 12,200 villages:CM Gram Transport Scheme set for rollout; cabinet to clear 27 proposals
stories.summary: The Chief Minister Gram Transport Scheme 2026 is set to be implemented to provide bus services to 12,200 villages in Uttar Pradesh that currently lack transport connectivity. The proposal, along with around 27 others, is likely to be discussed in the cabinet meeting scheduled at Lok Bhavan on Tuesday under the chairmanship of Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. Cabinet meeting to discuss 27 proposals Chief Secretary SP Goyal has issued a 27-point agenda for the cabinet meeting scheduled at 11 am at Lok Bhavan. Transport Minister Dayashankar Singh says that out of nearly one lakh villages in the state, about 12,200 still do not have bus services. The Chief Minister Gram Transport Scheme is being introduced to provide transport connectivity to these villages. Under the scheme, buses from UP Roadways as well as private operators will run to these rural areas. Private operators to get permit relief Under the scheme, private bus operators running services in villages will be given major concessions in permits. In some cases, the permit requirement may be completely waived. This step is expected to encourage private operators to run buses on rural routes. Bus schedule from village to district headquarters According to the plan, a bus will leave the village at 6 am. It will pass through around 15–20 nearby villages and the block headquarters before reaching the district headquarters by about 10 am. From the district headquarters, the bus will depart again at 4 pm and return to the same village by 8 pm after covering the same route. Farmers, women and students to benefit The facility is expected to make it easier for villagers to transport their crops to block and district headquarters. Farmers, women and students are likely to benefit the most from the improved connectivity.

stories.title: Wife of cricketer Amit Mishra alleges multiple affairs:Claims forced intimacy during illness; seeks ₹1 crore compensation
stories.summary: The wife of IPL cricketer Amit Mishra has filed a case against him in a Kanpur court. Garima Tiwari says Amit beats her for dowry. He mentally harasses her and even keeps her hungry at times. According to the cricketer’s wife, her husband forces a physical relationship even when she is ill. He also takes away the money she earns from modelling. Troubled by Amit’s behaviour, she once tries to take her life by drinking phenyl. She is later admitted to hospital. Garima tells the court that Amit is in contact with several girls. She says he calls and chats with them on the phone in front of her. Garima also alleges that Amit misleads many girls with promises of marriage and sexually exploits them. She says the police do not register her FIR because of her husband’s influence. Even after complaining to the Police Commissioner, no action is taken. After this, she files the case through the court. She demands ₹1 crore as compensation. So far, Garima has filed three cases against Amit. Read the allegations made by wife Garima against Amit Mishra In-laws taunted about dowry Garima Tiwari (35), a professional model from Birhana Road in Kanpur, says she becomes friends with Amit Mishra through Instagram in 2019. After their conversations, they grow close. After some time, they decide to get married for love. After remaining in a relationship for about two-and-a-half to three years, the two get married on 26 April 2021. After the marriage, she says her husband Amit and his family members — mother Beena Mishra, father Shashikant Mishra, elder brother Amar Mishra, sister-in-law Ritu Mishra and sister Swati Mishra — start taunting her over dowry on small matters almost every day. Garima says she files a complaint against Amit Mishra with the police, but no action is taken because of his influence. Demanded Honda City car and 10 lakh rupees According to Garima, before her departure from her parents’ home after the wedding, her in-laws demand a Honda City car and ₹10 lakh as dowry. Her family somehow arranges ₹2.5 lakh. Only after this do her in-laws allow her to leave. However, she says the demands of Amit and his family continue to increase. Garima alleges that Amit often beats her after drinking alcohol. She is also kept hungry for several days at times. She says he pressures her for a physical relationship even when she is ill, and beats her if she resists. She also claims that her in-laws force her to transfer money to their accounts several times. Lawyer said - Complained to Police Commissioner, still no FIR Garima’s lawyer Kareem Ahmed says the victim complains about the matter at Philkhana police station, and also approaches the ACP, DCP and the Police Commissioner. However, the FIR is not registered due to the cricketer’s influence. Therefore, a complaint case is filed in court on Monday on Garima’s behalf. Garima filed 3 cases against husband Amit First: April 21, 2025 - Filed court case alleging domestic violence. Second: April 23, 2025 - Filed second case in court demanding maintenance. Garima has demanded Rs 50,000 per month as maintenance from Amit. Also demanded Rs 1 crore as compensation. Third: March 9, 2026 - Garima filed third dowry harassment case after police did not conduct hearing and refused to file FIR.

Her husband and their daughter were with her at the time, but she separated from her husband in the market. Carrying the child in her arms, she ran towards the railway track after spotting a train. People nearby tried to stop her and ran after her, but could not catch her. Her husband also chased her from behind. By the time anyone could reach her, the train engine had hit them and both were killed on the spot. After the incident, a large crowd gathered at the site. The husband was seen crying and clinging to the bodies. A team of police along with the Railway Protection Force also reached the spot. The bodies were taken into custody, a panchnama was completed with the husband, and the bodies were sent for post-mortem. The incident occurred near the Chaukhandi railway line under the Jansa police station area, Varanasi. See 3 images... Now Read the Complete Matter The deceased woman, Anita Devi (22), lived in Lachhipur village near the Chaukhandi railway line in the Jansa police station area along with her three-year-old daughter Darshana. Her husband Ajit Kumar works in Mumbai and visits home only occasionally. Because of this, there were frequent disputes between the husband and wife. At present, the husband had come home. On Monday, another argument took place between the two. After this, the woman left home with her daughter on the pretext of buying medicine. The husband followed them from behind. When they reached near the Chaukhandi railway line and she noticed her husband behind her, she suddenly ran towards the railway track. Both died after being hit by train engine The husband also started running behind her. At the same time, the Sarnath Express coming from Varanasi towards Prayagraj struck them. Both the mother and daughter died on the spot after being hit by the engine. When the family members received information about the incident, there was chaos at home. Relatives from the woman’s parental side also reached the spot and were seen crying. On the information given by a railway gatekeeper, railway police reached the spot and sent the bodies for post-mortem after taking them into custody. Maternal family accuses son-in-law Members of the woman’s parental family alleged that the son-in-law used to frequently quarrel with their daughter. They said that because of these disputes, she had been living at her parental home for nearly three years. They claimed that on Monday they had gone to work, and the husband had come home and taken their daughter away on some pretext. Later they came to know about the incident. Husband said - Wife went to get medicine Ajit Kumar said that his wife was unwell and they were going to Bhawanipur to get medicine. According to him, near the Chaukhandi railway line his wife said she wanted to meet a friend and began crossing the railway track. He said that when he saw the train approaching, he ran to save them, but the train passed over his wife and daughter, leading to the tragic accident. News is being updated…

stories.title: UPSC issues clarification regarding Rank-301 in Civil Services 2025 results:UP's Akanksha Singh gets selected; Bihar candidate's claim proven false
stories.summary: The Union Public Service Commission (UPSC) has issued a clarification regarding the confusion over Rank-301 in the Civil Services Examination 2025 results. The Commission has clarified that Akansha Singh from Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, is the successful candidate who achieved Rank-301 in the final result. UPSC stated that, according to Commission records, the candidate who secured Rank-301 in the Civil Services Examination (Main) 2025 final result is Akansha Singh. Her father's name is Ranjit Singh, and her mother's name is Neelam Singh. Her roll number is 0856794. After this clarification from the Commission, the controversy regarding Rank-301 has been largely cleared. Akansha from UP, Bihar had claimed 301st rank The Civil Services Examination 2025 final result was declared on March 6. After the result was announced, two candidates with the same name, Akansha Singh, claimed to have secured Rank 301 in the final merit list. Claims from two different Akanksha Singhs from Uttar Pradesh and Bihar emerged regarding the 301st rank. Actually, in the merit list released by UPSC, Akanksha Singh's name is registered at AIR 301, whose roll number is 0856794. This led to confusion after claims from both candidates. There was an error in Bihar's Akanksha's admit card Dainik Bhaskar checked the admit cards of both candidates to investigate the matter. The roll number 0856794 is recorded on the interview call letter of Akanksha from Ghazipur, UP. The same roll number was visible when scanning the QR code shown on this admit card. Meanwhile, Akanksha Singh from Ara, Bihar, provided her prelims admit card to Bhaskar. However, this also showed roll number 0856794. But when scanning the QR code, roll number 085659 was visible. UP's Akanksha says, ‘Now there is no confusion’ Ranjit Singh's daughter, Akanksha from Ghazipur, Uttar Pradesh, told Dainik Bhaskar that she appeared for Mains in August 2025 with roll number 0856794 and gave the interview on February 4, 2026. Says, ‘It is clear to me that this result is mine’. You can verify it with the code or roll number on my admit card. There is no doubt on UPSC's site. There has been misinformation in the media. The whole matter is clear that this result is mine. If Akanksha from Ara feels the result is hers, she should come forward, deny this and show proof. I don't know on what basis Akanksha from Ara has seen the result. I took all three tests, including Mains, with this same roll number. My father helps me take every exam. When I filled out the form, I received this roll number. Bihar's Akanksha says this is not my mistake, but UPSC's mistake Bihar's Akanksha belongs to Khopira village in Bhojpur district. However, her family lives in the Katira locality of Ara city. Akanksha received her early education from Catholic Mission School in Ara. She took her matriculation exam in 2017 and scored 80 percent. In 2019, she scored 81 percent marks in the Intermediate (Science) examination. Continuing her further studies, she graduated in English in 2022, where she secured first position with 64 percent marks. In conversation with Dainik Bhaskar, Akanksha says, ‘My life has been very simple, and I have achieved this position through hard work and dedication while living with limited resources’. My father, Kumar Indu Bhushan Singh, is a farmer and mother, Rinku Devi, is a housewife. 3 girls in UPSC Civil Services top 10 UPSC has released the final result of the Civil Services Exam 2025. Anuj Agnihotri from Rawatbhata in Chittorgarh, Rajasthan, has topped All India. 958 candidates have been selected for different services. 180 candidates selected for IAS In the released result, a total of 180 candidates have been selected for the IAS. 55 candidates have been selected for IFS. Meanwhile, 150 candidates have been selected for IPS. Check result here Candidates can visit the official websites upsc.gov.in and upsconline.nic.in to check the final merit list. IAS-IPS Cadre allocation rules changed this year The Government of India has abolished the 'zone system' arrangement for UPSC cadre allotment that had been in place since 2017. It has been replaced with the new 'Cadre Allocation Policy 2026'. Under this, officers' cadres will now be distributed through a 'cycle system'. This policy will apply to candidates selected for the Indian Administrative Service (IAS), Indian Police Service (IPS), and Indian Forest Service (IFoS).

This would help secure jobs in this recruitment as soon as possible. stories.title: Mayawati expels leader who brought criminals into BSP:Wasim with 56 cases; history-sheeter given party membership
stories.summary: BSP chief Mayawati has expelled Vikram Singh, who was the coordinator for several divisions in Western UP, from the party. The allegation is that Vikram Singh Jatav, keeping Mayawati in the dark, arranged a meeting between her and two criminals on January 22 and also got them BSP membership. It is being said that both criminals wanted to contest the district panchayat elections from BSP. 'Dainik Bhaskar' had prominently published this news. When this information reached Mayawati, she expressed her displeasure on Monday and issued an order for Vikram Singh's expulsion. Charges of western UP divisional coordinators also changed Mayawati has also made changes in the charges of coordinators for Western UP and Lucknow divisions. Suraj Singh Jatav has been made the coordinator for Agra and Aligarh divisions. While Zafar Malik has been appointed as the coordinator for Lucknow division. Munqad Ali's stature has also been elevated in Western UP. He has been entrusted with the responsibility of divisions like Meerut, Moradabad, Bareilly, etc. Mayawati was already said to be dissatisfied with the functioning of Western UP. Recently, a BSP program was held in Aligarh, but the expected crowd did not turn up. Mayawati had also expressed displeasure over this. Mayawati met several Western UP leaders before the expulsion According to BSP sources, before expelling Vikram Singh from the party, Mayawati met several leaders from Western UP on Monday. These leaders had complained about Vikram Singh's activities. This action was taken only after that. This was the whole case Vikram Singh had recently given party membership to Waseem Munne, a notorious criminal from Meerut. Waseem Munne is a resident of Safiabad Loti village in Mundali police station area of Meerut district. There are 56 FIRs against him. It is also a coincidence that the first case against him was registered in 2007, when BSP chief Mayawati was the Chief Minister of the state. This FIR was registered in Ghaziabad. Cases are registered against Waseem in several districts including Ghaziabad, Gautam Buddh Nagar, Delhi, Hapur and Meerut. These include serious charges such as theft, robbery, dacoity, fraud and rioting. Similarly, Vikram Singh had also inducted Sushil Fauji, a resident of Bhadaura in Rohta police station area of Meerut, into the BSP. Sushil Fauji is said to be a history-sheeter and gangster in police records. Around 12 cases, including murder and rioting, are also registered against him. According to police records, Sushil Fauji, along with his gang, spreads terror in the area through robbery, extortion, murder, and threats. Despite this, Vikram Singh had arranged a meeting for both of them with Mayawati and got them inducted into the BSP. It is said that both had also struck a deal with Vikram Singh regarding making them candidates in the district panchayat elections. Some leaders of the Meerut organization had objected to this even then, but due to Vikram Singh's influence, no one could openly protest. When the news of both criminals' entry into BSP was published in Dainik Bhaskar, to suppress the matter, both were immediately separated from the party. Efforts were made to prevent this information from reaching Mayawati, but on Monday, it finally reached her, and she expelled Vikram Singh from the party. Had also received admonition for including a woman accused in a rape case in the party While being the coordinator of Meerut division, Vikram Singh had previously also included Meenakshi Singh, who was a co-accused in a rape case, in the party. This case is about four years old. A Muslim girl residing in Bareilly had at that time filed a rape case against Meenakshi Singh, who was then a BJP leader, and her brother. The girl alleged that Meenakshi Singh had given her shelter in her house, and during that time, her brother had given her an intoxicating drink and raped her. The victim also alleged that Meenakshi Singh made a video clip of the incident and pressured her. After the matter came to light, the BJP expelled Meenakshi Singh from the party. After this, Vikram Singh got her to join the BSP and also arranged her meeting with Mayawati in Delhi. After Meenakshi Singh's case came to light, Mayawati gave strict advice to Vikram Singh. Despite this, he got Waseem Munne and Sushil Fauji to join the party.

stories.title: UP Deputy CMs stuck in flight for an hour:Were flying to Kolkata from Lucknow on IndiGo plane
stories.summary: UP Deputy CMs Brajesh Pathak and Keshav Prasad Maurya were stuck for about 1 hour on Monday in an Indigo flight. Both were travelling from Lucknow Airport to Kolkata. Just before takeoff, the pilot detected a technical fault in the aircraft. He immediately informed Air Traffic Control (ATC). The engineering team was called. The aircraft was inspected for about an hour. After this, the flight departed for Kolkata. Now, know the complete matter in detail According to information, IndiGo flight number 6E-505 was scheduled to depart from Lucknow's Chaudhary Charan Singh International Airport for Kolkata (CCU) at 7:40 AM. Passengers had already boarded. Both Deputy CMs were also on the flight. Then, due to some technical issue, the flight kept getting delayed. Both Deputy CMs and passengers had to remain seated in the aircraft until the malfunction was fixed. After about an hour, the aircraft took off at 8:59 AM. The aircraft landed in Kolkata at 10:17 AM. Both Deputy CMs went to Kolkata to attend party meeting It was reported that Deputy CM Brajesh Pathak and Keshav Prasad Maurya have gone to Kolkata to attend a BJP meeting. Discussions will be held there regarding the proposed assembly elections in West Bengal. BJP officials from across the country have arrived for the meeting.

stories.title: Lioness Neerja gives birth to 4 cubs:Mother and cubs are healthy; staff and visitors barred near cage for 7 days
stories.summary: Lioness Neerja has given birth to 4 cubs in Etawah Safari Park. The lioness and cubs are healthy. They are being continuously monitored through CCTV. Public and regular staff are not allowed near the cage for 7 days. Whether the cubs are male or female will be known after a week. The park management has released a video after the birth of the cubs. In the video, lioness Neerja is cuddling her cubs. The cubs are climbing and moving around on her belly. This is the 3rd time Neerja has given birth to cubs. There are already 19 lions living here. Asiatic lions from Gir in Gujarat have been settled in Etawah Lion Safari. 4 cubs born in one and a half hours Etawah Safari Park Director Dr. Anil Kumar Patel said that lioness Neerja gave birth to four cubs on the night of March 8. The first cub was born at 8:25 PM. The second cub was born at 9:07 PM, the third at 9:43 PM, and the fourth cub was born at 9:59 PM. He said that all four cubs have been in normal condition since birth. The lioness is also taking good care of her babies. The cubs and lionesses are being continuously monitored through CCTV cameras installed in the breeding center to maintain surveillance on their safety and health. Special care taken during pregnancy According to the safari administration, mating occurred between lion Kanha and lioness Neerja between November 18 and November 21, 2025. Subsequently, during examination at IVRI Bareilly, Neerja was confirmed to be pregnant. After pregnancy confirmation, the lioness was kept in the safari's breeding center, where a team of doctors and keepers was providing special care. Given the expected delivery time around Holi, the safari administration remained vigilant and increased monitoring of all wildlife. Neerja becomes mother for the 3rd time, 5 cubs alive According to the safari administration, Neerja has become a mother for the third time. Previously, she has given birth to cubs twice. Her first 5 cubs are growing healthy in the safari, while two have died. With the birth of 4 new cubs, her total number of cubs at Etawah Safari Park has now reached nine. Family of 19 lions in safari, 5 cubs died in 1 year Before the birth of four cubs, there was a family of 19 lions in Etawah Safari Park. This includes 5 lions, 6 lionesses, and 8 cubs. In the past 1 year, 5 cubs have died after birth in the safari. Lioness Rupa gave birth to 4 cubs on April 21, 2025, out of which 3 have died so far. Lioness Neeraja gave birth to 4 cubs on May 31, 2024, out of which only 2 have survived. Among the cubs whose death cases have come to light, most were stillborn (dead at birth). Lioness Rupa gave birth to four cubs on April 21, 2025, but 1 cub died immediately after birth. The second one died 2 days later on April 23, when the lioness accidentally sat on her cub while nursing. Rupa's third cub died 85 days after birth on July 16. The cub was eating very little. On July 4, its nervous system malfunctioned, and it died due to illness. Meanwhile, lioness Neerja gave birth to four cubs on May 31, 2024, of which two were stillborn. Two cubs are completely healthy and have turned one year old. 34 lions and cubs died in safari from 2014 to 2025 After the start of the lion breeding center in the safari, a total of 15 deaths of lions, lionesses, and their cubs occurred from 2014 to 2022. The highest 10 deaths occurred in 2023, and 6 cubs died in 2024. This year until July, 3 cubs of lioness Rupa have died. About 90% of cubs were stillborn. In the past 11 years, a total of 34 lions, lionesses, and cubs died in the safari.

stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj approaches POCSO court again against Shankaracharya:Seeks to stop yatra reaching Sitapur, says Batuk victim in fear
stories.summary: Ashutosh Maharaj has once again approached the court against Swami Avimukteshwaranand. On Monday, he filed a petition in the special POCSO court in Prayagraj seeking a halt to the ‘Gau Pratishtha Dharmayuddh Yatra’. He said the Shankaracharya should be stopped from reaching Sitapur because the batuk who recorded a statement against him belongs to the neighbouring Hardoi district. According to him, the batuk is living in fear due to the yatra. In the same court earlier, Ashutosh Maharaj had filed a case accusing the Shankaracharya of sexually harassing batuks. The Shankaracharya had started his yatra from Varanasi on 7 March. After passing through Raebareli and Unnao, the procession is scheduled to reach Sitapur on Monday evening. The yatra, demanding that the cow be declared ‘Rashtra Mata’ (National Mother), will conclude in Lucknow on 11 March. Meanwhile, police have registered an FIR against unidentified persons in connection with a life-threatening attack on Ashutosh Maharaj in a moving train on Sunday. Police have questioned four passengers who were present in the train at the time of the incident. However, what information has emerged from the questioning is not yet clear. Ashutosh Maharaj was travelling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express. His reservation was in the AC First Class coach. Near Sirathu railway station, an unidentified person attacked him near the toilet. The attacker allegedly tried to slit his nose with a sharp weapon. Ashutosh Maharaj is the same person who had earlier filed an FIR accusing the Shankaracharya of sexually harassing batuks. Know what Ashutosh Maharaj said after the attack... Ashutosh Maharaj had said- I was traveling from Ghaziabad to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express train. I was sitting in the First AC coach. On the way, near Sirathu railway station around 5 AM, I got up to use the toilet. A man was standing near the gate. As soon as I moved forward, he attacked me from behind. He tried to cut my nose with a sharp weapon and made several strikes on my face and hands. This caused me serious injuries and a lot of bleeding. I somehow managed to save my life and locked myself in the train's toilet. From there, I called the GRP and informed them about the incident. Ashutosh Maharaj said - Avimukteshwaranand got the attack done After filing a complaint with the GRP, Ashutosh Maharaj went to the circuit house. Speaking there, he said he was travelling in the H1 coach of the First AC with West UP coordinator Sudhanshu Som. He said the attack happened when he went to the bathroom in the morning. He claimed he had a scuffle with the attacker to save his life. According to him, the attacker was alone and looked like a bodybuilder. The man was not wearing a mask. He said he would recognise the attacker if he saw him again and suspected that the man might have been following him from Ghaziabad. Ashutosh Maharaj also expressed suspicion that more attackers could have been waiting outside the train. He said he first informed the GRP before coming out of the bathroom. Launching a sharp attack on the Shankaracharya, he alleged the attack was carried out so that he would not be able to present evidence in court. He claimed the Shankaracharya knew he would not get bail once the evidence was presented. Ashutosh Maharaj is a disciple of Jagadguru Rambhadracharya Ashutosh Brahmachari Maharaj was born in a Brahmin family in Kandla town of Shamli district. His father Rajendra Pandey worked as a conductor on private buses running on the Delhi Road. Ashutosh Maharaj later became associated with the committee of the ancient Shakumbhari Siddhpeeth temple in Kandla and currently serves as its manager. His uncle Pradeep Pandey is a priest at the temple. Now Know About The Dispute Between Shankaracharya And Ashutosh Maharaj Now read what Shankaracharya said after the attack on Ashutosh Maharaj? Reacting to the attack on Sunday, the Shankaracharya said the train attendant claimed Ashutosh Maharaj was fine when he went to the bathroom but came out injured later. He asked who attacked him after he came out and alleged that the incident appeared staged to create an atmosphere and obtain security. He also questioned whether trains run by the Government of India were no longer safe. He said if someone is travelling with a valid ticket, the Government Railway Police responsible for security should explain how such an attack could happen. The Centre, he said, should answer this. Responding to the allegation that the attack was carried out to stop evidence from being presented in court, he said a fair investigation should be conducted so that the truth becomes clear. He added that someone who supports the investigation from the beginning would have no reason to get such an attack carried out. He said they were busy with the yatra and had no knowledge of where Ashutosh Maharaj was travelling. He claimed the accusations were meant only to gain media attention and divert focus from the yatra.

stories.title: Dimple asks govt to clear India's stand on Iran war:Akhilesh says, 'Govt has mortgaged foreign policy'
stories.summary: There was a huge uproar in the Lok Sabha and Rajya Sabha on the first day of the second phase of Parliament's budget session. The SP and other opposition parties created an uproar, demanding a discussion on the US-Israel war with Iran and the no-confidence motion against Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla. There was intense sloganeering. In fact, 118 MPs from the opposition, including Congress, had submitted a signed notice to the Lok Sabha Secretariat on February 10. They had alleged that the Speaker was not maintaining impartiality in the proceedings of the House. Not giving adequate opportunity to the opposition. Speaking to the media in the Parliament House on this, SP chief Akhilesh Yadav says, ‘There will be a meeting of floor leaders now, after which it will be decided how to proceed further’. He criticized the Modi government regarding Indians stranded in Gulf countries. says, ' The BJP government has mortgaged our foreign policy. Inflation keeps rising. What is the Government of India doing for our people who are stranded abroad? SP MP Dimple Yadav says, 'While a motion to remove the Lok Sabha Speaker is coming, what's more important is where India stands in the war between Iran and America, what our policy says, and what our Foreign Ministry is saying'. The way it is still working under American pressure, many such important issues will be raised in this session. Meanwhile, BJP MP Hema Malini says, ‘This time we were hoping something good would happen’. The opposition has brought a proposal; now, let's see what happens. BJP MP Arun Govil says, ‘We have faith, our party has faith in our Lok Sabha Speaker’. Let the opposition say whatever they want to say.

stories.title: 2-day rain alert in UP, temperature crosses 37°C:Scorching heat in 5 cities, including Jhansi; mercury likely to reach 40°C soon
stories.summary: Summer has started showing its intensity in UP in March itself. The temperature has crossed 35°C in 5 cities, including Jhansi and Agra. People are sweating at night. AC-coolers have started running in homes. People are using scarves and umbrellas on roads to protect from the sun. Meanwhile, the weather department has issued a rain alert for eastern UP and surrounding areas for the next two days. During this time, clouds may remain in many districts. Light rain may occur with thunder and lightning. Winds may blow at speeds of 25 to 30 kilometers per hour. Talking about the last 24 hours, Agra was the hottest in the state. The temperature here was recorded at 37.6 °C. People had to face scorching heat due to strong sunlight and hot winds. Besides this, cities like Kanpur, Prayagraj, Agra, and Varanasi also saw a spike in temperature. Weather expert Atul Kumar Singh said- Temperature may rise further in the coming days. Soon the mercury could reach 40 degrees Celsius in many areas of the state. However, due to the effect of western disturbance, there may be a slight drop in temperature in some parts of the state in the next two days. Doctors and administration have advised people to avoid going out in intense sunlight during the afternoon. Drink plenty of water. Take necessary precautions to avoid heatwaves. The weather will remain mixed for farmers. Light rain could be beneficial for crops. However, there are concerns about damage to standing crops due to heat and strong winds. Why is the heat increasing in March itself? Skymet Weather Vice President Mahesh Palawat says that in recent years, the impact of climate change has been clearly visible on the weather. Due to this, weather patterns are changing rapidly. Summer is starting earlier compared to before. The effect is that the temperature is rising more rapidly. The number of hot days is also increasing. Sometimes, the period of heat waves also lasts longer than before. In the past few years, many cities in the country have broken old heat records. In some places, temperatures have been recorded above 48°C. Western Disturbance active. What effect will be seen in UP? According to Mahesh Palawat, there is a possibility of a western disturbance becoming active, which may lead to light rain and snowfall in the Western Himalayan region (Jammu-Kashmir, Ladakh, Himachal Pradesh, and Uttarakhand) until March 11. Its effect will also be seen in UP. Actually, a trough line extends up to the northern parts of Uttar Pradesh from the cyclonic circulation (wind rising while rotating in a circular motion in one area) formed in the northern Odisha and Bengal region. Due to this system, slight changes in the state's weather may be observed. However, the weather in Uttar Pradesh is likely to remain mostly dry for now, but some areas may see cloud cover, and there could be slight fluctuations in temperature. Heatwave may last for a long time According to IMD's forecast, heatwave conditions may persist for a long time in some areas this year. This means that temperatures may remain very high for several consecutive days in many cities, and people may have to face intense heat. When is a heatwave considered? According to the Weather Department, a heatwave is considered when the temperature in the plains reaches 40 degrees Celsius or higher, or when the temperature recorded is 4 to 6 degrees above normal. In such conditions, people's health can be affected, and the risk of heatstroke increases. Crops will be damaged due to heat Professor PK Singh from the Agriculture Department at Banaras Hindu University (BHU) says - March could prove challenging for farmers. The rise in temperature will affect the Rabi crops, especially wheat. The grains will not develop fully due to the heat. This will result in lower yield. According to PK Singh, crops like mustard, chickpeas, and peas can also be damaged due to hot winds. Rising temperatures cause the soil in fields to dry quickly. This increases irrigation costs. Crops face stress.

stories.title: Brace for summer power cuts:UP records 19,000 MW demand in March, concerns rise over 33,000 MW peak load
stories.summary: The heat in UP is increasing day by day. Power demand has also reached record levels. In the first week of March itself, the demand crossed 19 thousand megawatts (MW). Last year too, power demand started increasing from February, which reached 32 thousand megawatts. This time it is estimated that power demand could reach 33 thousand megawatts in May-June. But the question is where will so much electricity come from? The transmission capacity is also 2.05 lakh crore kilowatts less compared to the sanctioned load of consumers. Power generation is limited, distribution system is struggling. In such a situation, how will electricity reach people's homes? Read this report... Despite the implementation of Consumer Right Rule-2020, UP is the only state in the country where roster system is still running. While electricity is being provided 24 hours across the country, in UP rural areas an 18-hour roster is being implemented. The electricity system can be understood from 3 points Know How Much Electricity is Available in UP? Energy Minister AK Sharma had said in response to a question during the budget session that more than 31 thousand megawatts of electricity is available in the state. Of this, the production capacity of state-owned companies is 18,136 megawatts. At the same time, the state government gets 8,814 megawatts of electricity from the private sector under contract. Additionally, 7,621 megawatts of electricity is received from the central pool, NTPC etc. Solar capacity has also reached 2,815 megawatts. However, solar power generation depends on the time of day and weather. Overall, the average electricity consumption in UP has currently reached 724 units per year. Could not provide 19 thousand megawatt supply during Holi Although electricity availability in UP is said to be more than 31 thousand megawatts. On March 3 at 8:17 PM, the electricity demand in the state reached 19,830 megawatts. However, the electricity department could only supply 17,211 megawatts of power. This means the electricity department failed to supply about two and a half thousand megawatts compared to demand. Power cuts had to be implemented to make up for this shortfall. Uttar Pradesh State Electricity Consumer Council President Avdhesh Verma raises the question that when electricity availability is sufficient in the state, why these cuts? UP is the first state in the country where roster system continues despite Consumer Right Rule 2020 being implemented. Know the reality of Transmission and Distribution In UP, electricity generation mainly happens through UPRVUNL plants and Share State Generating Stations (SSGS). However, transmission lines and sub-stations have become old. After implementing the vertical system, manpower has also reduced. Contract workers are being laid off. Staff should have been increased to provide uninterrupted power to the state's 3.72 crore consumers, but instead cuts are being made. The state has a total electricity load of 8.40 crore kilowatts for 3.72 crore consumers. The available capacity of 132 KV sub-stations of the transmission company is only 6.35 crore kilowatts. There is a gap of 2.05 crore kilowatts. Additionally, about 20 percent electricity theft occurs in the state. This is why the state can never supply electricity compared to the demand. How will the department meet the demand of 33 thousand megawatts According to UP Power Corporation Chairman Ashish Goyal, last time the highest electricity demand in the state reached close to 32 thousand megawatts in May-June. This time the electricity department estimates that it could reach up to 33 thousand megawatts. Keeping this in mind, the electricity department had started preparations from winter itself. The department has banked up to 5500 megawatts of electricity in several states including Madhya Pradesh, Tripura, Chhattisgarh, and Rajasthan. This means that when electricity demand was low in UP during winter, they provided their quota of electricity to these states. In return, they will receive that much electricity from them during summer when needed. This only incurs transmission costs. The Power Corporation claims that when electricity demand increases in the state, they will use the banked electricity. Additionally, the electricity department also makes short-term electricity purchase agreements. This is done for the period between May and July. Sometimes when needed, electricity is purchased from the open market, but then the electricity rates are very high. According to UP Power Struggle Committee Coordinator Shailendra Dubey, the electricity department is never able to provide power according to the state's demand. There is a reason for this. Firstly, the state's power distribution system has not yet been fully upgraded. In rural areas, even today power lines have not been replaced in many places. The capacity of transformers is much less compared to the load. Due to this, transformers often burn out in summer. Many times power lines break due to overload.

stories.title: Thousands join Shia procession wearing black in Lucknow:Mourning on 19th Ramazan; devotees rush to touch the coffin
stories.summary: In Lucknow, with devotion and tearful eyes, the procession of 'Gileem' (coffin of blankets) is being taken out on the 19th of Ramadan. Thousands of people from the Shia community participated in the 4-kilometer-long procession. From men, women, and children to the elderly, everyone was seen wearing black clothes. Among them, there was a rush to catch a glimpse, touch, and kiss the coffin. Before the procession started, a Majlis was held at Kufa Mosque in Saadatganj. Prayers were offered. Then the procession began. It will pass through Turiyaganj, Sarkata Nala, Billauchpura, and reach Pata Nala Imambara Taki Zaidi in Chowk. Police forces deployed Considering security in the procession, police forces are deployed everywhere. RAF and CRPF have taken charge. Surveillance is being done with drones and CCTV cameras. Police personnel are deployed on the rooftops of buildings along the routes the procession will take. It is to be noted that on the 19th of Ramadan, when Hazrat Ali reached the mosque for prayers, he was attacked with a sword for the first time. After this, Hazrat Ali was martyred on the 21st of Ramadan. The procession is taken out in remembrance of that very incident. See the procession in five pictures

stories.title: MBA graduate searching for ₹20K job even after 3 years:Young women reach UP’s pink employment fair with resume
stories.summary: We are still just wandering around. It’s not clear where exactly to submit the CV. What is the process? Only nominal interviews are happening here; we just want to get a job. This was said by Anjali Chaudhary, who attended the Pink Job Fair held on March 8, 2026, at Indira Gandhi Pratishthan in Lucknow. More than 50 major companies, including Amazon, Flipkart, Reliance, Jio, and several logistics firms, participated in the fair. These companies came to offer employment opportunities to women in sectors such as sales, customer service, IT support, banking, and healthcare. The job fair, organised on Women’s Day, was filled with hope. Young women and others who had travelled from far away stood in long queues with files and resumes in their hands. Hope for employment was visible on their faces. However, along with hope, uncertainty and fatigue were also evident. Many women stood in the scorching sun and crowd, drenched in sweat, yet they did not lose hope. They believed that perhaps their hard work would finally pay off. Dainik Bhaskar spoke to several women present at the fair to understand their expectations, experiences, and hopes of getting a job. Shivangi said – Hoping for a better job Shivangi Maurya, who attended the fair, said she currently works as a teacher in a private school and earns Rs 4,000–Rs 5,000 per month. She came to the fair hoping for better employment and a higher salary. “The companies have taken my CV, but it’s not clear what the next process will be. I was told that I will receive a call within two days for further information,” she said. Richa Pathak also said she had come looking for a job. Her CV was collected, and she was told that she would be called later for an interview. Sanskruti Mani Tripathi, a final-year graduation student from Lucknow, also attended the fair. She said companies collected her resume and informed her that she would receive a phone call regarding the next step. Akshi said – Searching for a job for 3 years Akshi, who attended the job fair, said she holds an MBA degree but has been searching for a job for the past three years. “I have tried for jobs at many places and given interviews, but every time I faced disappointment,” she said. Despite the long struggle, she said the job fair has given her new hope that she might finally get an opportunity where her education and hard work will pay off. Soni travelled 100 km but returned disappointed Soni Begum, who came from nearly 100 kilometres away, said only resumes were being collected at the fair. “We were told that if needed, we would be called later. Right now there is only a 20–25% chance of getting a job,” she said. She added that people had travelled from far distances in the heat. Earlier it was said that jobs would be available for those with 10th or 12th qualifications, but after arriving they were told that a diploma was also required. “We submitted our resumes and are now returning. We have been standing in the sun since morning and are very tired, but still haven’t got a job,” she said. CM Yogi’s initiative appreciated Anushree, who came from Lucknow, said the initiative by Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath to organize such employment opportunities for women was a good step. According to her, it gives many young women a chance to find jobs according to their qualifications. Jyoti Srivastava said the process would move forward only if the company found their profile suitable for the applied position. ‘However, I am confident that I will be selected,’ she added. Financial assistance for Anganwadi workers During the event, the government announced Rs 3,849 lakh for insurance premiums and saree uniforms for Anganwadi workers. The amount was directly transferred to their bank accounts. However, some Anganwadi workers looked disappointed. Laxmi Devi, an Anganwadi worker, said they had hoped for a salary increase, but no such announcement was made. Financial aid under Kanya Sumangala Yojana At the job fair, the Chief Minister also distributed financial assistance checks under the Kanya Sumangala Yojana. Avishree Gupta, a Class 2 student, received a check during the event. Avishree and her parents appeared very happy. Nari Shakti award presented Women who made significant contributions in fields such as education, social service, and healthcare were also honoured with the Nari Shakti Award during the program. The award recipients said the honour would inspire them to continue working for society and achieve even greater success. Target to provide jobs to 5,000 women The government aims to provide employment opportunities to around 5,000 women and young girls through this Pink Employment Mahakumbh.

stories.title: Ashutosh Maharaj alleges ₹21 lakh attack conspiracy:Calls Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand SP’s guru, claims strong evidence
stories.summary: Ashutosh Maharaj, a disciple of Jagadguru Rambhadracharya, has claimed that he was attacked while travelling to Prayagraj on the Rewa Express early Sunday morning. According to him, the incident took place around 5 AM near Sirathu railway station in Kaushambi, when an attacker allegedly assaulted him inside the moving train. The attacker hit his nose, face and hands, after which Ashutosh was admitted to Colvin Hospital in Prayagraj. After medical examination, he reached the Circuit House, where he spoke to Dainik Bhaskar. He alleged that the attack was orchestrated over ₹21 lakh and was meant to stop him from reaching court and presenting evidence. Ashutosh also made allegations against Shankaracharya Avimukteshwaranand, saying: “He is SP’s guru and says only what they make him write. He is on a foot march, but will run away once he reaches Lucknow.” Ashutosh further claimed that he did not receive adequate help after the attack. He said he had earlier filed an FIR against the Shankaracharya over alleged sexual harassment of disciples. Question: What is the significance of the attack on you? Answer: The person who attacked me came at Avimukteshwaranand's behest for 21 lakh rupees. These people had earlier planned to cut off my nose. They must have thought that by cutting off my nose, they would eliminate the evidence. If I don't survive, what evidence would go to court. Their plan was not successful. In fact, on February 24, Falahari Maharaj, president of Shri Krishna Janmabhoomi Sangharsh Nyas, had said that a Sanatani who cuts off Ashutosh Brahmachari's nose would get a reward of 21 lakh rupees. They should be garlanded with shoes. Question: How did you save yourself? Answer: The Lord has saved me. Otherwise these people would have killed me. I will live as long as God wishes. It's clear that their story is over. They are telling different kinds of lies. They will keep saying something or the other. Question: Did you know beforehand that there could be an attack? Answer: I didn't say that. Look, everyone has apprehensions, everyone faces danger. I always write to the administration before traveling. I had written to the administration that I would go to Prayagraj from this date to this date. Somehow they must have got wind of it and orchestrated the attack. Question: How can you say with such confidence that Avimukteshwaranand orchestrated the attack? Answer: How can I accept that some third person carried out the attack? The person who is getting a declaration of 21 lakhs made. Anyone would attack for money. These days everyone wants money. They are also roaming around for money. They must be getting donations. This is their only work. Question: Shankaracharya is claiming that you orchestrated the attack on yourself? Answer: He can say anything. He doesn't know what he's saying. He only speaks what the Samajwadi Party spokespersons write for him, because he has taken funding. Akhilesh Yadav is his disciple. He is saying this at his behest. Elections are approaching. If he is such a great spiritual leader, why did he run away? Why did you leave Banaras? The court had said to fully cooperate in the investigation. You want to escape on the pretext of Lucknow. Will you run to Delhi? Question: Did the attacker say anything to you? Answer: Yes, the attacker was saying that he would cut off my nose and offer it at his guru's feet. He was saying that he had taken an oath. The attacker was referring to Avimukteshwaranand as his guru. Question: How satisfied are you with the action taken so far? Answer: I don't even know what the police are doing. The police made me go here and there. They took me to the hospital. I was feeling unwell, but no one came to check on me. GRP officials don't answer phone calls. I haven't received any help. No facilities of any kind have been provided to me. Question: You have said that if they shed as much blood as mine has been shed, you will withdraw the case? Answer: Yes, yes, I have said that. As much blood as mine has been shed. If Avimukteshwaranand sheds even half of that, I will withdraw the assault case. I can see who orchestrated the attack. I will name them. Question: If the court's decision in the sexual harassment case is not in your favor, what will be the next step? Answer: I will go to the Supreme Court. If there is no hearing in the Supreme Court, I will go to the Honorable President. I will fight till my last breath. The law should be equal for everyone. If it was a common man, he would be in jail under the POCSO Act. Today a renunciant saint, who is a guru of socialists, is committing sexual exploitation and roaming freely. He gets a stay. If it was a common man, the poor fellow wouldn't even be able to come out. Question: You had said that Shankaracharya will escape under the pretext of travel? Answer: Yes, there is a plan to make him flee. Just wait and see if he doesn't escape from Lucknow airport. He will 100% flee somewhere outside. He can see that if he returns, the court won't spare him because we have strong evidence against him. He is just trying to find ways to escape. stories.title: FIR against Maulana for making objectionable comments on Yogi's mother:BJP workers burn effigy in Balrampur; warn of agitation
stories.summary: An FIR has been registered in Balrampur against Maulana Abdullah Salim Chaturvedi for allegedly making objectionable remarks about the mother of Uttar Pradesh Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath. The case was filed by Kotwali Nagar police based on a complaint lodged by BJP district president Ravi Kumar Mishra. See 2 pictures of the protest... BJP workers stage protest, burn effigy On Sunday, BJP workers staged a protest in Balrampur, raising slogans against the Maulana and burning his effigy. Party workers first gathered at the BJP district office and later marched in a procession to Veer Vinay intersection, where they demonstrated and set the effigy on fire. Several local leaders, including MLAs Paltu Ram and Kailash Nath Shukla, condemned the alleged remarks and demanded strict action. Workers warned that if the Maulana is not arrested soon, a larger protest movement will be launched. Students had protested in Lucknow earlier A day earlier, students had also protested in Lucknow against the Maulana. They organized a mock funeral procession in Hazratganj, after which they poured petrol and set it on fire at a busy intersection. Police attempted to stop the protesters but were unable to control the situation immediately, leading to a brief commotion. ‘Comment hurt sentiments of entire state’: MLA Paltu Ram Balrampur Sadar MLA Paltu Ram strongly condemned the remarks and said the statement had hurt public sentiments. “Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath is not only the head of the state but also the head priest of Gorakhpeeth. The comment made against his mother is condemnable and has hurt the sentiments of the entire state. Such statements cross all limits of humanity.” Strict legal action demanded Tulsipur MLA Kailash Nath Shukla demanded strict legal action against the accused. He warned that if authorities fail to act firmly, the protest could intensify in the coming days. Former Gasadi MLA Shailesh Kumar Singh ‘Shailu’ also criticised the remarks, saying Yogi Adityanath has dedicated his life to Sanatan Dharma and social service. Using derogatory language against his mother, he said, was deeply unfortunate. ‘Strict action needed to deter such remarks’ BJP district president Ravi Kumar Mishra, who filed the complaint, said strict action should be taken to ensure that people think carefully before making such statements in the future. He added that although BJP workers have so far held only a symbolic protest within democratic traditions, stronger agitation could follow if the accused is not arrested. Kotwali Nagar Inspector-in-Charge Manoj Kumar Singh said police have registered a case based on the complaint and are examining the matter. “The case has been registered and the entire incident is being investigated. Further legal action will be taken based on the facts that emerge during the probe,” he said. Video of Maulana’s speech surfaces online Meanwhile, a video of Maulana Abdullah Salim has surfaced on social media. According to reports, the speech was delivered during a religious gathering in Bihar during the month of Ramadan. In the video, the Maulana allegedly makes controversial remarks about Yogi Adityanath and state laws in Uttar Pradesh. (The full statement has not been reproduced verbatim here due to the presence of objectionable language. The offensive portions have been omitted.)
